However, he will have difficulty fighting Shang Zhanluo and the rest with his current strength, especially since they are stronger than us."

chapters.title: Chapter 1502: People Minds III
paragraphs: "Why don’t you still want to be Zhang Fei’s wife, Shengjie?"

"Aren’t you the same as me, Xun’er?" Helian Xun’er simply smiled at Tianshi Shengjie. "We’ve both been in love with him for a long time, but he still hasn’t managed to win our hearts because he’s too busy with other things."

Helian Xun’er agreed with her. "I’ve known about Zhang Fei since his cultivation had just broken through to the Earth Realm, and I kept watching him when he challenged the Star Tower with the others. I was truly impressed by his fighting prowess and mindset, but I still didn’t have feelings for him at the time. However, that changed when he reached the repository of those techniques, and he managed to learn his chosen technique in just a short time, but I didn’t see him for a long time after that. When I finally saw him again, he had brought more people to challenge the tower and had already improved significantly."

"Unlike you, I met Zhang Fei when he was still weak, but I had no doubts about him back then because he was Hu Tianlang’s sole successor." Tianshi Shengji looked towards the pavilion. "My avatar met him again when he went to the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm, and his growth as a cultivator was so rapid that it surpassed all cultivators in this realm. Not only did his cultivation improve rapidly, but so did his combat abilities and other things, and he progressed even faster after he left the Sky Jade Realm. I was a little shocked when he first arrived at this realm because he had already reached the Seven Divine Realms at that time, but those seven stages were just stepping stones for him, and he managed to reach the Five Celestial Realms after he emerged from his two-decade seclusion in this place."

"That’s true." Helian Xun’er nodded at her. "I was also surprised when Hua Mei’er told me that Zhang Fei had broken through to the Five Celestial Realms a few years ago, and my master asked me to go to his side at that time."

Tianshi Shengji smiled upon hearing that. "Jia Xianzu understands your feelings for Zhang Fei very well, so he asked you to go to his side. The current me is certainly no match for you, as you’ve been training here for almost three years, and you’ve perfectly adapted to level 5 gravity."

"Unfortunately, it’s still not enough, and I want to quickly be able to adapt to level 7 gravity like Zhang Fei and all his women." Helian Xun’er let out a soft sigh as she spoke. "After I adapt perfectly to that level, I will leave this place to test my fighting skills. There is a battle simulation in this place, but the feeling is different from when we face other living beings because our opponents here have no brains at all, and I can beat them easily."

"Hahaha." Tianshi Shengjie laughed at that before looking at the five female demons who were still struggling to adapt to level 1 gravity. "They were once under Yuan Xiajie’s influence, and that woman changed many of their memories, so they still have to find their true selves and improve their strength."
Helian Xun’er also looked at them. "Do you think they can get their old memories?"

"No." Tianshi Shengjie shook her head in response. "Yuan Xiajie is much stronger than us because she is a member of the ancient race, and we don’t know what kind of techniques she used on them. Zhang Fei has already checked their memories, but he couldn’t find anything in them, so he can’t restore their old memories. Although they no longer have their memories, they are safe now, and they will continue to develop in the future, especially Wang Yin."

"Yes." Helian Xun’er looked at Wang Yin. "That woman is a corpse demon, and she doesn’t have a soul. She is one of Zhang Fei’s women, even though she can’t remember their old relationship, but I’m sure that’s not a problem because he can help her to build new memories together."
Tianshi Shengjie rose to his feet. "Let’s continue our training."
"Yeah."
Meanwhile, Tian Qiye walked into Tian Yaoqin’s room because she sensed something strange from her. She stood in front of her subordinate and used her senses to examine her body.

Tian Qiye’s eyebrows raised slightly after she couldn’t find anything strange about Tian Yaoqin’s body, but she didn’t give up and tried checking her body several times to no avail. ’Is it just my feeling? I believe there’s something different about her, but I can’t find anything inside her body.’
After she did this a few more times, Tian Qiye immediately left the room, and Tian Yaoqin opened her eyes. She breathed a sigh of relief, but she immediately closed her eyes again.

Meanwhile, Tian Qiye flew high into the sky and checked on several other people, especially the people from Tian Yizu’s group, who had also locked themselves in seclusion. She didn’t tell them that she ordered her subordinates into seclusion, but they also entered into seclusion at the same time, which made her wonder about their decision.

Tian Qiye looked outside their domain with a serious expression, thinking about the demons, who were the Winged Race’s main enemies. She became irritated when she remembered Zhang Fei, especially how he treated her when she visited the Moonlit Passion Temple a few days ago.

Tian Qiye considered going to the Moonlit Passion Temple again, but she changed her mind and returned to her private chamber. She had a premonition that the situation in the Paradise Realm would change soon, but she couldn’t predict it, and she felt that it had something to do with Zhang Fei. "If he causes a major disturbance in this realm and it concerns my race, I will definitely fight him regardless of his relationship with Empress Huo."

Following Qing Qiu’er’s orders a few days ago, the elders of the Moonlit Passion Temple moved to several different domains after completing their preparations. However, they didn’t recruit disciples indiscriminately, only recruiting those who had the qualities to become capable cultivators as Zhang Fei desired.

Although finding capable disciples was not easy because they were former dual cultivation sects, the elders still carried out their duties as requested by their two leaders, and they hoped to gain many new disciples in this recruitment.

As per Zhang Fei’s orders, the natural races were busy constructing new residences in the Twin Flames Main Domain, which would be used by members of the Zhang, Qiao, Tang, and Wu Clans. As for the residences of the You and Tan Clans, they built them in areas quite separate from all the sects and cities within the domain, mainly because their activities as swordsmiths would disturb the peace.
The people of the clans joined with members of the natural races, including the giant race, to guide them so that the buildings that would become their future residences would suit their needs.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei handed over the security of the Moonlit Passion Sect to Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, Liao Yunxiao, Tian Kui, and Serpentera. They didn’t have to work too hard and simply monitored the situation in various areas, especially since the domain had already been installed with numerous formations that could protect it well.

At the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, Huang Xiaoyi couldn’t wait for the birth of her two grandchildren. Bing Xingying’s pregnancy has reached three months, and Cheng Mengyao’s pregnancy has reached one month.

Unlike Cheng Mengyao, Bing Xingying didn’t always stay with them and often stayed in the void, lest her body weaken if she spent too much time in the outside world. Despite this, she still left the void every day to visit her husband and in-laws so they wouldn’t worry about her condition or her pregnancy.

Since she had given birth to three children before, Huang Xiaoyi was used to taking care of pregnancies, and she prepared many things for her two daughters-in-law so that the babies in their wombs would be healthy.

"Haha." Luo Fenghan laughed as he stood in the distance with his two sons. "Look at your mother; she is so worried and concerned about both of your wives. Their pregnancy is still young, but she forbids them from doing strenuous activities, and she encourages them to get lots of rest until their children are born."

Luo Jiaxuan nodded in agreement as he looked at his wife, Cheng Mengyao. "I still can’t believe that my wife is pregnant now, and it happened thanks to my brother-in-law’s help. We’ve been trying to have a child for a long time, but my wife never got pregnant, which may be due to our cultivation."

"Me too." Luo Zhenyu nodded in agreement with his brother. "My wife is a void spirit, and her body is entirely different from that of an ordinary woman. I initially thought she would never be able to conceive due to her physical condition, but my brother-in-law made my dream of having a child with her come true by using his lust demon abilities."

"Haha." Luo Fenghan laughed as he nodded. "Zhang Fei has not only brought significant changes to our lives but also to the lives of everyone in this realm, and the situation in all domains is relatively safe now because of him and Feng Yao. The most striking change in the Twin Flames Main Domain is due to the many formations he has installed, which make it difficult for other cultivators to enter."

Tian Qiye looked outside their domain with a serious expression, thinking about the demons, who were the Winged Race’s main enemies.
She became irritated when she remembered Zhang Fei, especially how he treated her when she visited the Moonlit Passion Temple a few days ago.
Tian Qiye considered going to the Moonlit Passion Temple again, but she changed her mind and returned to her private chamber.
She had a premonition that the situation in the Paradise Realm would change soon, but she couldn’t predict it, and she felt that it had something to do with Zhang Fei.
"If he causes a major disturbance in this realm and it concerns my race, I will definitely fight him regardless of his relationship with Empress Huo."
Following Qing Qiu’er’s orders a few days ago, the elders of the Moonlit Passion Temple moved to several different domains after completing their preparations.
However, they didn’t recruit disciples indiscriminately, only recruiting those who had the qualities to become capable cultivators as Zhang Fei desired.

Although finding capable disciples was not easy because they were former dual cultivation sects, the elders still carried out their duties as requested by their two leaders, and they hoped to gain many new disciples in this recruitment.
As per Zhang Fei’s orders, the natural races were busy constructing new residences in the Twin Flames Main Domain, which would be used by members of the Zhang, Qiao, Tang, and Wu Clans.

As for the residences of the You and Tan Clans, they built them in areas quite separate from all the sects and cities within the domain, mainly because their activities as swordsmiths would disturb the peace.
The people of the clans joined with members of the natural races, including the giant race, to guide them so that the buildings that would become their future residences would suit their needs.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei handed over the security of the Moonlit Passion Sect to Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, Liao Yunxiao, Tian Kui, and Serpentera.
They didn’t have to work too hard and simply monitored the situation in various areas, especially since the domain had already been installed with numerous formations that could protect it well.
At the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, Huang Xiaoyi couldn’t wait for the birth of her two grandchildren.
Bing Xingying’s pregnancy has reached three months, and Cheng Mengyao’s pregnancy has reached one month.
Unlike Cheng Mengyao, Bing Xingying didn’t always stay with them and often stayed in the void, lest her body weaken if she spent too much time in the outside world.
Despite this, she still left the void every day to visit her husband and in-laws so they wouldn’t worry about her condition or her pregnancy.

Since she had given birth to three children before, Huang Xiaoyi was used to taking care of pregnancies, and she prepared many things for her two daughters-in-law so that the babies in their wombs would be healthy.
"Haha." Luo Fenghan laughed as he stood in the distance with his two sons.
"Look at your mother; she is so worried and concerned about both of your wives.
Their pregnancy is still young, but she forbids them from doing strenuous activities, and she encourages them to get lots of rest until their children are born."
Luo Jiaxuan nodded in agreement as he looked at his wife, Cheng Mengyao.
"I still can’t believe that my wife is pregnant now, and it happened thanks to my brother-in-law’s help.
We’ve been trying to have a child for a long time, but my wife never got pregnant, which may be due to our cultivation."
"Me too." Luo Zhenyu nodded in agreement with his brother.
"My wife is a void spirit, and her body is entirely different from that of an ordinary woman.
I initially thought she would never be able to conceive due to her physical condition, but my brother-in-law made my dream of having a child with her come true by using his lust demon abilities."
"Haha." Luo Fenghan laughed as he nodded.
"Zhang Fei has not only brought significant changes to our lives but also to the lives of everyone in this realm, and the situation in all domains is relatively safe now because of him and Feng Yao.
The most striking change in the Twin Flames Main Domain is due to the many formations he has installed, which make it difficult for other cultivators to enter."

chapters.title: Chapter 1503: Absorb The Bloodlust Soul
paragraphs: "Formations?"

"Yes." Luo Fenghan nodded to his two sons. "Liao Hanxue of the Liao Clan helped your brother-in-law set up the formations, and the Twin Flames Main Domain has become much safer, so all clans and sects in that domain must use teleportation portals to leave their private quarters. Although it may seem troublesome, they will adapt more quickly, and cultivators from other domains will find it difficult to break into that domain due to the numerous illusion formations and flight prohibition formations. In fact, several large clans have already decided to join the sect and plan to relocate their members to that domain."
"Doesn’t that mean the Moonlit Passion Temple will be bigger than our Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, Father?"
"Are you thinking about moving part of our clan to that domain, Father?"

"No." Luo Fenghan looked in one direction. "Ever since the incident at the Ashen Lotus Monastery two months ago, our five ancestors have begun to change their minds, and they dislike Zhang Fei because of that incident. Moreover, no one has been able to find the leading portal there, and he’s the only one who can enter that place. They will disapprove if I send some of our clansmen to the Twin Flames Main Domain, so we are reconsidering that decision."
"Do they want to be enemies with our brother-in-law, Father?" Luo Zhenyu asked.

Luo Jiaxuan also spoke to him. "They should have heard about our brother-in-law’s actions since he joined the Moonlit Passion Temple, so they should be aware that they are no longer his opponents. Unfortunately, their envy and jealousy have blinded their hearts, and they have difficulty accepting the reality in front of them."

"Sigh." Luo Fenghan released a heavy sigh. "There’s a saying that age can’t guarantee one’s maturity, and they are an easy example. They are much more experienced and more senior than your brother-in-law, but they act like children when they find something they think is valuable, even though there’s nothing there. Back then, we had already inspected the entire area of the Ashen Lotus Monastery, and we had already explained it to them, but they would rather not listen to our words, and they still harbored jealousy toward him. If they can’t control their jealousy, fights and divisions will break out among us, and our sect will be weakened by it."
"What would you do if that happened, Father?"
"At that time, would you side with our ancestors or our brother-in-law?"

"Do you two really need to ask that?" Luo Fenghan turned to them. "Although they are our ancestors, they have no direct relationship with us. On the other hand, Luo Yunxiao and Zhang Fei are my children, so your mother and I will stand by them if trouble inevitably arises."

"Haha." Luo Jiaxuan and Luo Zhenyu laughed at that. "We will without a doubt stand by our brother-in-law, Father. Even though we are not that close to him, we are indebted to him because he made our dream of having children with our wives come true."
"We respect our ancestors, but we will not side with those who are controlled by their envy and jealousy."

Luo Fenghan nodded in satisfaction with his two sons’ answers. "By the way, you two have already seen the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple, so I want you two to go there often to train, especially under the guidance of the Sword Maniac, Jian Kuang. Furthermore, you two can learn more about the body cultivation path from Hong Quan and the others, so your bodies will become stronger in the future."
"Alright, we’ll go to the Moonlit Passion Temple tomorrow." After that, Luo Zhenyu and Luo Jiaxuan went to accompany their two wives.
Meanwhile, Luo Fenghan went with Huang Xiaoyi to another area to discuss some important matters, one of which was the relationship between their five ancestors and Zhang Fei.
In her private room, Mo Zainan sat pensively in front of her dressing table, thinking about Zhang Fei. It had been more than a month since their last meeting, but he had never visited her again.

Mo Zainan was the wife of a demon god, and she knew she shouldn’t be thinking about other men, but she truly missed him, especially because of his gentle treatment of her. Thanks to him, she managed to gather her courage and take over her demon race from her husband, which put her in a dangerous position.
Fortunately, Mo Shentian was away in the Three Mortal Realms, and he wouldn’t be returning any time soon because Feng Yao had already done something to the tunnel he passed through to go there.

Even so, Mo Zainan still couldn’t calm down about the situation because her husband had left his demon mark in her soul, and she was worried that Mo Shentian would find out about her actions. Currently, only Zhang Fei could give her peace and relief, but he had not appeared in front of her again for more than a month, making her miss his presence.

Mo Zainan decided to contact her two daughters and ask them about Zhang Fei’s whereabouts, but she was disappointed after they told her that he had entered seclusion, and no one knew for sure how long he would stay in seclusion.

Mo Zainan let out a disappointed sigh after she spoke with her two daughters, and she stared at her reflection in the mirror with a sad expression. Suddenly, she recalled her husband, Mo Shentian, who had been absent for more than a month. However, she did not know how long it would take for him to pass through the tunnel to reach the Three Mortal Realms, as she had never descended there in her entire life. "I hope my husband won’t come back any time soon, so I can establish my position in our demon race first, and he won’t have anything when he comes back here."
Mo Zainan immediately left her private room and went to the throne room, asking all her subordinates to gather there to discuss something, especially regarding her husband.
While Zhang Fei, his four clones, and all their wives were busy with his seclusion, a week quickly passed in the outside world.

In the Blood Forest underground, Zhang Fei [4] had finished absorbing all the bloodlust from Hu Tianlang’s Bloodlust Soul. "Kid, you’ve absorbed all my bloodlust, so it’s time for you to absorb my soul, and your soul will become even stronger. For now, you can’t do anything because you won’t be able to fight my wrath soul, and you should focus on developing your strength to go to the Ancient Realm. Once you’ve fused with my greed and envy souls, you can go to the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain to fulfill your destiny."

"My destiny, huh?" Zhang Fei [4] muttered. "I never had such a big ambition, but I had to do it for my loved ones. For now, I just want to focus on myself and everyone around me, and I will go to the ancient realm after my cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm. I don’t know how long it will take you to reach that stage because I still have to help all my wives improve their cultivation, so I will be patient for a while."

Hu Tianlang’s Bloodlust Soul nodded to him. "You can take care of everything in the future, and it’s time for me to leave this universe. Once you’ve successfully collected all my souls, you only need to take the hearts of the two heavenly foxes, and the new ten-tailed fox will be reborn in this universe through you."
"Let’s do it."
"Goodbye, kid."
After Zhang Fei [4] released his soul, Hu Tianlang’s Bloodlust Soul immediately entered his soul and began the process of merging their souls.
Zilvora, Ilsath, and Orith hurriedly moved away from Zhang Fei [4] as his bloodlust overflowed and spread throughout the area.
The Slaughter Blood Phantom, who was waiting at the entrance of the place, was also frightened by Zhang Fei [4]’s bloodlust.

Since three months ago, the wandering evil souls did not dare to approach that place at all, and they increasingly stayed away from that area because Zhang Fei [4]’s bloodlust was too terrifying, surpassing that of the Asura Demon God.
[The host’s soul level has increased to the perfection stage of the divine soul level.]

Zhang Fei [4] was surprised by the notification, as he didn’t expect his soul power to break through to that stage after absorbing Hu Tianlang’s Bloodlust Soul. However, the ten-tailed fox was once a primordial being, so it was understandable that its soul power would be so powerful. ’Could it be that my soul power will reach the immortal soul level after I obtain his last three souls?’

Zhang Fei [4] smiled with joy as he thought about it, and he couldn’t wait to obtain Hu Tianlang’s last three souls to find out the results. However, he realized that it wouldn’t be easy for him because his greed and envy souls were in the Ancient Realm, and his wrath soul was still too strong for him.

Zhang Fei [4] turned to his three wives. "I’ll send you guys into the training space first, and you can join one of my clones to dual soul cultivate. I’ll go to the Celestial Moon Domain to search for some people, and I’ll be right back after I find them."
After they agreed, Zhang Fei [4] immediately sent them inside before he walked out of the place. "Did I keep you waiting too long?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1504: The Celestial Moon Domain
paragraphs: The Slaughter Blood Phantom looked at Zhang Fei [4] seriously, but it didn’t dare to approach him like before because of his bloodlust. Although it was born from the fallen asura demons of the past, his bloodlust was too terrifying for it because the ten-tailed fox was a primordial being that had lived for a very long time.

"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed and teleported before the Slaughter Blood Phantom, rubbing its head. "Don’t worry, okay? You’re my friend, and I will never hurt you. However, I’ve already spent too much time here, and I still have many matters elsewhere. I’ll be leaving now, but I’ll come back to visit you in the future."

The Slaughter Blood Phantom was a smart creature, and it could understand Zhang Fei [4]’s situation. It threw him onto its back and carried him away from that place at full speed, causing all the wandering evil souls to scatter around to make way for them.

Shang Luohu, who was enjoying her time, suddenly stood up from her seat. She listened to a message from the Blood Tree, which informed her that the situation in the underground had calmed down. "Is it true that Zhang Fei’s clone is finish? Zhui."
"Yes, Empress." Shang Zhui appeared behind her.
"Zhang Fei is done, and he is on his way out of the underground."
"Do you want to see him, Empress?"
"Let’s go to the Blood Sea now! I’m sure he will come out of there."
"Yes."

Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui had arrived at the edge of the Blood Sea, and Zhang Fei [4] flew out of it a moment later. He frowned when he saw the two of them, but he soon landed in front of them. "It must have been the Blood Tree that told you two about me, right?"

"Yes." Shang Luohu immediately asked him. "Is my daughter with you now? I originally didn’t have any thoughts about it, but my sister-in-law told me about Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha being in your sect. However, I was sure that Mo Shentian would not possibly send his daughters to join a human sect, and I thought the Celestial Demon Race sealed their domain because of you, so I believed that my daughter had been with you for a long time."

"Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha did join my sect, but that doesn’t mean Shang Xueli is there too." Shang Luohu frowned at Zhang Fei [4]. "Moreover, I didn’t restrict Shang Fengxue’s movements, and I gave her freedom like my other guests. She can see all of my sect’s grounds freely, so she should be able to find your daughter if she’s there."

Shang Luohu did not believe Zhang Fei [4], and she was sure that her daughter was in his hands. She considered using harsh methods to force him to tell the truth, but she immediately remembered her relationship with Feng Yao, forcing her to abandon her intention. "Is my daughter really not in your hands?"

"I’ve told you the truth, but if you don’t believe me, you can look for your daughter in my sect by yourself." Zhang Fei [4] stole a glance at Shang Zhui for a moment. "By the way, I still have something important to do, so I have to go now."
"Do you believe his words, Zhui?" Shang Luohu asked this question after Zhang Fei [4] had disappeared.
Shang Zhui shook his head at Shang Luohu. "That kid is unpredictable, so I can’t be sure whether he’s telling the truth or not. Actually, you don’t need to worry about Princess Xueli, Empress."
"Hmm?" Shang Luohu turned to him. "What do you mean by that? Do you know anything about my daughter?"
"I have no information about Princess Xueli, Empress."
"Then?"

"I’ve talked to my son a lot about Zhang Fei." Shang Luohu’s ears perked out, making a smile appear on Shang Zhui’s old face. "My son said that you don’t need to worry about Princess Xueli, Empress. He doesn’t know her whereabouts, but he believes that kid knows something about her, and he also told me that that kid would never harm someone who has no problem with him. Since that kid has shown you her hair and dress, he must already have plans for her. The most important thing now is to wait for my emperor to come out of seclusion, and you can discuss this matter with him. However, I’m not sure that he will agree to that kid’s offer, and he might attack the Celestial Demon Domain and the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"Are you sure my daughter is okay?"
"I don’t dare say for sure, but my son has absolute confidence in that child, and he’s convinced that Princess Xueli is fine."
"How about we go to the Moonlit Passion Temple? I want to make sure that my daughter is indeed not there."

Shang Zhui let out a soft sigh. "My son told me that it won’t be easy for us to enter the Twin Flames Main Domain, Empress. Even Tian Qiye has gone to that domain, but she can’t go to the Moonlit Passion Temple because the domain is now riddled with formations, including flight-restricting formations."
"Eh? Is that true? Who helped Zhang Fei set up all those formations?"

"My son told me about it, so I’m sure it’s not wrong." Shang Luohu nodded to Shang Zhui. "That kid succeeded in persuading the Liao Clan of the Sky Pillar Domain to join his sect, and Liao Hanxue is one of the best array masters in this Paradise Realm, so she helped him set up all those formations. My son also told me that several clans had decided to join them, such as the Zhang, You, and Qiao Clans."

Shang Luohu was truly surprised to hear this revelation because it had been quite a while since he last visited the Twin Flames Main Domain, and he hadn’t been there again since. "It seems Zhang Fei has prepared himself well for the changing situation in this Paradise Realm."
"Yes." Shang Zhui nodded in agreement. "Empress, I understand your concern for Princess Xueli, but I believe she is safe now."
Shang Luohu sighed softly. "I hope you’re right, Zhui. Xueli is my only daughter, and I don’t want anything bad to happen to her."
After that, Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui returned to Asura Castle, but the empress could never find peace, as she was unaware of Shang Xueli’s whereabouts.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Celestial Moon Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]

Zhang Fei [4] wanted to take Jia Xianzu out of his soul world, but he refused his request. Instead, he told him to take Helian Xun’er to the Celestial Moon Domain, especially since she had close ties with several people from that domain.
Zhang Fei [4] opened a portal to the training space, and Helian Xun’er walked out from inside, followed by Tianshi Shengjie. "Do you also have acquaintances in this domain, Shengjie?"

"You want to go to the Moon Tower, right?" Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Tianshi Shengjie. "The guardian of the tower is Yue Liangyu, and I have known her for a long time, so I will accompany you to meet her."
"Alright." Zhang Fei [4] turned to Helian Xun’er. "Who are your acquaintances in the Celestial Moon Sect?"

"Hehe." Helian Xun’er chuckled. "Before I followed my master, I was a disciple of the Celestial Moon Sect. Naturally, I knew many people there, but only a few were truly close to me, like Yue Bingxuan. If you want to go to that sect, you have to disguise yourself as a woman, or they will expel you from this domain."
Zhang Fei [4] raised an eyebrow. "Yuan Tianhua told me that her parents live in this domain, so I’m sure there are other men here, right?"

"Yes." Helian Xun’er nodded at him. "Normally, men are prohibited from entering this domain, and some can get exceptions as long as they are married. However, not all married couples can stay in this domain, and they will be forced to leave if they don’t meet the requirements."
"So, where are we going first?"

"The Moon Tower first." Tianshi Shengjie pointed north. "The tower is in that direction, but you won’t be able to go there in your male form, so you’ll have to disguise yourself as a woman to get there."

Zhang Fei [4] used his transformation technique to transform into a woman, and he looked much more feminine than the other women in that form, making Helian Xun’er and Tianshi Shengie tempted to tease him. "Why are you two looking at me like that?"
"Have you ever used your female form to have fun with all your wives?"

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed at that. "I like watching two women satisfy each other, but I never thought of using my female form to have fun with them. Moreover, they’re not interested in that either, and they’re more interested in my dick."
"Shameless!" Tianshi Shengjie and Helian Xue’er shouted to him.
Zhang Fei [4] grinned at them before grabbing their shoulders, and he immediately took them away to the location of the Moon Tower.

With such a short distance, Zhang Fei [4] and the two women had already arrived at the area of the Moon Tower. Tianshi Shengjie promptly guided them to the back area, the location of the entrance portal.
They saw two women standing guard there, but they were surprised by Tianshi Shengjie’s presence. "Dragon Princess Tianshi?"

However, I’ve already spent too much time here, and I still have many matters elsewhere.
I’ll be leaving now, but I’ll come back to visit you in the future."
The Slaughter Blood Phantom was a smart creature, and it could understand Zhang Fei [4]’s situation.
It threw him onto its back and carried him away from that place at full speed, causing all the wandering evil souls to scatter around to make way for them.
Shang Luohu, who was enjoying her time, suddenly stood up from her seat.
She listened to a message from the Blood Tree, which informed her that the situation in the underground had calmed down.
"Is it true that Zhang Fei’s clone is finish?
Zhui."
"Yes, Empress." Shang Zhui appeared behind her.
"Zhang Fei is done, and he is on his way out of the underground."
"Do you want to see him, Empress?"
"Let’s go to the Blood Sea now!
I’m sure he will come out of there."
"Yes."
Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui had arrived at the edge of the Blood Sea, and Zhang Fei [4] flew out of it a moment later.
He frowned when he saw the two of them, but he soon landed in front of them.
"It must have been the Blood Tree that told you two about me, right?"
"Yes." Shang Luohu immediately asked him.
"Is my daughter with you now?
I originally didn’t have any thoughts about it, but my sister-in-law told me about Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha being in your sect.

However, I was sure that Mo Shentian would not possibly send his daughters to join a human sect, and I thought the Celestial Demon Race sealed their domain because of you, so I believed that my daughter had been with you for a long time."
"Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha did join my sect, but that doesn’t mean Shang Xueli is there too." Shang Luohu frowned at Zhang Fei [4].
"Moreover, I didn’t restrict Shang Fengxue’s movements, and I gave her freedom like my other guests.
She can see all of my sect’s grounds freely, so she should be able to find your daughter if she’s there."
Shang Luohu did not believe Zhang Fei [4], and she was sure that her daughter was in his hands.
She considered using harsh methods to force him to tell the truth, but she immediately remembered her relationship with Feng Yao, forcing her to abandon her intention.
"Is my daughter really not in your hands?"
"I’ve told you the truth, but if you don’t believe me, you can look for your daughter in my sect by yourself." Zhang Fei [4] stole a glance at Shang Zhui for a moment.
"By the way, I still have something important to do, so I have to go now."
"Do you believe his words, Zhui?" Shang Luohu asked this question after Zhang Fei [4] had disappeared.
Shang Zhui shook his head at Shang Luohu.
"That kid is unpredictable, so I can’t be sure whether he’s telling the truth or not.
Actually, you don’t need to worry about Princess Xueli, Empress."
"Hmm?" Shang Luohu turned to him.
"What do you mean by that?
Do you know anything about my daughter?"
"I have no information about Princess Xueli, Empress."
"Then?"
"I’ve talked to my son a lot about Zhang Fei." Shang Luohu’s ears perked out, making a smile appear on Shang Zhui’s old face.
"My son said that you don’t need to worry about Princess Xueli, Empress.
He doesn’t know her whereabouts, but he believes that kid knows something about her, and he also told me that that kid would never harm someone who has no problem with him.
Since that kid has shown you her hair and dress, he must already have plans for her.
The most important thing now is to wait for my emperor to come out of seclusion, and you can discuss this matter with him.
However, I’m not sure that he will agree to that kid’s offer, and he might attack the Celestial Demon Domain and the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"Are you sure my daughter is okay?"
"I don’t dare say for sure, but my son has absolute confidence in that child, and he’s convinced that Princess Xueli is fine."
"How about we go to the Moonlit Passion Temple?
I want to make sure that my daughter is indeed not there."
Shang Zhui let out a soft sigh.
"My son told me that it won’t be easy for us to enter the Twin Flames Main Domain, Empress.
Even Tian Qiye has gone to that domain, but she can’t go to the Moonlit Passion Temple because the domain is now riddled with formations, including flight-restricting formations."
"Eh?
Is that true?
Who helped Zhang Fei set up all those formations?"
"My son told me about it, so I’m sure it’s not wrong." Shang Luohu nodded to Shang Zhui.

"That kid succeeded in persuading the Liao Clan of the Sky Pillar Domain to join his sect, and Liao Hanxue is one of the best array masters in this Paradise Realm, so she helped him set up all those formations.
My son also told me that several clans had decided to join them, such as the Zhang, You, and Qiao Clans."
Shang Luohu was truly surprised to hear this revelation because it had been quite a while since he last visited the Twin Flames Main Domain, and he hadn’t been there again since.
"It seems Zhang Fei has prepared himself well for the changing situation in this Paradise Realm."
"Yes." Shang Zhui nodded in agreement.
"Empress, I understand your concern for Princess Xueli, but I believe she is safe now."
Shang Luohu sighed softly.
"I hope you’re right, Zhui.
Xueli is my only daughter, and I don’t want anything bad to happen to her."
After that, Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui returned to Asura Castle, but the empress could never find peace, as she was unaware of Shang Xueli’s whereabouts.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Celestial Moon Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
Zhang Fei [4] wanted to take Jia Xianzu out of his soul world, but he refused his request.
Instead, he told him to take Helian Xun’er to the Celestial Moon Domain, especially since she had close ties with several people from that domain.
Zhang Fei [4] opened a portal to the training space, and Helian Xun’er walked out from inside, followed by Tianshi Shengjie.
"Do you also have acquaintances in this domain, Shengjie?"
"You want to go to the Moon Tower, right?" Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Tianshi Shengjie.
"The guardian of the tower is Yue Liangyu, and I have known her for a long time, so I will accompany you to meet her."
"Alright." Zhang Fei [4] turned to Helian Xun’er.
"Who are your acquaintances in the Celestial Moon Sect?"
"Hehe." Helian Xun’er chuckled.
"Before I followed my master, I was a disciple of the Celestial Moon Sect.
Naturally, I knew many people there, but only a few were truly close to me, like Yue Bingxuan.
If you want to go to that sect, you have to disguise yourself as a woman, or they will expel you from this domain."
Zhang Fei [4] raised an eyebrow.
"Yuan Tianhua told me that her parents live in this domain, so I’m sure there are other men here, right?"
"Yes." Helian Xun’er nodded at him.
"Normally, men are prohibited from entering this domain, and some can get exceptions as long as they are married.
However, not all married couples can stay in this domain, and they will be forced to leave if they don’t meet the requirements."
"So, where are we going first?"
"The Moon Tower first." Tianshi Shengjie pointed north.
"The tower is in that direction, but you won’t be able to go there in your male form, so you’ll have to disguise yourself as a woman to get there."

Zhang Fei [4] used his transformation technique to transform into a woman, and he looked much more feminine than the other women in that form, making Helian Xun’er and Tianshi Shengie tempted to tease him.
"Why are you two looking at me like that?"
"Have you ever used your female form to have fun with all your wives?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed at that.
"I like watching two women satisfy each other, but I never thought of using my female form to have fun with them.
Moreover, they’re not interested in that either, and they’re more interested in my dick."
"Shameless!" Tianshi Shengjie and Helian Xue’er shouted to him.
Zhang Fei [4] grinned at them before grabbing their shoulders, and he immediately took them away to the location of the Moon Tower.
With such a short distance, Zhang Fei [4] and the two women had already arrived at the area of the Moon Tower.
Tianshi Shengjie promptly guided them to the back area, the location of the entrance portal.
They saw two women standing guard there, but they were surprised by Tianshi Shengjie’s presence.
"Dragon Princess Tianshi?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1505: The Moon Tower
paragraphs: "Do you want to meet Senior Yue Liangyu inside the Moon Tower?"

Tianshi Shengjie nodded at them and pointed to Zhang Fei [4]. "My friend came from the Three Mortal Realms, and some members of his family were challenging the tower when he ascended to this realm. Therefore, I brought him here to meet Yue Liangyu so he could help her reunite with her family members."
They looked at Zhang Fei [4] for a moment before returning their gazes to Tianshi Shengjie. "You can bring your two friends into the portal, Dragon Princess Tianshi."
"Let’s go." Tianshi Shengjie led them into the portal.
After they disappeared, one of the women spoke to her friend. "We should report to Elder Yue Yuling about their arrival."
"Yes." One of the women contacted the female elder named Yue Yuling.
Yue Liangyu, who was cultivating at the top of the Moon Tower, was surprised by the appearance of Tianshi Shengjie, Helian Xun’er, and Zhang Fei [4].

Yue Liangyu knew both women, but she didn’t know Zhang Fei [4], and she sensed something unusual about him. She observed him thoughtfully, but she couldn’t see through his disguise, and he looked like most women in her eyes.
"Long time no see, Liangyu." Tianshi Shengjie spoke.
Helian Xun’er asked her. "Senior Sister Liangyu, how are you?"

"I never thought you would come back here, Xun’er. I thought you were comfortable being Wan Jiang’s disciple, so you forgot about us." Yue Liangyu looked at Tianshi Shengjie. "However, I didn’t expect that you would come with the Princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, which surprised me quite a bit."

"Hey! We are old friends, so you can stop addressing me with my honorific title." Tianshi Shengjie pointed to Zhang Fei [4]. "Actually, we came here to search for some people, and they were supposed to challenge this tower a few months ago based on the flow of time in the Three Mortal Realms."
Yue Liangyu was surprised to hear that. "Who are those people? Which realm do they come from?"
"Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi, and they came from the Sovereign Heaven Realm." Zhang Fei [4] created a qi screen, showing the image of the two people.
"I see." Yue Liangyu nodded in understanding. "They did challenge this tower, and they have reached the third floor. What do you want about them?"

Zhang Fei [4] was not surprised by that; he had personally experienced the challenges in the Star Tower in the past. He knew that all the challenges were complicated, and not all cultivators could complete them as quickly as he did. "Can you bring them here?"

"You know that I can’t do that, right?" Yue Liangyu looked at the qi screen. "Even if they are your acquaintances, they must have made their own efforts to reach this place with their abilities. If they don’t have the ability to reach this place, I will expel them from this tower."
Zhang Fei [4] wanted to speak to Yue Liangyu, but Tianshi Shengjie preceded him. "Can’t you give them an exception? Moreover, you won’t suffer any loss by bringing them here, right?"

"You know I can’t do that, right, Shengjie?" Yue Liangyu refused with a shake of her head. "Rules are rules, and I will always abide by the rules set by the higher-ups. Without rules, this world would be in chaos, and I don’t want that to happen in this tower, especially under my watch. If they want to ascend to this realm, they must pass the trials before them, or they won’t be able to survive the situation here."

Helian Xun’er could only shake her head upon hearing that, and she had already guessed from the start that Yue Liangyu would never allow those people to reach the top of the tower without completing those tests.

Helian Xun’er turned to Zhang Fei [4], who folded his forehead and looked at Yue Liangyu with an unusual gaze. She was already familiar with him, and she knew the plan in his mind, so she immediately took his hand to stop him. ’Don’t do that; it will make you an enemy of the Celestial Moon Sect, and that will only bring us losses. The sect is one of the best sects in this realm, and its status is above those supreme sects such as the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.’
’Hmm?’ Zhang Fei [4] turned to her. ’What should we do now?’
Helian Xun’er let out a soft sigh. ’We have no choice but to challenge this tower from the first floor, and we’ll take those people away after we meet them. But—’
’But what?’
’Are you sure you want to use your abilities in this tower?’

Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her. ’I don’t want to waste time in this tower, and I will use all my abilities to reach them as soon as possible. Moreover, they are on the third floor, so the tests there shouldn’t be that difficult, and I can clear them easily.’

’That’s true.’ Helian Xun’er agreed and gave him another idea. ’How about you contact Long Wuzhao? I’m sure the Golden Dragon Emperor can help you persuade her, and you won’t have to reveal your abilities in this tower.’

’We don’t need to trouble Long Wuzhao over this trivial matter.’ Zhang Fei [4] rejected her idea, and his four clones immediately set off for the Moon Realm in the Three Mortal Realms, which was too easy for them because the system already stored all the realms there.
Tianshi Shengjie turned to Zhang Fei [4]. "What should we do now?"

"What else besides challenging this tower?" Zhang Fei [4] looked at Yue Liangyu. "Since she’s unwilling to help us, I’ll challenge this tower myself. I’m sure it won’t be difficult to reach the third floor, as I’ve already cleared the Star Tower."

Yue Liangyu looked at Zhang Fei [4] with raised eyebrows because she had never heard of any cultivator successfully completing all the challenges in the Star Tower before, but the presence of Helian Xun’er by his side changed her view because she and Jia Xianzu had been responsible for that tower in the past.

"If—" Yue Liangyu didn’t continue her words when she sensed the change in the Tower, and she created a qi screen that showed the situation outside the Moon Tower, where four of Zhang Fei’s clones were already there. "Who are these people? Are they clones?"

Helian Xun’er and Tianshi Shengjie looked at the qi screen with laughter in their hearts. They were confident that Zhang Fei’s four clones could easily complete the challenges in the Moon Tower up to the third floor.

"They are my clones." Yue Liangyu looked at Zhang Fei [4] with a frown. "There’s no prohibition against using clones to challenge this tower, right? In the past, I used my clone to challenge the Star Tower because I didn’t want to waste my time in vain, and my original body had to help the people around me."
Yue Liangyu nodded at him. "Anyone can challenge this tower using any means, including the clone technique. However, clones are still clones, and they don’t have our original strength, so—"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] softly laughed. "Why don’t you watch my clones first?"

"Hmm?" Yue Liangyu was confused by Zhang Fei [4]’s confidence, but she was shocked when she shifted her gaze to the qi screen, especially since his clones scored perfect scores on the initial test. "How is such an outcome possible? How could they score perfect scores?"

Zhang Fei [4]’s lips curled up as Yue Liangyu looked at him again. "We’re not close acquaintances, so I don’t need to explain everything to you, right? Since my clones have passed the initial test, they will enter the tower to undergo all the tests. For now, we just need to wait for the results, and I’m sure they can complete those tests before long. Oh! By the way, I know you can increase the difficulty of each test on each floor, but I advise you not to do that."
"Hmm?" Yue Liangyu looked at Helian Xun’er. "Are you the one who said that?"
Helian Xun’er shook her head. "My master said all that after he reached the top floor of the Star Tower."

"I see." Yue Liangyu saw that Zhang Fei’s four clones had entered the tower, and they began to take on the challenge on the first floor. She changed the display on the Qi screen, showing their activity in the challenge. "I’ve heard about your master, and he chose to leave the tower seven months ago, but I haven’t heard from him since then."

Helian Xun’er smiled at her. "Actually, we’ve already withdrawn from the Emerald Bamboo Sect and joined the Moonlit Passion Temple. However, our former sect masters have decided to maintain good relations with that sect, and the two sects now have a good relationship."

"I see." Yue Liangyu nodded in understanding. "I’ve heard from people from my sect that the Moonlit Passion Sect has undergone a change from a dual cultivation sect to a universal sect, but I didn’t expect that your master would choose to join that sect, especially with his true identity as a fairy."

"Senior Jia Xianzu wasn’t the only one who joined the sect, you know?" Yue Liangyu looked at Tianshi Shengjie, who immediately took out her identity plaque as an elder of the Moonlit Passion Temple. "I and many other races also joined that sect, and that sect is the most universal in this realm because various races gather there."

chapters.title: Chapter 1506: Zhang Fei VS Yue Liangyu
paragraphs: Yue Liangyu furrowed her brows after seeing Tianshi Shengjie’s plaque, not expecting that the dragon princess would join a human sect. She glanced at Zhang Fei [4], who crossed his arms and watched his four clones undergo the challenge on the moon tower. ’Who exactly is this person?’
"Liangyu, do you remember the people from the Sovereign Heaven Realm who ascended to this realm through this tower last time?"

Yue Liangyu nodded at Tianshi Shengjie. "Ruan Xiaoqi and her husband live in the city to the east. Beihuang Fan and Nalan Qingge joined my sect, and their cultivation has now reached the Celestial Lord level. As for the rest of the people, I don’t know their whereabouts because they left my domain after they exited this tower. Are you thinking about bringing them to the Moonlit Passion Temple too?"

"Ruan Xiaoqi’s daughter is in the sect, so she and her husband would be delighted to reunite with her. As for Beihuang Fan and Nalan Qingge, people from both their clans are also there, but we won’t take them away." Tianshi Shengjie’s answer surprised Yue Liangyu. "As for the rest of those people, their families are also in our sect. Since their whereabouts are unclear, we will not waste our time looking for them, and they will probably hear about them from our members who are currently recruiting new disciples."

"If you want to take Ruan Xiaoqi and her husband with you, you can meet them in that city. I don’t know about Beihuang Fan and Nalan Qingge, but my sect won’t stop them from reuniting with their families." Tianshi Shengjie was slightly surprised by Yue Liangyu’s words. "Even though they have joined our sect, their talents are so-so, and they have difficulty developing, so they can leave if they want."

"Haha." Helian Xun’er laughed softly when she heard that. "It seems like you guys never change, huh? Back then, I chose to leave the sect and follow my new master partly due to your unfair treatment of me, particularly because your sect master and elders viewed my talent as only mediocre and difficult to develop."

Yue Liangyu smiled faintly when she heard that. "Wasn’t our decision correct? Tens of thousands of years have passed since you left our sect, but your cultivation still hasn’t reached the Celestial Venerable Realm, proving that our conclusion about your talent is correct."

"Are you that proud of your cultivation at the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm?" Yue Liangyu frowned as she looked at Zhang Fei [4]. "If you think that you are superior to Xun’er because your cultivation has reached that stage, you can try to catch her now. If you can’t do it with your cultivation being higher than hers, that means you are much weaker than her."

Yue Liangyu felt a bit angry because Zhang Fei [4] belittled her by comparing her to Helian Xun’er, despite her being one of the best in the Celestial Moon Sect, and not many members of her sect could reach her level except for the higher-ups.
Zhang Fei [4] smirked faintly. "Would you rather try to chase me?"

Yue Liangyu said nothing, immediately disappeared from her original position, and reappeared behind Zhang Fei [4]. She was shocked when she tried to catch him because her hand went through his body, which was just an illusion. ’How can he avoid me with his low cultivation?’

Tianshi Shengjie and Helian Xun’er only smiled after seeing that because their speed was already faster than Yue Liangyu’s, but they wouldn’t be able to catch Zhang Fei [4] at their current speed, let alone her. ’Heh! Not even Yue Xuelian can catch up to him.’
"Haha."

Yue Liangyu tried to find Zhang Fei’s position based on his laughter, but she couldn’t detect his aura at all, let alone his position. ’How can he hide his aura so neatly? His cultivation is only at the Celestial King Realm, so he shouldn’t be able to hide his aura from me.’
"Your cultivation is indeed far above mine, but you will never be able to find me, let alone capture me."

Yue Liangyu closed her eyes and used her technique to track Zhang Fei [4], dimming the entire area. She concentrated fully on detecting his aura, even though she couldn’t sense it under normal conditions.
Tianshi Shengji turned to Helian Xun’er, who immediately shook her head. ’She’ll never find him.’

’Yeah.’ Tianshi Shengjie nodded slightly as she looked at Yue Liangyu, who was still trying to find Zhang Fei [4] with a frown. ’You underestimate him too much, Liangyu. Even my emperor praises him to the skies, and he’s not even sure he can keep up with his speed, let alone a weak woman like you.’

"Yawn!" Yue Liangyu’s eyes fluttered after hearing that. "How long do you want to try to sense my aura? I’m standing here waiting for you to find me, but you can’t sense my aura with your high cultivation. My cultivation is several stages below yours, so you should be ashamed if you can’t detect my aura."

Yue Liangyu was furious at Zhang Fei [4]’s taunt, and she released her aura to suppress him. However, she was shocked again as a powerful pressure pressed down on her from above, forcing her to kneel on one knee.

Helian Xun’er and Tianshi Shengjie could only shake their heads at this, and Yue Liangyu immediately opened her eyes and looked at Zhang Fei [4], who had already sat down in her place. She tried to fight back against his pressure and exerted all her strength to break free, but her efforts were completely useless.

Zhang Fei [4] looked at Yue Liangyu with disdain. "You previously insulted Xun’er just because her cultivation hasn’t reached the Celestial Venerable Realm, but you’re apparently far weaker than her because you couldn’t break free from my pressure, even though my cultivation is only at the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm. If people knew this, they would ridicule and belittle you."
Yue Liangyu wanted to say something, but Zhang Fei [4] activated his sword domain with thousands of swords aimed at her, which further shocked her. "A god-rank swordmaster."

"You should never underestimate others if you’re weak." Zhang Fei [4] moved his finger, and the thousands of swords moved closer to Yue Liangyu, causing her to break out in a cold sweat. "There’s another sky above the sky; there are many cultivators far better than you, including me. Fortunately, I do not wish to have any conflict with your sect; otherwise, I would have killed you for insulting Xun’er."
"That’s enough." Tianshi Shengjie finally spoke. "Retract your sword domain and release Yue Liangyu."

"I will spare you this time, but I will not spare you again if you dare insult Xun’er one more time." After he canceled his sword domain and pulled back his pressure, Zhang Fei [4] immediately moved to Helian Xun’er’s side and hugged her waist, leading her out of that place. "I won’t let anyone insult you, Xun’er."
Helian Xun’er smiled at that. "I trust you; otherwise, I wouldn’t stay by your side."
Tianshi Shengjie shook her head slightly before helping the trembling Yue Liangyu to her feet. "You made a fatal mistake by insulting Helian Xun’er."
"Who is that woman really? How can she suppress me with her low cultivation?" Yue Liangyu asked with a trembling voice.

"Actually, he is a man, and his name is Zhang Fei. Helian Xun’er is one of his women, so he won’t allow you to insult her." Yue Liangyu looked at Tianshi Shengjie in shock. "I asked him to disguise himself as a woman so as not to cause trouble here, and we will leave immediately after we pick up those four people. Qing Qiu’er was the sect master of the Moonlit Passion Sect, but he was the one who brought significant changes to the sect. Jia Xianzu joined us because of him, and my emperor also respected him very much."

Yue Liangyu suddenly remembered something. "So, he’s the man Yuan Tianling asked about in the past, huh? Back then, she asked me to ask Jia Xianzu about her male friend who challenged the Star Tower, but she didn’t tell me his name."

"Yes." Tianshi Shengjie nodded at her. "Yuan Tianling is also his wife, and they knew each other in a realm within the Three Mortal Realms. Actually, I also knew him in one of the realms there, specifically in the lower realm, and he had just begun his cultivation at that time."
"Hmm?" Yue Liangyu was really surprised to hear that. "What are you doing in the Three Mortal Realms?"

"Haha." Tianshi Shengjie laughed softly. "I was bored with the situation in this Paradise Realm, so I sent several of my avatars to the Three Mortal Realms to scout for new talents, and one of them met Zhang Fei in the Sky Jade Realm. Since then, I’ve been monitoring him, including when he challenged the Star Tower."
"Don’t tell me you’re also interested in that man."
Tianshi Shengjie smiled at her. "Zhang Fei is my future husband, and my father has already agreed to our relationship. However, we’re not married yet, and I’ll wait until he wins my heart."

"Sigh." Yue Liangyu let out a soft sigh. "I’ve met many powerful cultivators, but I’ve never felt such fear. How can he possess such great power with his cultivation still at the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm?"
"I won’t tell you anything about him, but I can tell you not to mess with him, or you’ll regret it."

chapters.title: Chapter 1507: Yue Yuling
paragraphs: Yue Liangyu looked at Tianshi Shengjie without saying anything, but she already knew that Zhang Fei [4] was a terrifying man because he could suppress her with just his cultivation at the Celestial King Realm, and she didn’t dare to imagine that his cultivation was already on par with hers.
Yue Liangyu shifted her gaze to the qi screen, and she saw that Zhang Fei’s four clones had already cleared the first floor to go to the second floor. "Those challenges are useless to him."

"Haha." Tianshi Shengjie softly laughed. "Those challenges were almost no different from the ones at the Star Tower, and he had already completed all the challenges there. Moreover, his cultivation had only broken through to the Earth Realm when he first challenged the tower, and he had already reached the Celestial King Realm now, so it was natural that those challenges were useless for him."
Yue Liangyu nodded and looked at her. "How can he return to the Three Mortal Realms if he has already ascended to the Paradise Realm? When did he ascend to this realm?"

"He has ascended to this realm for almost three decades." Yue Liangyu raised an eyebrow after Tianshi Shengjie said that, as she recalled that not much time had passed in the Paradise Realm since her last meeting with Tian Yueling, during which Zhang Fei was challenging the Star Tower. "I can’t reveal the exact details, but he ascended to this realm around that time. He is the only cultivator who can move between realms freely, including between the Three Mortal Realms and the Paradise Realm, which is due to his ability as a heavenly fox."
"A heavenly fox? Why have I never heard of that fox race before?"

Tianshi Shengjie let out a soft sigh and looked at her. "You were born and raised in the Paradise Realm, and you have never left this realm in your entire life. The heavenly fox race only exists in the Three Mortal Realms, and they can move between realms easily, but only if they have visited that realm before."
"As far as I remember, Zhang Fei never went to this realm in the past."

"Is that so?" Tianshi Sengjie gave a faint smile. "Have you ever checked the outer area of the Moon Tower? You never did, right? How can you be certain he never went to that realm before? He had explored all the realms in the Three Mortal Realms before, thanks to his clones; otherwise, it would have taken him years, especially with his cultivation being in the Ten Mortal Realms at that time. By the way, you shouldn’t talk about him to anyone, including Yue Xuelian. You guys are strong, but the people by his side are much stronger than them."
"Who are the people you mean?"

"Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, and several clans from the Sky Pillar Domain." Yue Liangyu naturally knew about those people, but she never expected that they would join forces with Zhang Fei and the Moonlit Passion Sect. "Apart from them, he has close ties with the fairy race and all the beast races, including my emperor. The most important thing is that he is Empress Huo Yanling’s future husband."
"What?" Yue Liangyu screamed in shock after hearing that. "How—"

Tianshi Shengjie immediately created a qi screen, showing Zhang Fei and Feng Yao together. "That woman is the reincarnation of Empress Huo, and her parents have acknowledged him as their son-in-law and approved of their marriage."

Yue Liangyu was at a loss for words after hearing that, and she looked at the Qi screen created by Tianshi Shengji again, observing the closeness between Zhang Fei and Feng Yao. She found it difficult to believe, but the evidence was right before her eyes, and she was certain that their relationship was real.

"Zhang Fei is a complex person; he can be both easygoing and difficult, and he will never hesitate to commit terrible acts if people dare to speak negatively about all his women." Tianshi Shengjie removed the qi screen. "He doesn’t like to cause trouble with other cultivators, and he wants to build peace among all races. However, he will become everyone’s nightmare, particularly those who harbor negative thoughts about all his wives."
*Tap... Tap... Tap...*
Tianshi Shengjie and Yue Liangyu turned to the woman who had just arrived in the room. "Long time no see, Elder Yue Yuling."
"Elder Yuling." Yue Liangyu bowed slightly.

Yue Yueling has a delicate face with snow-white skin, and her eyes were not fearful and deeply unyielding, combined with sharp eyebrows, large eyes, and a small mouth that was as red as a cherry. Her black hair is long and straight, falling smoothly down her back and over her shoulders. Her figure is soft, curvy, and feminine. She has a full chest, a gently defined waist, and smooth hips. Her body looks curvaceous in a pink dress made of light fabric, showing off her elegant and naturally sensual figure.
Yue Yuling nodded at them. "I didn’t expect you to visit our domain, Princess Tianshi. I heard you came with two women, but I didn’t see them here."
"They are looking at the view outside the tower from that place." Tianshi Shengjie pointed outside.

"Hmm?" Yue Yuling looked outside, finding Zhang Fei [4] and Helian Xun’er standing there. "Xun’er, huh? I haven’t seen her for a long time since she resigned from this sect and joined the Emerald Bamboo Sect, but her cultivation hasn’t made much progress since then."

Tianshi Shengjie glanced at Yue Liangyu, signaling her to avoid mentioning anything about Zhang Fei [4] in front of Yue Yuling. "Xun’er’s progress is indeed slow because not everyone has extraordinary talents like those in your sect, but she has changed a lot in the past few years."

"I’m happy that she has grown as a cultivator now." Yue Yuling returned the pandanus to Tianshi Shengjie. "What brings you here today, Princess Tianshi? Why did you go to this tower but not our sect?"
"Haha." Tianshi Shengjie laughed softly. "Elder Yuling, I came here because I want to pick up some people who challenged this tower, and I will take them to the Moonlit Passion Temple."

"Oh?" Yue Yuling was a little surprised. "I heard that the sect has undergone many changes, and it’s no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal one. Their elders also often travel to other domains to recruit new disciples, but their image as a dual cultivation sect made it difficult for them to gain new disciples. By the way, what are you doing in that sect? Why are you helping them?"

"Here." Yue Yuling was shocked when Tianshi Shengjie showed her the elder plaque. "As you can see, I am one of the guest elders at the Moonlit Passion Temple. The sect has changed a lot, and there are still several guest elders from various races and clans."
"Please elaborate to me, Princess Tianshi."
Tianshi Shengji instantly created several qi screens, allowing Yue Yuling to see with her own eyes all the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Yue Yuling said nothing, and she focused on observing all the changes occurring within the sect. She was quite surprised to see so many halls there, especially under the mountain. She was even more surprised to see some familiar faces, and she didn’t expect that they would decide to join the sect, especially since some of them never wanted to have ties to any sect.

Yue Yuling was even more shocked when she saw members from the natural races, beast races, demihuman races, and demon races there. After all, the natural and demihuman races usually lived in their realms, and the beast races lived in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, under the leadership of Long Wuzhao.

"Why does the Moonlit Passion Temple recruit people from the demon races, Princess Tianshi?" Yue Yuling asked as she observed those demons. "They are demons from the Celestial Demon Race, the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, the Eternal Night Race, the Eternal Night, and several demons from other races."

"Elder Yuling, you know that not all members of the demon race are evil, right? In fact, many humans are far more evil than demons, and they also commit far more horrific acts." Yue Yuling didn’t say anything to refute Tianshi Shengjie, but she didn’t agree with her opinion of them either. "We want the Moonlit Passion Temple to be a paradise for all races so they can live safely and comfortably together in one place."
"What if they rebel and wreak havoc in the sect?"

"We will get rid of them." Yue Yuling and Yue Liangyu looked at Tianshi Shengjie. "We will accept all races to join our sect, but we will never tolerate actions that could disrupt the balance within it. Whether they are humans, demons, beasts, or demihumans, we will immediately eliminate them if they show any signs of ill will. Thus, they should think twice about causing trouble in our sect, especially since our leader will never show mercy to anyone with ill intentions."

"Hmm?" Yue Yuling was astonished. "Does Qing Qiu’er really have the guts to challenge all races? If she kill those people, members of their races will definitely move to attack your sect, and you guys will face big trouble because of it."

Tianshi Shengjie smiled at her. "Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling are still our leaders, but we have someone who stands above them. That person brought about significant changes in our sect, including the unification of all races within our sect."

"Please elaborate to me, Princess Tianshi."
Tianshi Shengji instantly created several qi screens, allowing Yue Yuling to see with her own eyes all the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Yue Yuling said nothing, and she focused on observing all the changes occurring within the sect.
She was quite surprised to see so many halls there, especially under the mountain.
She was even more surprised to see some familiar faces, and she didn’t expect that they would decide to join the sect, especially since some of them never wanted to have ties to any sect.
Yue Yuling was even more shocked when she saw members from the natural races, beast races, demihuman races, and demon races there.
After all, the natural and demihuman races usually lived in their realms, and the beast races lived in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, under the leadership of Long Wuzhao.
"Why does the Moonlit Passion Temple recruit people from the demon races, Princess Tianshi?" Yue Yuling asked as she observed those demons.
"They are demons from the Celestial Demon Race, the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, the Eternal Night Race, the Eternal Night, and several demons from other races."
"Elder Yuling, you know that not all members of the demon race are evil, right?

In fact, many humans are far more evil than demons, and they also commit far more horrific acts." Yue Yuling didn’t say anything to refute Tianshi Shengjie, but she didn’t agree with her opinion of them either.
"We want the Moonlit Passion Temple to be a paradise for all races so they can live safely and comfortably together in one place."
"What if they rebel and wreak havoc in the sect?"
"We will get rid of them." Yue Yuling and Yue Liangyu looked at Tianshi Shengjie.
"We will accept all races to join our sect, but we will never tolerate actions that could disrupt the balance within it.
Whether they are humans, demons, beasts, or demihumans, we will immediately eliminate them if they show any signs of ill will.
Thus, they should think twice about causing trouble in our sect, especially since our leader will never show mercy to anyone with ill intentions."
"Hmm?" Yue Yuling was astonished.
"Does Qing Qiu’er really have the guts to challenge all races?
If she kill those people, members of their races will definitely move to attack your sect, and you guys will face big trouble because of it."
Tianshi Shengjie smiled at her.
"Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling are still our leaders, but we have someone who stands above them.
That person brought about significant changes in our sect, including the unification of all races within our sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 1508: Zhang Fei - Yue Yuling
paragraphs: Yue Yuling was completely shocked to hear that there was someone else standing above Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling, but she knew that the two women would never be able to bring change to the Moonlit Passion Temple. If they had the ability to bring change to the sect, they would have done it years ago without having to wait for someone to come to their aid. "What’s that person’s name?"
"Zhang Fei."
Yue Liangyu felt confused because Tianshi Shengjie had previously forbidden her from telling Yue Yuling about him, yet she had informed the female elder herself.
’I mean, you don’t need to tell her that he is here and disguised as a woman because that will only cause him problems.’
Yue Liangyu nodded in understanding, and she chose not to say anything to Yue Yuling, leaving everything to Tianshi Shengjie.
"Zhang Fei?" Yue Yuling tried searching in her memories about him, but she was sure that she had never heard his name. "What is his status in the Moonlit Passion Temple?"

Tianshi Shengjie smiled at her. "Do you still need to ask that, Elder Yuling? Zhang Fei is the husband of Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling, and he is the true leader of our sect. However, he rarely appears in public, and he is more often in seclusion with them."

"I see." Yue Yuling nodded in understanding. "I don’t care about Zhang Fei, and I’m just curious about him. I don’t know how he managed to get Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling, but the changes he brought to the Moonlit Passion Temple are a good thing, so the number of dual cultivation sects in this realm has decreased by one. I hope that all dual cultivators will disappear completely from this realm because too many of them have evil natures, and they force others to become like them."

"Hehe." Tianshi Shengji chuckled. "Even though many dual cultivators have evil natures, non-dual cultivators are much worse than them, mainly because their numbers are greater; for example, Hun Lingwu."
"Hun Lingwu?" Yue Liangyu and Yue Yuling were shocked to hear the name. "What has that old man done?"

"He kidnapped several women and used them as cultivation furnaces." Yue Liangyu and Yue Yuling found it hard to believe because Hun Lingwu had a good reputation in the Paradise Realm, but they were sure Tianshi Shengjie wouldn’t slander him without proof. "I’ll show you two."

Tianshi Shengjie created a qi screen and displayed memories of when Zhang Fei and Feng Yao infiltrated the Immortal Soul Palace. Yue Liangyu and Yue Yuling raised their eyebrows when they saw Hun Lingwu doing such a thing to a woman, but they quickly averted their gazes because the old man was naked.

Tianshi Shengjie directly removed the qi screen and spoke to them. "People in the Paradise Realm always ostracize dual cultivators, even though not all of them are evil. In reality, many ordinary cultivators are more evil than them, and Hun Lingwu is one of them. That old man kidnapped Jun Qingling when she was young, and he used her body as a cultivation furnace for years. If he hadn’t caused trouble with us, we would never have discovered his depraved actions against so many women."
"Trouble?"

Tianshi Shengjie nodded at them. "Hun Lingwu visited our sect about a month ago, and he used cunning methods to influence several women in our sect, just like what he did to other women in the past, including Jun Qingling. Unfortunately, he targeted the wrong targets, and he had to bear the consequences for his actions against them."
"What did you guys do to Hun Lingwu?"
"Nothing serious." Tianshi Shengjie replied with a shake of her head. "Someone helped us to erase Hun Lingwu’s memories and destroy his backup memories, so he can’t remember many things now."
"Who?"
"Feng Yao, also known as Empress Huo."

Yue Yuling was stunned for a moment upon hearing that, but she had already heard Feng Yao announce that the Moonlit Passion Sect was under her protection, so she felt it was natural for her to help the sect do something about Hun Lingwu.
"Why didn’t Empress Huo kill that lecherous old man?"

"Empress Huo has other plans for Hun Lingwu, so she can’t kill him now." Tianshi Shengjie then warned them. "You two must warn your sect members about that old man, and they must flee immediately if they encounter him on the road."
*Tap... Tap..."
Yue Yuling turned to Zhang Fei [4] and Helian Xun’er, who had just returned, but she couldn’t recognize his disguise like Yue Liangyu. "I didn’t expect that you would come back here, Xun’er."
"Elder Yuling, I haven’t seen you for a long time." Helian Xun’er greeted the female elder by cupping her hands together.

"I’m glad that you’re healthy, Xun’er. Although your cultivation hasn’t progressed much compared to the last time we met, I can feel that your aura has become stronger than last time." Yue Yuling looked at Zhang Fei [4]. "Is this woman also a member of the Moonlit Passion Temple like you and Princess Tianshi? Even though her cultivation is still at the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm, I can feel that her aura is much stronger than the two of you."
Helian Xun’er nodded at her. "Her name is Feltia, and she is one of the elders of the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"Feltia? I have never heard such a name in this Paradise Realm before."
"I’m not a native of this realm, Elder." Yue Yuling was surprised to hear that from Zhang Fei [4]. "I am a native of the Three Mortal Realms, and I ascended to this realm about two decades ago."

Yue Yuling nodded at Zhang Fei [4]. "You are still so young, yet your cultivation has already reached this stage. Many women in our sect are older than you, but none of them could reach this stage at your age, and I reached that stage when I was a thousand years old."

"You are too modest, Elder." Zhang Fei [4] glanced at Yue Liangyu, who immediately turned her face to the side. "Even though my cultivation has reached this stage, I am not satisfied with my achievements, and I want to pursue a higher stage as quickly as possible."

Yue Yuling nodded at him. "As cultivators, we must never be satisfied with our achievements because cultivation has no limits, and many new things await us. If you find satisfaction in your achievements, you won’t be able to progress, and you’ll remain stuck at this stage. Unfortunately, you have already joined the Moonlit Passion Temple, so I can’t recruit you to my sect."
’Tch! He is Zhang Fei, Elder Yuling! If you recruit him into our sect, our sect’s name will be tarnished because of his presence.’ Yue Liangyu grumbled in her heart.

"Thank you for your advice, Elder." Zhang Fei [4] glanced at Yue Liangyu again before continuing. "I’m already comfortable with the situation at the Moonlit Passion Temple because it has taken me in since I first ascended to this realm, so I would never consider joining another sect. Moreover, our sects have completely changed now, and we are no longer a dual cultivation sect, so I hope our two sects can maintain a good relationship in the future."

"As long as your sect is not a dual cultivation sect, our sect has no problem establishing good relations with you guys." Yue Yuling then diverted their conversation. "Princess Tianshi previously said that the three of you went to this tower to pick up some people from the Three Mortal Realms, and I think they are your friends, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her. "They already went to this tower when I ascended to this realm, and many of their families are in our sect now. Therefore, we came here to pick them up, and we will take them to our sect. Additionally, we want to pick up some of the people who ascended to this realm before us so we can gather together again like in the past."
"Who are those people?"

"Ruan Xiaoqi and her husband. Besides the two of them, there are two others who joined your sect, Elder. Originally, I didn’t plan to bring them with us, but your disciple said that their talents are so-so, and they have difficulty developing in your sect, so I thought of bringing them with us."
Yue Yuling turned to Yue Liangyu, who immediately nodded to her. "Who are those people?"

"Beihuang Fan and Nalan Qingge." Yue Yuling remembered those two women, and she also thought that their talents were so-so. "If they have difficulty developing in this sect, I’ll take them with us so they won’t be a burden to you. Moreover, their families are in my sect, so they can be together again."
"I’ll have someone bring the four of them here." Yue Yuling readily agreed and contacted someone to bring the four of them into the tower. "So, who are your acquaintances challenging this tower?"
"You don’t need to do anything about them, Elder." Yue Yuling and Yue Liangyu were shocked when Zhang Fei [4] opened a portal, and several people walked out from it.
’Since when has he reached the third floor? How did he get there so quickly? What kind of portal is that? How can he open one in the tower?’ Yue Liangyu wondered in her heart.
Yue Yuling was also shocked to see the portal, but she didn’t ask about it. "Are they your acquaintances from the Three Mortal Realms?"
