chapters.title: Chapter 1509: Bring People Back
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [4] informed her. "The two in front are husband and wife, Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi. Behind them are the people from the Tian and Shangguan Clans, who left with them here several months ago based on the time flow in the Three Mortal Realms."

Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi were still shocked to see Zhang Fei [4], especially since his cultivation had far surpassed theirs, coupled with his advanced bone age. Moreover, he hadn’t provided them with a detailed explanation of the Paradise Realm, so they were still unaware of the differences in time flow between the two realms.

"I see." Yue Yuling nodded. "Normally, we wouldn’t allow those who haven’t reached the top of the tower to ascend to our realm, but since they are your closest relatives, I will allow them to enter our realm. However, you will be responsible for them, including all actions in our realm."

"Elder, you don’t need to worry about that, and I dare to guarantee that they will not bring trouble to this realm either today or in the future." Zhang Fei [4] looked at Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi. "I will bring you guys back to my sect after Ruan Xiaoqi and the others arrive here."
"Alright." Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi still had many questions for Zhang Fei [4], but they knew the time was not right to ask them due to the presence of Yue Yuling and Yue Liangyu.

Yue Liangyu secretly inspected the lower floors, especially the third floor. However, she could no longer find Zhang Fei’s four clones there because they returned to the training space after sending Shangguan Lizhi and the others to the top floor.

Yue Liangyu stole a glance at Zhang Fei [4], who responded to her with a faint smile. ’Tch! Who exactly is this man? How can he have such clone techniques? Moreover, Tianshi Shengjie said that he is a heavenly fox, but I can’t sense his beast aura.’

A while later, a woman brought Ruan Xiaoqi, her husband, Beihuang Fan, and Nalan Qingge to the top of the tower. The four of them could not recognize Zhang Fei [4] because he was disguised as a woman, but they certainly recognized Tian Junfeng, Shangguan Lizhi, and the people of the two clans.

"Aunt Xiaoqi, Yuan Tianhua misses you two, and she lives in my sect. That’s why I came here to pick you two up, and you can reunite with her later." Ruan Xiaoqi and her husband immediately recognized the woman in front of them as Zhang Fei [4], and she asked the other two. "What about your decision? Do you want to leave this sect and join my sect? Members of both your clans are there, and you two can reunite with them, but the decision is yours."

Beihuang Fan and Nalan Qingge exchanged glances as they nodded. They then looked at Yue Yuling and returned their disciple badges to her. "Elder Yuling, the sect has helped us a lot since we ascended to this realm, but we are aware of our limited capabilities."

"We’ve been working hard for the past few years, but our progress has been too slow." Nalan Qingge glanced at Zhang Fei [4] before continuing. "Since both of our clan members are in another sect, we decided to join them."

"You two have difficulty progressing in our sect because our cultivation methods don’t suit you." Yue Yuling accepted the badges. "I will accept your resignation, and I hope you will find better opportunities in the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"Thank you, Elder Yuling." Yue Yuling only nodded to Beihuang Fan and Nalan Qingge.
Zhang Fei [4] immediately spoke to the two women. "Elder and Senior, since our business in this tower is finished, we will leave now, and I will take them back to my sect."
"Alright."
After they said goodbye to Yue Yuling and Yue Liangyu, Zhang Fei [4] led them all to leave the Moon Tower.
"Was there anything else they said to you before, Liangyu?"
"Elder, Feltia isn’t a human but a fox beast."
"A fox beast?" Yue Yuling was surprised by that because she couldn’t sense Zhang Fei’s beast aura either.

Yue Liangyu nodded at her. "Feltia is a heavenly fox beast, but I’ve never heard of that race before. According to Princess Tianshi, the fox race only exists in the Three Mortal Realms, but their population is not large."

"A heavenly fox, huh?" Yue Yuling searched her memories for information about the fox race, but she had never seen or encountered a beast of that race before. "I’ve never heard of that fox race either, but Feltia is definitely unusual. I can’t sense her beast aura even though she’s standing in front of me, and her aura is no different from ours. Moreover, she’s not yet fifty years old, but her cultivation has already reached the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm, which was unheard of before. Unfortunately, she’s already joined the Moonlit Passion Temple, and she seems loyal to them, so we can’t persuade her to join our sect."

’Elder! Feltia and Zhang Fei are the same person!’ Yue Liangyu screamed in his heart. "Do you have plans to check out the Moonlit Passion Temple yourself, Elder? The sect has changed now, and they managed to recruit famous cultivators like Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, and several clans from the Sky Pillar Domain."

"Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng are joining them, huh?" Yue Yuling muttered to herself. "I’m sure Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling won’t be able to persuade those three men to join their sect, so I’m sure Zhang Fei persuaded those three to join the sect."
Yue Liangyu nodded at her. "Actually, Zhang Fei’s identity is truly extraordinary, Elder."
"What is it?"

"Princess Tianshi told me that Zhang Fei is Empress Huo’s future husband, and her parents have agreed to their relationship." Yue Yuling looked at Yue Liangyu in shock. "At first, I didn’t believe it either, but she showed all the evidence of their closeness, so I was sure that they had a special relationship."

Yue Yuling nodded in understanding. "I had heard about Empress Huo’s decision to protect the Moonlit Passion Temple, but I didn’t expect that she had such a relationship with Zhang Fei. Who exactly is that young man? How did he convince her to accept him? How did he bring about so much change in the sect?"

’You met Zhang Fei just now, Elder.’ Yue Liangyu spoke to her again. "Moreover, that man was the first to complete the challenge at the Star Tower, and Jia Xianzu has already decided to join the sect, along with people from the Emerald Bamboo Sect."

"I heard about Jia Xianzu relinquishing his job at the Star Tower, but I didn’t expect him to join the Moonlit Passion Temple. Since Helian Xun’er is his disciple, it’s natural that she would join the sect as well." Yue Yuling then contacted Lan Yueru to confirm the news about the Emerald Bamboo Sect. "I’ll return to our sect now, and I’ll discuss this matter with our sect master and the others."

"Alright." After Yue Yuling left, Yue Liangyu sat down again and sighed heavily. "Tch! How can that man suppress me so much? My cultivation is much higher than his, so he shouldn’t be able to suppress me like that. However, the opposite happened because he was able to suppress me so strongly, and I couldn’t break free from his pressure."
Yue Liangyu sighed softly and closed her eyes to continue her cultivation, but her previous defeat to Zhang Fei made her depressed.
"Father! Mother!" Yuan Tianhua screamed as she ran to hug her parents. "I missed you both so much! Luckily, you’re both fine, and we can be together again now."
Ruan Xiaoqi hugged her daughter back. "It’s been a long time since we saw each other, but I didn’t expect that cultivation would already be on par with us now, Tianhua."
"Haha." Yuan Tianhua giggled as she released her parents from her embrace. "A lot has happened since you two ascended to this realm, and I’ve been cultivating diligently ever since."
"I see." Ruan Xiaoqi turned to Yuan Tianling’s parents, Yuan Tianquan and Ren Ziwei. "I’m glad to see you two again, Brother Tianquan and Sister Ziwei."
Ren Ziwei smiled at her. "I’m glad to see you again too, Xiaoqi. We’ve been apart for a long time, so we have a lot to talk about."
"Yes." Ruan Xiaoqi asked her. "Where is your daughter? Why isn’t she here?"

"Oh! Tianling has become Zhang Fei’s wife, and she has entered seclusion with him. She won’t be coming out anytime soon, so you’ll have to wait a long time to meet her." Ren Ziwei then pulled Ruan Xiaoqi and Yuan Tianhua away with him. "Let’s talk somewhere else."
Meanwhile, Yuan Tianquan went with Yuan Tianhua’s father and explained many things to him, especially about the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Meanwhile, Beihuang Fan and Nalan Qingge immediately went to meet their Beihuang and Nalan Clan members, especially since they had been separated from them for so long.
On the other hand, Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi went to the Shangguan Clan’s residence, especially since Zhang Fei hadn’t brought the Tian Clan members to the Paradise Realm.
"Ancestors! I’m glad you have arrived in this realm now." Shangguan Han spoke to both Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi.
Shangguan Miyuan hugged them for a moment. "We’ll be together again from now on, Ancestors."
"Yeah." Shangguan Lizhi nodded at her. "Where’s Shangguan Yan?"

However, you will be responsible for them, including all actions in our realm."

"Elder, you don’t need to worry about that, and I dare to guarantee that they will not bring trouble to this realm either today or in the future." Zhang Fei [4] looked at Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi.
"I will bring you guys back to my sect after Ruan Xiaoqi and the others arrive here."
"Alright." Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi still had many questions for Zhang Fei [4], but they knew the time was not right to ask them due to the presence of Yue Yuling and Yue Liangyu.
Yue Liangyu secretly inspected the lower floors, especially the third floor.
However, she could no longer find Zhang Fei’s four clones there because they returned to the training space after sending Shangguan Lizhi and the others to the top floor.
Yue Liangyu stole a glance at Zhang Fei [4], who responded to her with a faint smile. ’Tch!
Who exactly is this man?
How can he have such clone techniques?
Moreover, Tianshi Shengjie said that he is a heavenly fox, but I can’t sense his beast aura.’
A while later, a woman brought Ruan Xiaoqi, her husband, Beihuang Fan, and Nalan Qingge to the top of the tower.
The four of them could not recognize Zhang Fei [4] because he was disguised as a woman, but they certainly recognized Tian Junfeng, Shangguan Lizhi, and the people of the two clans.
"Aunt Xiaoqi, Yuan Tianhua misses you two, and she lives in my sect.

That’s why I came here to pick you two up, and you can reunite with her later." Ruan Xiaoqi and her husband immediately recognized the woman in front of them as Zhang Fei [4], and she asked the other two.
"What about your decision?
Do you want to leave this sect and join my sect?
Members of both your clans are there, and you two can reunite with them, but the decision is yours."
Beihuang Fan and Nalan Qingge exchanged glances as they nodded.
They then looked at Yue Yuling and returned their disciple badges to her.
"Elder Yuling, the sect has helped us a lot since we ascended to this realm, but we are aware of our limited capabilities."
"We’ve been working hard for the past few years, but our progress has been too slow." Nalan Qingge glanced at Zhang Fei [4] before continuing.
"Since both of our clan members are in another sect, we decided to join them."
"You two have difficulty progressing in our sect because our cultivation methods don’t suit you." Yue Yuling accepted the badges.
"I will accept your resignation, and I hope you will find better opportunities in the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"Thank you, Elder Yuling." Yue Yuling only nodded to Beihuang Fan and Nalan Qingge.
Zhang Fei [4] immediately spoke to the two women.
"Elder and Senior, since our business in this tower is finished, we will leave now, and I will take them back to my sect."
"Alright."
After they said goodbye to Yue Yuling and Yue Liangyu, Zhang Fei [4] led them all to leave the Moon Tower.
"Was there anything else they said to you before, Liangyu?"
"Elder, Feltia isn’t a human but a fox beast."
"A fox beast?" Yue Yuling was surprised by that because she couldn’t sense Zhang Fei’s beast aura either.
Yue Liangyu nodded at her.
"Feltia is a heavenly fox beast, but I’ve never heard of that race before.
According to Princess Tianshi, the fox race only exists in the Three Mortal Realms, but their population is not large."
"A heavenly fox, huh?" Yue Yuling searched her memories for information about the fox race, but she had never seen or encountered a beast of that race before.
"I’ve never heard of that fox race either, but Feltia is definitely unusual.
I can’t sense her beast aura even though she’s standing in front of me, and her aura is no different from ours.
Moreover, she’s not yet fifty years old, but her cultivation has already reached the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm, which was unheard of before.
Unfortunately, she’s already joined the Moonlit Passion Temple, and she seems loyal to them, so we can’t persuade her to join our sect."
’Elder!
Feltia and Zhang Fei are the same person!’ Yue Liangyu screamed in his heart.
"Do you have plans to check out the Moonlit Passion Temple yourself, Elder?
The sect has changed now, and they managed to recruit famous cultivators like Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, and several clans from the Sky Pillar Domain."
"Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng are joining them, huh?" Yue Yuling muttered to herself.
"I’m sure Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling won’t be able to persuade those three men to join their sect, so I’m sure Zhang Fei persuaded those three to join the sect."
Yue Liangyu nodded at her.
"Actually, Zhang Fei’s identity is truly extraordinary, Elder."
"What is it?"
"Princess Tianshi told me that Zhang Fei is Empress Huo’s future husband, and her parents have agreed to their relationship." Yue Yuling looked at Yue Liangyu in shock.
"At first, I didn’t believe it either, but she showed all the evidence of their closeness, so I was sure that they had a special relationship."
Yue Yuling nodded in understanding.
"I had heard about Empress Huo’s decision to protect the Moonlit Passion Temple, but I didn’t expect that she had such a relationship with Zhang Fei.
Who exactly is that young man?
How did he convince her to accept him?
How did he bring about so much change in the sect?"
’You met Zhang Fei just now, Elder.’ Yue Liangyu spoke to her again.
"Moreover, that man was the first to complete the challenge at the Star Tower, and Jia Xianzu has already decided to join the sect, along with people from the Emerald Bamboo Sect."
"I heard about Jia Xianzu relinquishing his job at the Star Tower, but I didn’t expect him to join the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Since Helian Xun’er is his disciple, it’s natural that she would join the sect as well." Yue Yuling then contacted Lan Yueru to confirm the news about the Emerald Bamboo Sect.
"I’ll return to our sect now, and I’ll discuss this matter with our sect master and the others."
"Alright." After Yue Yuling left, Yue Liangyu sat down again and sighed heavily.
"Tch!
How can that man suppress me so much?
My cultivation is much higher than his, so he shouldn’t be able to suppress me like that.
However, the opposite happened because he was able to suppress me so strongly, and I couldn’t break free from his pressure."
Yue Liangyu sighed softly and closed her eyes to continue her cultivation, but her previous defeat to Zhang Fei made her depressed.
"Father!
Mother!" Yuan Tianhua screamed as she ran to hug her parents.
"I missed you both so much!
Luckily, you’re both fine, and we can be together again now."
Ruan Xiaoqi hugged her daughter back.
"It’s been a long time since we saw each other, but I didn’t expect that cultivation would already be on par with us now, Tianhua."
"Haha." Yuan Tianhua giggled as she released her parents from her embrace.
"A lot has happened since you two ascended to this realm, and I’ve been cultivating diligently ever since."
"I see." Ruan Xiaoqi turned to Yuan Tianling’s parents, Yuan Tianquan and Ren Ziwei.
"I’m glad to see you two again, Brother Tianquan and Sister Ziwei."
Ren Ziwei smiled at her.
"I’m glad to see you again too, Xiaoqi.
We’ve been apart for a long time, so we have a lot to talk about."
"Yes." Ruan Xiaoqi asked her.
"Where is your daughter?
Why isn’t she here?"
"Oh!
Tianling has become Zhang Fei’s wife, and she has entered seclusion with him.
She won’t be coming out anytime soon, so you’ll have to wait a long time to meet her." Ren Ziwei then pulled Ruan Xiaoqi and Yuan Tianhua away with him.
"Let’s talk somewhere else."
Meanwhile, Yuan Tianquan went with Yuan Tianhua’s father and explained many things to him, especially about the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Meanwhile, Beihuang Fan and Nalan Qingge immediately went to meet their Beihuang and Nalan Clan members, especially since they had been separated from them for so long.
On the other hand, Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi went to the Shangguan Clan’s residence, especially since Zhang Fei hadn’t brought the Tian Clan members to the Paradise Realm.
"Ancestors!
I’m glad you have arrived in this realm now." Shangguan Han spoke to both Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi.
Shangguan Miyuan hugged them for a moment.
"We’ll be together again from now on, Ancestors."
"Yeah." Shangguan Lizhi nodded at her.
"Where’s Shangguan Yan?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1510: The Celestial Moon Sect
paragraphs: Yuan Hao immediately answered her. "Ancestor Lizhi, my mother and mother-in-law are Zhang Fei’s wives, remember? They’ve been in seclusion with him since a week ago, and we don’t know when they’ll come out."
"I see." Shangguan Lizhi nodded in understanding. "How big is the time difference between the two realms exactly? How can the three of you be so much older than the last time we met?"

"One year in the three mortal realms is equivalent to fifty years in this realm, ancestor." Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi were stunned by Shangguan Han’s answer. "Moreover, we’ve been training in Zhang Fei’s private place for several years, and the flow of time there is four times faster than in the outside world. That’s why we’re much older now, and our cultivation has already broken through to the Five Celestial Realms."
"The Five Celestial Realms?"
"Yes, Ancestor." Shangguan Miyuan pulled Shangguan Lizhi to sit with him. "I’ll explain everything to you so you won’t be confused anymore, and I’ll take you on a walk through the sect afterward."
Shangguan Lizhi nodded at her. "Please tell me everything."
"Why did you guys envelop us with your auras? Zhang Fei did the same when he brought us here."

"Haha." Shangguan Yan and Yuan Hao laughed at that. "Ancestor Junfeng, you wouldn’t have been able to move if we hadn’t protected you with our auras, especially since the gravity in this realm is much greater than in our home realm."
"Oh?"
Shangguan Yan supported Tian Junfeng. "I will withdraw my aura from you, and you can try experiencing the gravity here, Ancestor."

"Alright." Tian Junfeng almost fell as soon as Shangguan Yan retracted his aura, and he had difficulty moving his body. "So heavy! Even with my cultivation, I can’t withstand this gravitational weight, and I definitely can’t move if you don’t hold me."

"Haha." Yuan Hao chuckled as Shangguan Yan enveloped Tian Junfeng with his aura again. "Ancestor, you and Ancestor Lizhi must first adjust to this realm’s gravity; otherwise, you won’t be able to move freely. However, it will probably take you both a few months to fully adapt to it, mainly because the gravity here is too heavy."
"How long have you all been in this realm?"
"A few years, but we have trained in Zhang Fei’s private space for several years, and we immediately got used to the gravity in this realm." Shangguan Yan answered Tian Junfeng.

Tian Junfeng nodded in understanding. "Alright, I will adapt to the heavy gravity here first, but please explain to me about this sect. How can you all live in this sect? Is Zhang Fei the owner of this sect?"

"Zhang Fei is not the owner of this sect, but his two wives are the sect master and vice sect master here." Tian Junfeng was surprised by Yuan Hao’s answer. "Now, this sect is no different from his, and there are many cultivators from the Three Mortal Realms here, all of whom are his family members and close people."
Shangguan Yan then explained to Tian Junfeng about many other things, such as the Moonlit Passion Temple, the Twin Flames Main Domain, and the Paradise Realm.

Tian Junfeng was pensive after hearing that, as he still remembered the first time he met Zhang Fei in the Sovereign Heaven Realm. A few months had passed for him, but several years had passed for Zhang Fei. "Sigh! Lizhi and I have a lot of things we need to catch up on, or we’ll have a difficult time adapting to this sect."

"Hahaha." Shangguan Yan laughed at that. "Don’t worry too much about it, Ancestor. You’ll definitely get used to this sect because there are many cultivators from our realms here, and most of the others come from the Three Mortal Realms like us. However, there are many cultivators from the Paradise Realm here, and they come from all races, including demons."
"Demon races?" Tian Junfeng looked at Shangguan Yan and Yuan Hao.

"Zhang Fei has demon wives from other domains, and two of them are demon gods." Tian Junfeng was shocked again, but Yuan Hao immediately explained their status, especially Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran. "Those two women are two of the ten powerful demon gods, but they have fallen into his arms. Additionally, his mother-in-law, Nalan Shizhe, is also one of the demon gods."

"That kid is as scary as ever." Tian Junfeng muttered to himself. "In both the Three Mortal Realms and the Paradise Realm, he has done many things that other cultivators cannot. Forget it! I have to adapt to the gravity of this realm as soon as possible, or I will have to continue to depend on you two."

"Before that, we will take you and Ancestor Lizhi on a tour of the sect, and you two can decide your next steps later." The three men immediately took Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi along while explaining to them about the sect and all its halls so they could choose the best one for themselves later.

At the Celestial Moon Sect, Yue Yuling was already sitting with several women, who were the sect’s leaders and elders. She explained to them about her previous meeting with Zhang Fei, Helian Xun’er, and Tianshi Shengjie, including the Moonlit Passion Temple.

The people were shocked when Yue Yuling told them that several demon races had already joined the Moonlit Passion Temple, which was quite unusual for a human sect to accept them. However, they knew that Feng Yao was protecting the sect, and no one would dare attack the sect with such a powerful protector behind them.
They were even more shocked after Yue Yuling mentioned to them that many races had also joined the sect, including Tianshi Shengjie, who was the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race.
Yue Yuling then looked at the woman sitting in the head seat. "What do you think if we establish a relationship with the Moonlit Passion Temple, Sect Master Xuelian?"

Yue Xuelian is a stunning beauty, and she has long, flowing black hair that cascades down her back. Her face is mature but delicate and exudes calm, tranquil beauty. Her skin is light, which gives her a soft, otherworldly look. She has a natural expression with a slim nose and thin lips, combined with a slightly angular jawline and soft cheekbones. She has clear black eyes that feel calm but slightly alluring, framed by long lashes.

Yue Xuelian’s body is well-proportioned, with a slim but tall figure, soft curves, and big breasts. She wears a simple white and lavender slip dress, highlighting her sensual and sexy figure while maintaining a sense of modesty and elegance.

Yue Xuelian did not immediately give Yue Yuling an answer, and she considered the pros and cons for them if they built a relationship with the Moonlit Passion Temple. Even though the sect had turned into a universal sect, its main basis was dual cultivation, and there were many male disciples there. Her sect was a women-only sect that had been established for a long time, and she was afraid that the collaboration between the two sects would tarnish their reputation.
"What if we don’t make a decision now and visit the sect first, Sect Master?" Another woman, who was sitting next to Yue Xuelian, asked a question.

The woman’s face is oval, with soft, almond-shaped eyes and light brown pupils, topped by thin eyebrows. Her nose is slender and straight, and her lips are full and tinted in pink. There is a quiet composure in her eyes—neither overly emotional nor cold. Her black hair is long, straight, and flows naturally down her back, with a soft sheen.

She wears a red and white slip-style traditional dress. The red accents contrast vividly against the softer base color, emphasizing her mature figure. Her shoulders are slender, her breasts are not big but not small, her arms are long, her waist is gently defined, and her curves are soft yet noticeable.

Yue Xuelian nodded to the woman. "You’re right, Yue Qianrou. Honestly, I’ve never liked dual cultivation sects, but I don’t hate them either. News of the major changes at the Moonlit Passion Temple has long piqued my curiosity, especially because of Empress Huo’s presence behind them. However, I only found out today that Princess Tianshi also joined the sect as a guest elder, and she has such a relationship with the man behind the sect’s changes."
"Shall we go there now?" Yue Qianrou asked.
Yue Xuelian looked out the window before rising from her seat. "We will visit the sect, and I’ll decide after I speak with Qing Qiu’er myself."
"Do we need to inform Qing Qiu’er about our visit first?" Yue Qianrou rose from her seat and followed behind Yue Xuelian.
Yue Xuelian nodded as she walked away. "I’ll contact Qing Qiu’er on the way, so we should leave now."
After the two women left, a female elder approached Yue Yuling with a question. "Why did you allow those cultivators from the Three Mortal Realms to enter this realm?"
"Do you think we can stop Feltia from taking them away, Yue Wanxian?"
"What do you mean by that?"

"I won’t explain the details to you." Yue Wanxian frowned at Yue Yuling. "Do you dare to prevent them from taking those people away with Empress Huo behind them? That sect is indeed still weak now, but I am confident she will not remain idle, and she will help them grow. If my guess is correct, establishing a positive relationship with the sect will be beneficial for us."

chapters.title: Chapter 1511: Two Guests
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [4] stood in midair with Tianshi Shengjie and Helian Xun’er, awaiting the arrival of the people from the Celestial Moon Sect.
"Are you sure they will come to our sect?"
"I’m sure Yue Yuling has already informed them about our sect, and they will be here soon." Zhang Fei [4] opened a portal to the training space. "You can continue your training, Xun’er."

As Helian Xun’er walked into the portal, Qing Qiu’er walked out from inside it. After that, Zhang Fei [4] closed the portal and informed the female sect leader about the people from the Celestial Moon Sect.
"Are you going to move the demons in our sect to another place first?"

"No need." Zhang Fei [4] told Qing Qiu’er about Tianshi Shengjie’s conversation with Yue Liangyu at the Moon Tower. "Since they already know about the demons, we don’t need to hide them. I’m sure they won’t dare cause trouble in our sect, and they won’t tell other sects about them either."

Qing Qiu’er then teased him. "Are you interested in the women of that sect, husband? The Celestial Moon Sect is a women-only sect, and as far as I know, they are all virgins. If you use your demon abilities, I’m sure you can subdue them all, and their sect will be yours."

"You are not interested in Yue Liangyu and Yue Yuling, but I think you will be interested in Yue Xuelian." Zhang Fei [4] turned to Tianshi Shengjie, who immediately touched his forehead and shared the image of the woman. "She is a stunning beauty, and her face is otherworldly."

Zhang Fei [4] immediately saw the image of Yue Xuelian in his mind, and he admitted that the woman was indeed stunning with an otherworldly face. "She is indeed an extraordinary woman, but Tian Qiye is much better than her."

Tianshi Shengjie and Qing Qiu’er smiled strangely upon hearing that, but they also admitted that Tian Qiye’s beauty far surpassed Yue Xuelian’s, and she was also much more powerful than that woman. However, they believed that the two women’s beauty would be equal if Zhang Fei [4] gave them his two Beauty Pills, and he would be lucky if he could have both of them as his women in the future.
"They’re here."

Tianshi Shengjie and Qing Qiu’er looked towards the entrance portal to their domain, finding Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou standing there. The two women did not dare to move forward due to the flight restriction formation.
Zhang Fei [4] looked at both women, but he frowned when he activated his demon eyes to examine them. "Who is the other woman?"

"Yue Qianrou is the vice sect master of their sect, and she takes care of everything there if Yue Xuelian goes into seclusion." Then, Qing Qiu’er asked him. "What do you think of them? Are you interested in them?"

"I have to admit that Yue Xuelian’s beauty is indeed extraordinary when I see her in person, but I’m not interested in her." Zhang Fei [4] then looked at the second woman. "Yue Qianrou’s heart isn’t as beautiful as her face, and she harbors many terrible things deep inside."
Tianshi Shengjie and Qing Qiu’er looked at Zhang Fei [4] with surprise. "What do you mean by that? Does Yue Qianrou truly possess a corrupt heart?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] narrowed his eyes as he looked at Yue Qianrou. "I’ll tell you two about her later, and you can go pick them up now."
"Aren’t you going to meet them?" Zhang Fei [4] shook his head and instantly disappeared from the sight of the two women. "He doesn’t usually act like that, right?"

"Let’s meet them."

"Your husband is Zhang Fei, right? Where is he now? Why isn’t he with you?"
"Zhang Fei is indeed my husband." Qing Qiu’er replied with a nod. "However, he also has other wives, and they have been in seclusion for some time now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1512: Tour And Offer
paragraphs: Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou weren’t surprised by this, as the Moonlit Passion Temple was a former dual cultivation sect, and Zhang Fei was a dual cultivator, so it was natural for him to have many wives. However, they did not expect that Qing Qiu’er was willing to be his wife and Tianshi Shengjie was his future wife, especially since his cultivation was much lower than theirs.
Qing Qiu’er and Tianshi Shengjie brought Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou around to see all the new areas of the Moonlit Passion Temple, starting from the Sword Hall.

Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou had heard from Yue Yuling that Jian Kuang and Zhuxian Sheng had joined the Moonlit Passion Temple. Initially, they were skeptical about the news, but after seeing the three men in person, they became convinced, and they could see that the three were happy to train the sect’s disciples.
"He is Han Ling, the fourth god-rank swordmaster in our sect, and he is my husband’s master."

After Qing Qiu’er pointed at him, Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou looked at Han Ling. His cultivation was only at the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, but they knew that swordsmanship had nothing to do with one’s cultivation, and anyone could reach the highest level with profound knowledge of it.

Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were quite surprised to see Long Xiaolian there because she was a demihuman, but she seemed to be enjoying herself among the humans, which was unheard of. However, their expressions changed when they saw Mo Yousha among them, as they knew that she was the second princess of the Celestial Demon Race.

Although Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou had heard from Yue Yuling that the Moonlit Passion Temple accepted all races, they did not expect that they would meet the second princess of the Celestial Demon Race there. Moreover, all the disciples and senior cultivators, such as Jian Kuang and Zhuxian Sheng, did not mind Mo Yousha’s presence among them.
"You’ve heard that our sect accepts all races, right?" Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou nodded to Qing Qiu’er, who immediately led them to the next hall, the Soul Hall.
"Does the presence of the second princess of the Celestial Demon Race bring trouble to you?"

"No." Qing Qiu’er shook her head at Yue Qianrou. "Mo Yousha and Mo Anqi joined us not long ago, but all the disciples have already accepted them. Our sect has strict rules, and we will eliminate anyone who tries to disrupt the balance, including the two demon princesses."
"Does that mean you are ready to face the Celestial Demon Race?"
"Mo Shentian and the Celestial Demon Race are indeed powerful, and not many cultivators dare to confront them, but we will never allow anyone to mess with our sect."
’Heh!’ Yue Qianrou sneered inwardly. ’Of course, you dare to face Mo Shentian because Empress Huo is protecting you from behind.’

Soon, they arrived at the Soul Hall, where Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou saw Hun Di and some of his disciples training the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple in the soul cultivation path. Although those people were far weaker than them in cultivation, the two women did not dare underestimate them because the soul cultivation path was a difficult one to learn, but they were shocked because the sect had many soul cultivator experts.
They didn’t spend long in the Soul Hall, and Qing Qiu’er led the two guests into another hall, with Tianshi Shengjie following behind them as she monitored Yue Qianrou.

They didn’t spend much time exploring the Body and Speed Halls either, as there weren’t many powerful cultivators there, and most disciples were still beginners in both fields. However, Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were quite curious about Su Shentian’s decision to join the Moonlit Passion Sect because everyone in the Paradise Realm knew that he never stayed long in one place, but he was willing to join the sect to train disciples.

Their next destination was the Alchemist Hall, where Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou seriously observed Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang teaching the disciples about alchemy. However, they were unable to recognize that the latter was a demon due to his disguise technique.
"Where are the other seven alchemy gods?"

Qing Qiu’er answered Yue Qianrou directly. "As I said before, one of them is my husband, and he has been in seclusion for some time. The identities of the other five alchemists are secret, and they don’t like appearing in public. As for the last alchemist, my husband sent her to the Heavenly Mistveil Domain to help the demihuman race."

"Hmm?" Yue Qianrou raised an eyebrow. "Why are the other five hiding their identities? As far as I know, alchemists like to show off their abilities, and they do it to gain recognition and resources."

"Hehe." Tianshi Shengjie chuckled. "Vice Sect Master Qianrou, you are aware that everyone has different characters, right? You don’t need to doubt that they exist, but they have different roles. They don’t need the recognition of others, and Zhang Fei can provide them with resources, so they will never appear in public."
"They—"

"That’s enough, Qianrou." Yue Xuelian stopped her vice sect master. "Everyone has their own choices, just like us. Although many alchemists like to show off their abilities, many of them never do so, so you shouldn’t be surprised by their decision."
"Yeah." Despite this, Yue Qianrou was still curious about the identities of the other alchemists.
They had arrived at the Blacksmith Hall, and Qing Qiu’er told Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou about the identities of the people there, including their blacksmith rank.
Afterward, Qing Qiu’er took the two guests to the Array Hall, but they only found Fa Shen there because Duanmu Luolan was in seclusion with Zhang Fei.

They didn’t waste time and went to visit the other halls, their last stop being the Medical Hall, where Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou saw Elmyra, Tian Zhiling, and several others. However, they didn’t see Chiel, Tian Gongzhu, and Tian Jianxia because they were in the training space.
"An elf and a winged race." Yue Xuelian muttered as she looked at Elmyra and Tian Zhiling.

Yue Qianrou was also curious about them, but Yue Xuelian forbade her from asking Qing Qiu’er. She was truly curious about how Zhang Fei managed to persuade them to join the Moonlit Passion Temple, and their presence in the sect made it the best in the Paradise Realm, especially since not all sects could specialize in all areas.
Qing Qiu’er had already brought Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou to the main hall, but Tianshi Shengjie did not join them; instead, she went to another area to talk to Zhang Fei [4].

Qing Qiu’er then spoke to them. "Sect Master Xuelian, this sect was once a dual cultivation sect, but you have seen all the changes we have made. I know that your sect is a women-only sect, but what do you think if our two sects establish a beneficial relationship from now on?"

"Yes." Yue Xuelian nodded at her. "At first, I didn’t believe it after Yue Yuling told me about the great changes in your sect, but I’ve seen everything now, and I dare say that your sect has become the best of all the sects in the Paradise Realm, including the Divine Samsara Sect. Although the cultivation of your main members is not as high as the cultivation of the members of other sects, they can make up for their shortcomings with their abilities in various fields. When they reach our level, I believe they will be unstoppable, and your sect will become the number one sect in our realm. So, what kind of cooperation do you propose?"

Qing Qiu’er contacted Zhang Fei [4] first because she had no idea about it, and she replied to Yue Xuelian after discussing it with him. "Sect Master Xuelian, I want to open an alchemy shop in your domain, and I will send someone there to manage the shop. In addition, we can each send two female disciples to our two sects, and they will be our representatives."

"Hmm?" Yue Qianrou raised an eyebrow. "Sect Master, it doesn’t matter if Sect Master Qing wants to open an alchemy shop in our domain, but we cannot allow her disciples to stay in our sect, especially because most of them are dual cultivators."

"Haha." Qing Qiu’er laughed at that. "Vice Sect Master Qianrou, I understand the situation in your sect, and I won’t send female dual cultivators there. Moreover, you’ve already witnessed the many races here, and not all of them are dual cultivators, so I’ll choose two of them to join your sect. So, what do you think about my offer?"

Yue Xuelian shook her head in response. "Sect Master Qing, I have witnessed all the changes in this sect with my own eyes, but the image of a dual cultivation sect still clings to it, and I am uncertain if my disciples are willing to join. Therefore, I cannot immediately make a decision, and I have to discuss your offer with my sect members first."

"I see." Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding, as she had been certain from the start that it wouldn’t be easy to establish a relationship with the Celestial Moon Sect. "In that case, you can discuss my offer with them first, and you can contact me once you’ve reached an agreement. If they agree, we will prepare everything to open an alchemy shop in your domain, and your members will get huge benefits."

Qing Qiu’er had already brought Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou to the main hall, but Tianshi Shengjie did not join them; instead, she went to another area to talk to Zhang Fei [4].
Qing Qiu’er then spoke to them.
"Sect Master Xuelian, this sect was once a dual cultivation sect, but you have seen all the changes we have made.
I know that your sect is a women-only sect, but what do you think if our two sects establish a beneficial relationship from now on?"
"Yes." Yue Xuelian nodded at her.

"At first, I didn’t believe it after Yue Yuling told me about the great changes in your sect, but I’ve seen everything now, and I dare say that your sect has become the best of all the sects in the Paradise Realm, including the Divine Samsara Sect.
Although the cultivation of your main members is not as high as the cultivation of the members of other sects, they can make up for their shortcomings with their abilities in various fields.
When they reach our level, I believe they will be unstoppable, and your sect will become the number one sect in our realm.
So, what kind of cooperation do you propose?"
Qing Qiu’er contacted Zhang Fei [4] first because she had no idea about it, and she replied to Yue Xuelian after discussing it with him.
"Sect Master Xuelian, I want to open an alchemy shop in your domain, and I will send someone there to manage the shop.
In addition, we can each send two female disciples to our two sects, and they will be our representatives."
"Hmm?" Yue Qianrou raised an eyebrow.

"Sect Master, it doesn’t matter if Sect Master Qing wants to open an alchemy shop in our domain, but we cannot allow her disciples to stay in our sect, especially because most of them are dual cultivators."
"Haha." Qing Qiu’er laughed at that.
"Vice Sect Master Qianrou, I understand the situation in your sect, and I won’t send female dual cultivators there.
Moreover, you’ve already witnessed the many races here, and not all of them are dual cultivators, so I’ll choose two of them to join your sect.
So, what do you think about my offer?"
Yue Xuelian shook her head in response.
"Sect Master Qing, I have witnessed all the changes in this sect with my own eyes, but the image of a dual cultivation sect still clings to it, and I am uncertain if my disciples are willing to join.
Therefore, I cannot immediately make a decision, and I have to discuss your offer with my sect members first."
"I see." Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding, as she had been certain from the start that it wouldn’t be easy to establish a relationship with the Celestial Moon Sect.
"In that case, you can discuss my offer with them first, and you can contact me once you’ve reached an agreement.
If they agree, we will prepare everything to open an alchemy shop in your domain, and your members will get huge benefits."

chapters.title: Chapter 1513: Heaven-Defying Corpse Scripture
paragraphs: "How is the result?" Tianshi Shengjie asked as soon as Qing Qiu’er appeared in front of them.

"Yue Xuelian doesn’t dare make a decision right away, and she has to discuss our offer with her sect members first. After she finishes discussing it with them, she’ll inform me of the result, but I don’t know whether they’ll agree to it or not." Qing Qiu’er looked at Zhang Fei [4] and questioned him. "What exactly did you see in Yue Qianrou? Is there something wrong with that woman?"

"Yue Qianrou is a corpse demon, but she differs from Wang Yin." Tianshi Shengjie and Qing Qiu’er looked at Zhang Fei [4] in confusion because they could feel a human aura from her. "I know you two find it difficult to believe it because she doesn’t have a demon aura, but she really is a corpse demon, and her heart is filled with many terrible things. She hates her sect master so much because Yue Xuelian caused her to become a corpse demon, and she wants to make that woman suffer."

Qing Qiu’er found it difficult to believe that Yue Qianrou was a corpse demon, but she was sure that Zhang Fei [4] was not making things up, as he still kept many secrets from her and his other wives. "Why doesn’t she have a demon aura? I sensed that she was a human because her aura was the same as mine, and I couldn’t sense her demon aura."
"Do you think that Yuan Xiajie was the one who turned Yue Qianrou into a corpse demon? Is that why you avoided that woman?" Tianshi Shengjie asked.

Zhang Fei [4] shook his head. "If Yuan Xiajie turns Yue Qianrou into a corpse demon, she will have the same demon aura as Wang Yin. Besides, her soul still resides in her body, so I’m sure it wasn’t that woman who turned her into a corpse demon."
*Swoosh*

They turned to Feng Yao, who had just appeared. "Yue Qianrou is indeed a corpse demon, but she is not an ordinary one. Her body doesn’t emit a demon aura because she didn’t die when she turned into one, and she turned into one because of a curse."
"A curse that can turn a living creature into a corpse demon, huh?"

"Yes." Feng Yao waved her hand and created a qi screen. "In the distant past, there was a sect that mastered various curse techniques, and one of them was the Heaven-Defying Corpse Scripture. If people were affected by that technique, they would transform into corpse demons. Although their bodies transformed into corpse demons, they did not possess a demon aura like others, and they still retained their souls. The sect was long extinct, but their relics still existed, and I didn’t expect that woman would encounter them."
"That technique is different from the Corpse Refining Coffin."

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded. "If you turn living beings into corpses using the Corpse Refining Coffin, they will become corpses without consciousness because they have lost their souls. Yuan Xiajie used a different technique to turn Wang Yin into a corpse demon, and she became a soulless corpse demon."
"Can we do anything to expose Yue Qianrou?"

Feng Yao shook her head at Tianshi Shengjie. "The only way to eliminate that woman is to find the Heaven-Defying Corpse Scripture, which will allow us to reverse the effects of the curse. If we reverse the curse, the woman will die, but unfortunately, I don’t know the exact location of the former sect. Honestly, you guys don’t need to think about that woman because she doesn’t want to cause trouble for you, and she only has a grudge against Yue Xuelian, so I think you guys don’t need to interfere in this matter."
"Yue Xuelian is much stronger than she looks on the outside; otherwise, Yue Qianrou would have long taken action against her."
Tianshi Shengjie agreed with Qing Qiu’er and asked Zhang Fei [4]. "Are you thinking of interfering in their matters?"

"No." Zhang Fei [4] denied with a shake of his head. "I don’t know Yue Xuelian personally, so I don’t need to interfere in their affairs. If something bad happens to her because of Yue Qianrou, then it’s her fate."

"Hehe." Qing Qiu’er chuckled and teased him. "Are you really going to let anything terrible happen to Yue Xuelian? Even though you’ve said you have no interest in her, she’s still one of the most beautiful women in this realm, and I think she’s suitable to be your woman."
Zhang Fei [4] admitted that Yue Xuelian was a beautiful woman, but he was not interested in her, so he did not want to waste time dealing with her problems.

Feng Yao smiled as she looked at Zhang Fei [4], and she felt that he had changed a lot compared to when he was still living in the Three Mortal Realms. He no longer followed his lust like in the past, and he became really picky in choosing women since he ascended to the Paradise Realm; otherwise, he has taken many women from that realm to become his women.
"Phew." Zhang Fei [4] let out a breath before speaking to Qing Qiu’er. "If you want to tell Yue Xuelian about Yue Qianrou, you can do it yourself, and I won’t interfere in their matters."
Qing Qiu’er pursed her lips, but she didn’t speak further about Yue Xuelian, and Feng Yao immediately turned into a crimson fire before re-entering Zhang Fei [4]’s body.

Zhang Fei [4] briefly looked at the portal out of the Twin Flames Main Domain before opening the portal to the training space. Qing Qiu’er and Tianshi Shengjie immediately walked inside, and he followed behind them as he closed the portal.
Once they arrived inside, Tianshi Shengjie continued her training together with Qi Qingxiu and the others. Zhang Fei [4] returned to the pavilion to help his three wives: Zilvora, Orith, and Ilsath.

Qing Qiu’er also returned to the pavilion, and she joined Zhang Fei [5], who was still dual cultivating with Sima Huiqing and Yan Jinwu. As for You Feiling, she joined the others in the training ground to train, mainly because she needed to catch up with the others.

"What are you thinking, Master?" Feng Yao tilted her head to Huo Ling and explained to her about Yue Qianrou and the Heaven-Defying Corpse Scripture. "I didn’t expect the legacy of that sect to resurface, but I don’t understand how their legacy could appear in this Paradise Realm since it’s one of the ancient sects. Are you going to do something to that woman, Master?"

Feng Yao shook her head. "That sect is indeed a heretical sect, but Yue Qianrou hasn’t done anything. She only hates Yue Xuelian, mainly because she caused her to turn into a corpse demon. Moreover, not all corpse demons are evil, so I won’t do anything to her, but I have other plans for the sect master."
"Your plan must have something to do with Zhang Fei, right?" Huo Ling never liked it when Feng Yao got too involved with him, and she wanted her master to be hers alone.
"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed in response, and the two of them immediately disappeared from the place.

A short time later, Feng Yao and Huo Ling were already standing in the air above the Celestial Moon Sect. They did not enter the sect and listened to Yue Xuelian, who was gathering with the sect elders, discussing Qing Qiu’er’s previous offer.

"Hmm?" Huo Ling looked at Yue Qianrou from a distance. "That woman is truly a corpse demon, Master. She can deceive all those women, but she will never deceive my eyes. What will you do for Yue Xuelian?"
"Let’s wait until Yue Xuelian finishes her meeting with all the women first."

Inside the room, Yue Xuelian explained to all the sect elders everything she had seen at the Moonlit Passion Temple. To further convince them, she created several qi screens showing all the areas she had previously visited, starting from the outermost area of the Twin Flames Main Domain.

Yue Yuling and all the female elders were shocked to see the changes in the Twin Flames Main Domain, which had now completely become a forest, except for the outermost area, preventing them from being able to see all sects and cities in that domain.
Yue Xuelian told them that Zhang Fei and Qing Qiu’er installed so many formations there, including illusion formations and flight restrictions.

Those elders were increasingly shocked when they saw the situation in the Moonlit Passion Temple, especially the situation and people in all the halls. They truly hadn’t expected a single sect to be inhabited by people from various races, including demons, which was unprecedented. Even though they had heard about it from Yue Yuling before, the result was different from seeing it with their own eyes.

After everything was done, Yue Xuelian spoke to them. "Qing Qiu’er proposed a disciple exchange with our sect. She will send two female disciples to our sect, and we will send two of our female disciples to her sect. Not all of her sect members are dual cultivators, and she will send two non-dual cultivator disciples to our sect. Additionally, she wants to open an alchemy shop in our domain, which will benefit both our disciples and the other residents. I haven’t decided on this matter yet, and I want to hear your opinions first on this matter, so I will make a decision after discussing it with all of you."

chapters.title: Chapter 1514: Choosing Disciples
paragraphs: Yue Qianrou sat in her chair as she looked at the elders one by one, and most of them seemed interested in the idea of their sect collaborating with the Moonlit Passion Temple. She glanced at Yue Xuelian several times, who seemed eager to realize the cooperation between the two sects.

Yue Qianrou herself was interested in the cooperation between the two sects, as it would bring many benefits to her sect. However, she was concerned about several potential issues that might arise if the two sects cooperated, and she was worried that people from the Moonlit Passion Temple would interfere in their affairs, which would complicate her personal plans.

’Unfortunately, Yue Xuelian is much stronger than me, even though our cultivation is equal.’ The female sect master was unaware of Yue Qianrou’s glances and thoughts toward her, and she preferred to wait for the female elders to consider the possibility of a collaboration between the two sects. ’I must find an opportunity to catch her off guard, and I will take her to that place. I will turn her into a corpse demon like me, and she will feel my suffering all this time. I was trapped in that place because of her, so she caused my suffering, and she had to feel the same suffering as mine.’
After weighing the pros and cons and discussing them with each other, the elders finally reached an agreement on the matter.

Yue Yuling immediately spoke to Yue Xuelian. "Sect Master, we believe that cooperating with the Moonlit Passion Sect poses no issues, and it will be the best decision we have ever made. After all, they have the support of Empress Huo, and they have many expert cultivators in their respective fields, especially alchemy."

"Has Qing Qiu’er told you the identity of the disciple she will send to our sect, Sect Master?" Yue Wanxian asked. "We must ensure that they are not dual cultivators, as this would negatively impact our disciples and tarnish the reputation of our sect, which has been upheld for tens of thousands of years."

The other female elders also voiced the same opinion, as they did not want the presence of two female disciples from the Moonlit Passion Temple to tarnish the reputation of their sect, and that would be a big problem for them in the future.

"Qing Qiu’er hasn’t told me the identity of the female disciple she will send to our sect, but she should already be aware of the situation in our sect, and she guarantees that they are not dual cultivators." Yue Xuelian’s answer made the elders wonder about their identities. "I don’t think you guys need to worry about that because there are many non-dual cultivators in the Moonlit Passion Temple, and I believe that she will keep her word. If she sends dual cultivators to our sect, we have the option of not accepting them, and I will ask them to return to their sect, so our reputation will never be tarnished."

All the female elders agreed with Yue Xuelian; however, one of them then asked a question. "Who are the two disciples we will send to the Moonlit Passion Temple, Sect Master? The image of their sect as a dual cultivation sect is still there, and I’m uncertain whether any of the disciples will agree to join it."

"Do you guys have two suitable candidates for us to send to the Moonlit Passion Temple?" Those female elders immediately thought of several names, but they weren’t sure if they would be willing to join the sect. "What do you think about Yue Liangyu, Yuling?"
Yue Yuling looked at Yue Xuelian in surprise. "Do you really want to send Liangyu to the Moonlit Passion Sect, Sect Master?"

"Yes." Yue Xuelian nodded slightly. "Princess Tianshi is a guest elder in the sect, and we know that Yue Liangyu has a good relationship with her since they’ve known each other for so long, so I think she’s the right choice. Moreover, she’s been guarding the Moon Tower for a thousand years, so I think it’s time for her to come out from there, and another disciple will take her place."
Yue Qianrou chimed in. "Yue Liangyu is one of our senior disciples, and she has a lot of experience compared to other disciples, so I think she is the right choice to join the sect."
"How about we ask her about this matter first?"

"No need." Yue Qianrou rejected Yue Yuling’s idea. "I’ll contact Yue Liangyu and ask her to come see us now, so all you need to do is think of one more disciple to accompany her in joining that sect."

Yue Yuling looked at Yue Xuelian, but she did not stop Yue Qianrou. Just like her, she felt that Yue Liangyu was the right choice to be their sect’s representative, and she had been guarding the Moon Tower for too long, so it was time for her to get out of there.

Yue Yuling released a disappointed sigh, but she didn’t refute Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou because she knew it was pointless. She then remembered someone and suggested a name to them. "Since you both chose Yue Liangyu as one of our representatives, I think it would be better if we also send Yue Liuxian there, as they are close friends and easier to communicate with."
"Please summon Yue Liuxian here now, Yuling."
Yue Yuling nodded slightly and immediately contacted Yue Liuxian, asking her to come meet them as soon as possible. "Yue Liuxian will arrive in a few minutes."
"Yue Liangyu has already departed from the Moon Tower, and she will arrive soon," Yue Qianrou said.
Yue Xuelian nodded to them. "Let’s wait for them to arrive first."

Some time later, Yue Liangyu and Yue Liuxian arrived at the venue almost simultaneously. They were confused because Yue Qianrou and Yue Yuling had asked them to come meet them, but the two senior women hadn’t explained anything to them.
Yue Liangyu and Yue Liuxian went to meet Yue Xuelian and the others. "Sect Master Xuelian! Vice Sect Master Qianrou! Elders."

"Yue Liangyu, you have guarded the Moon Tower for a thousand years, so I will assign another disciple to replace you." Yue Liangyu was surprised to hear this decision, as Yue Xuelian made it suddenly without prior discussion with her. "I have another task for you, and Yue Liuxian will join you in carrying it out."
"Can you explain to us about the task, Sect Master?"
Yue Xuelian nodded and created a qi screen to show them the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple. "Do you both recognize that sect?"
"The Moonlit Passion Sect."

"Yes." Yue Xuelian nodded to them. "Qianrou and I have visited the sect before, and we also talked a lot with Qing Qiu’er. We plan to exchange disciples to become representatives of each sect, and we all agreed to choose the two of you as our representatives."
Yue Xuelian’s explanation shocked Yue Liangyu and Yue Liuxian, who had always disliked dual cultivators.

"You two don’t need to think about the status of the sect." Yue Xuelian showed them all the halls in the Moonlit Passion Sect. "As you both can see, the sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect as it was in the past; it has now transformed into a universal sect."
Yue Liangyu already knew about the sect’s changes because Tianshi Shengjie had shown her before, but she wasn’t interested in joining the sect due to the large number of dual cultivators there.

Since she hadn’t seen the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple before, Yue Liuxian was truly astonished by the sect’s transformation, especially the large number of people from all races there. "Are those women on the screen really demons, Sect Master? Why does the sect accept demons as members?"

"They are demons, but two among them are not ordinary ones, and they are the two princesses of the Celestial Demon Race." Yue Liuxian stared at Yue Xuelian in shock. "That sect has completely changed, and they want it to be a paradise for all races to live together. At first, I didn’t believe it either, but I’ve seen the situation there myself, and all races live together in harmony. Moreover, Qing Qiu’er told me that they will severely punish anyone who disturbs harmony there, including killing them."
Yue Liuxian nodded slightly as her eyes observed the images on the qi screen, and she was quite amazed to see all the races gathered in one place, which was unprecedented.
"Sect Master, what did Qing Qiu’er offer that made you choose to agree with her?" Yue Liangyu was certain Xuelian wouldn’t make such a decision without some sort of benefit.

"Qing Qiu’er will open an alchemy shop in our domain if we cooperate with her sect," Yue Xuelian’s answer surprised them. "That sect has nine god alchemists, and no other sect can match them, including the Divine Samsara Sect."

The other female elders also voiced the same opinion, as they did not want the presence of two female disciples from the Moonlit Passion Temple to tarnish the reputation of their sect, and that would be a big problem for them in the future.

"Qing Qiu’er hasn’t told me the identity of the female disciple she will send to our sect, but she should already be aware of the situation in our sect, and she guarantees that they are not dual cultivators." Yue Xuelian’s answer made the elders wonder about their identities.
"I don’t think you guys need to worry about that because there are many non-dual cultivators in the Moonlit Passion Temple, and I believe that she will keep her word.
If she sends dual cultivators to our sect, we have the option of not accepting them, and I will ask them to return to their sect, so our reputation will never be tarnished."
All the female elders agreed with Yue Xuelian; however, one of them then asked a question.
"Who are the two disciples we will send to the Moonlit Passion Temple, Sect Master?
The image of their sect as a dual cultivation sect is still there, and I’m uncertain whether any of the disciples will agree to join it."

"Do you guys have two suitable candidates for us to send to the Moonlit Passion Temple?" Those female elders immediately thought of several names, but they weren’t sure if they would be willing to join the sect.
"What do you think about Yue Liangyu, Yuling?"
Yue Yuling looked at Yue Xuelian in surprise.
"Do you really want to send Liangyu to the Moonlit Passion Sect, Sect Master?"
"Yes." Yue Xuelian nodded slightly.
"Princess Tianshi is a guest elder in the sect, and we know that Yue Liangyu has a good relationship with her since they’ve known each other for so long, so I think she’s the right choice.
Moreover, she’s been guarding the Moon Tower for a thousand years, so I think it’s time for her to come out from there, and another disciple will take her place."
Yue Qianrou chimed in.
"Yue Liangyu is one of our senior disciples, and she has a lot of experience compared to other disciples, so I think she is the right choice to join the sect."
"How about we ask her about this matter first?"
"No need." Yue Qianrou rejected Yue Yuling’s idea.
"I’ll contact Yue Liangyu and ask her to come see us now, so all you need to do is think of one more disciple to accompany her in joining that sect."
Yue Yuling looked at Yue Xuelian, but she did not stop Yue Qianrou.
Just like her, she felt that Yue Liangyu was the right choice to be their sect’s representative, and she had been guarding the Moon Tower for too long, so it was time for her to get out of there.
Yue Yuling released a disappointed sigh, but she didn’t refute Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou because she knew it was pointless.
She then remembered someone and suggested a name to them.
"Since you both chose Yue Liangyu as one of our representatives, I think it would be better if we also send Yue Liuxian there, as they are close friends and easier to communicate with."
"Please summon Yue Liuxian here now, Yuling."
Yue Yuling nodded slightly and immediately contacted Yue Liuxian, asking her to come meet them as soon as possible.
"Yue Liuxian will arrive in a few minutes."
"Yue Liangyu has already departed from the Moon Tower, and she will arrive soon," Yue Qianrou said.
Yue Xuelian nodded to them.
"Let’s wait for them to arrive first."
Some time later, Yue Liangyu and Yue Liuxian arrived at the venue almost simultaneously.
They were confused because Yue Qianrou and Yue Yuling had asked them to come meet them, but the two senior women hadn’t explained anything to them.
Yue Liangyu and Yue Liuxian went to meet Yue Xuelian and the others.
"Sect Master Xuelian!
Vice Sect Master Qianrou!
Elders."

"Yue Liangyu, you have guarded the Moon Tower for a thousand years, so I will assign another disciple to replace you." Yue Liangyu was surprised to hear this decision, as Yue Xuelian made it suddenly without prior discussion with her.
"I have another task for you, and Yue Liuxian will join you in carrying it out."
"Can you explain to us about the task, Sect Master?"
Yue Xuelian nodded and created a qi screen to show them the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple.
"Do you both recognize that sect?"
"The Moonlit Passion Sect."
"Yes." Yue Xuelian nodded to them.
"Qianrou and I have visited the sect before, and we also talked a lot with Qing Qiu’er.
We plan to exchange disciples to become representatives of each sect, and we all agreed to choose the two of you as our representatives."
Yue Xuelian’s explanation shocked Yue Liangyu and Yue Liuxian, who had always disliked dual cultivators.
"You two don’t need to think about the status of the sect." Yue Xuelian showed them all the halls in the Moonlit Passion Sect.
"As you both can see, the sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect as it was in the past; it has now transformed into a universal sect."
Yue Liangyu already knew about the sect’s changes because Tianshi Shengjie had shown her before, but she wasn’t interested in joining the sect due to the large number of dual cultivators there.
Since she hadn’t seen the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple before, Yue Liuxian was truly astonished by the sect’s transformation, especially the large number of people from all races there.
"Are those women on the screen really demons, Sect Master?
Why does the sect accept demons as members?"
"They are demons, but two among them are not ordinary ones, and they are the two princesses of the Celestial Demon Race." Yue Liuxian stared at Yue Xuelian in shock.
"That sect has completely changed, and they want it to be a paradise for all races to live together.
At first, I didn’t believe it either, but I’ve seen the situation there myself, and all races live together in harmony.
Moreover, Qing Qiu’er told me that they will severely punish anyone who disturbs harmony there, including killing them."
Yue Liuxian nodded slightly as her eyes observed the images on the qi screen, and she was quite amazed to see all the races gathered in one place, which was unprecedented.
"Sect Master, what did Qing Qiu’er offer that made you choose to agree with her?" Yue Liangyu was certain Xuelian wouldn’t make such a decision without some sort of benefit.
"Qing Qiu’er will open an alchemy shop in our domain if we cooperate with her sect," Yue Xuelian’s answer surprised them.
"That sect has nine god alchemists, and no other sect can match them, including the Divine Samsara Sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 1515: Yue Bingxuan
paragraphs: "Nine god alchemists," Yue Liuxian muttered to herself. "Even the Divine Samsara Sect only has three god-rank alchemists: Senior Jin Nanqing, Senior Luo Lianjin, and Senior Luo Lianjin. Our sect has been trying to cultivate alchemists for a long time, but none have reached that rank, and the highest among them is only at the Venerable Rank."

Yue Xuelian nodded at her. "Alchemy and pills are very useful for all cultivators, but unfortunately, we lack a skilled alchemist. Indeed, we can obtain various types of pills in the Divine Samsara Sect, but we have to spend a much larger amount to purchase them. That’s why we must build a closer relationship between the two sects, which will be more beneficial for us."
"Yes." Yue Lixuan agreed with that.
"Sect Master." Yue Xuelian looked at Yue Liangyu. "I’m indeed close to Helian Xun’er and Princess Tianshi, but Yue Bingxuan is much closer to them than I am, so—"
"Call Yue Bingxuan." Yue Yuling nodded to Yue Qianrou and contacted the woman directly.

Yue Liangyu was slightly relieved when Yue Yuling contacted Yue Bingxuan, as she didn’t want to go to the Moonlit Passion Temple, and she hoped her sect sister would accept the task together with Yue Liuxian.

Unlike Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian was eager to go to the Moonlit Passion Temple, especially after seeing the significant changes in the sect. She didn’t like dual cultivation like the other members of her sect, but she was very open to better opportunities to improve herself, and she was confident that she would improve further if she joined there.

A few minutes later, Yue Bingxuan gracefully walked into the room, making them jealous with her appearance. Her figure is slightly full, yet feminine and sexy, with large breasts and sharp curves. She wears a flowing, light-colored dress made of sheer, layered fabric that drapes over her body. Her aura is strong, stronger than Yue Liangyu and Yue Liuxian’s.

Yue Bingxuan’s hair is long, straight, and dark, falling smoothly down her back. Her face is mature and charming, with smooth skin. She has large almond-shaped eyes, with a seductive and enchanting gaze, framed by long lashes that give her gaze a gentle, slightly dreamy quality. Her nose is small, and her lips are naturally thick and lightly tinted in pink. Her shoulders are narrow, her waist softly defined, and her hips subtly rounded.
"Seniors." Yue Bingyue greeted them as she bowed slightly. "Why did you call me here?"

Yue Xuelian immediately explained everything in detail to Yue Bingxuan, which made her a little surprised. "Are you willing to be our representative at the Moonlit Passion Temple, Bingxuan? You studied at the Spirit Temple in the past, and I want you to study at that sect now."
"Did Helian Xun’er really join the Moonlit Passion Temple, Sect Master?"
"Yes." Yue Xuelian pointed at Yue Liangyu. "She met Helian Xun’er and Princess Tianshi before."
Yue Bingxuan turned to Yue Liangyu, who confirmed it with a nod. "Helian Xun’er joined the sect, but she’s different from before, and she’s decided to become one of Zhang Fei’s wives."
"Zhang Fei?"

Yue Liangyu nodded at her. "That man brought great change to the Moonlit Passion Temple, and he is Qing Qiu’er’s husband. Apart from them, Princess Tianshi is also his future wife, but I don’t know how far their relationship has gone."
"Princess Tianshi, huh?" Yue Bingxuan muttered in surprise. "Sect Master, I am willing to go to the Moonlit Passion Temple because I can learn many things there."

Yue Liangyu felt relieved after hearing Yue Bingxuan agree to the task, but her relief was short-lived, and she felt irritated when Yue Qianrou spoke. "The three of you will join the Moonlit Passion Temple, and you will leave after we confirm everything with Qing Qiu’er."
"But—"

"No buts." Yue Qianrou dismissed Yue Liangyu’s refusal. "The three of you are senior members of the sect, and you should think about the future of our sect. The Moonlit Passion Temple is no longer a dual cultivation sect, and we believe the cooperation between the two sects will have a positive impact on our sect, so you should have no objections to carrying out this task."
Yue Liangyu could only sigh in her heart. "Yes, Vice Sect Master. I will join the Moonlit Passion Temple, and I hope you are right that our two sects’ cooperation will benefit us."
"Good."
Yue Xuelian spoke directly to them. "The three of you can leave now, and I will inform you of your departure date after I speak to Qing Qiu’er."
"Yes, Sect Master." Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan immediately left the room.
After discussing some other matters, Yue Yuling and the other female elders also left the room, leaving Yue Xuelian alone with Yue Qianrou.
Yue Qianrou got up from her chair, walked behind Yue Xuelian, and hugged her from behind. "In your opinion, how much benefit will we gain from the two sects working together, Big Sis?"

"I can’t yet confirm the benefits of cooperation between the two sects." Yue Xuelian grabbed Yue Qianrou’s hands and rubbed them. "However, I’m sure the cooperation between the two sects will bring significant changes to our sect in the future, especially after Qing Qiu’er opens the alchemy shop. We can buy pills and other things at the Divine Samsara Sect, but Liang Huizhong deliberately sets their prices so high, so we can’t rely on them forever."
"Do you think Qing Qiu’er will sell their pills much cheaper than the Divine Samsara Sect?"

Yue Xuelian shook her head slightly. "I don’t know about that yet, but I will talk to Qing Qiu’er about this matter, and I hope she will sell those pills at a more affordable price. Our sect is indeed quite wealthy because we trade in several sectors, but we can’t keep wasting jewels on pills and the like, so I hope the cooperation between the two sects will bring positive changes to our sect in the future."

’I wish they had pills that I could use on you so I could take you to that place without you knowing.’ Yue Qianrou immediately released Yue Xuelian. "I’ll be back now, Big Sis. I hope you can persuade Qing Qiu’er to sell their pills at a more affordable price, and our sect will become stronger in the future."

Yue Xuelian watched Yue Yue Qianrou walk away. ’Please forgive me, Yue Qianrou. I know you hate me for what happened that day, but this sect still needs me now. Once this sect is stronger and able to survive on its own, I will definitely make amends to you for my past mistakes.’

Yue Xuelian wanted to walk away, but Feng Yao and Huo Ling suddenly appeared in front of her, surprising her. "I didn’t expect you to appear in my sect today, Empress Huo. So, what purpose did you come to see me for today?"

"I do need something from you." Feng Yao walked in front of Yue Xuelian, touched her chest, and injected something into her body without her realizing it. "However, I won’t explain it to you, and you will find out one day in the future. By the way, do you know anything about Yue Qianrou?"

Yue Xuelian felt that Feng Yao had done something to her, but she couldn’t feel anything. "Qianrou is a corpse demon, but she is different from the other corpse demons, and she does not have a demon aura."
"How did you know that?"

"Sigh." Yue Xuelian let out a soft sigh. "The day Qianrou returned from that place, she fell unconscious, and I took care of her myself. She was unconscious for several days, and I found her body changed one day. I don’t know what happened to her while she was trapped there, but I can confirm that she was a corpse demon based on her transformation."
Feng Yao nodded at her. "Yue Qianrou is a corpse demon, but the changes only occur in her body, and her soul is still there."
"Are you serious about that, Empress Huo? Does Qianrou really still have her soul?"

"Yes." Feng Yao explained several things to Ye Xuelian, including the Heaven-Defying Corpse Scripture. "If you want to make amends to her, you should tell me the location of the portal leading to that place, and we might be able to find a method to reverse the curse."

"Unfortunately, I don’t know the exact location of the portal, Empress Huo." Yue Xuelian shook her head. "Back then, we were trapped in a strange place, and we were separated from each other. I found nothing there, and I was sent out the moment I set foot in one of the rooms there. I’ve been trying to find the entry portal for quite a long time, but my search ended in vain. I eventually gave up and thought that Qianrou had died there, but she suddenly returned a few months later, and she fell unconscious for some time."
"What about Yue Qianrou? Have you ever asked her about this?"
"I’ve asked Qianrou about this matter many times, but she can’t remember anything."
"I see." Feng Yao nodded in understanding and thought of another way to enter the place. "In that case, I’ll be leaving now."

Yue Xuelian wanted to ask about the Moonlit Passion Temple, but Feng Yao and Huo Ling had already disappeared. She pressed her palm to her chest and tried to search for something inside her body, but she found nothing. "What did she actually do to me?"
