chapters.title: Chapter 1516: Choosing People
paragraphs: Feng Yao stood in the air with Huo Ling beside her, thinking about the location where Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were trapped in the past. "Where is the entry portal to that place actually located? Why can’t I detect it?"
"Do you think there are other remains of that heretical sect there, Master?"

"That’s for sure, Ling’er." Feng Yao created a qi screen, showing a prosperous sect in the past. "The Ancient Calamity Sect was one of the greatest sects in the Ancient Realm, and they possessed many powerful techniques in the past, one of which was the Heaven-Defying Corpse Scripture. Even though the sect had long been destroyed, its relics should still be found in the ruins. Even those ancients had to think twice about entering the sect’s ruins because there were many deadly traps there, and they wouldn’t be able to survive if they were affected by one of them."
"If so, how did Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou get out of that place alive?"

"I can’t be sure about that until I find the portal to their sect ruins, but I’m certain there are remains of their members left there, and that person is the one who turned Yue Qianrou into a cursed corpse demon. If we can find the portal, I can go there and search for that technique, and I can reverse the curse on her." Feng Yao removed the qi screen. "Let’s go back now, and I will slowly search for the portal."

’Hey! Yue Xuelian is willing to accept your offer, and she will send three disciples to your sect.’ Zhang Fei [5], who had just finished dual cultivating with Sima Huiqing and Yan Jinwu, was surprised by Feng Yao’s words. ’She has already decided to send Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan there. Therefore, you must immediately prepare everything, and you must choose three female disciples to send to their sect.’
Zhang Fei [5] didn’t know Yue Liuxian and Yue Bingxuan yet, but he didn’t like Yue Liangyu because of the previous incident at the Moon Tower. ’Do you know when they will be leaving for my sect?’
’Everything depends on you.’

’Alright.’ Zhang Fei [5] looked at Qing Qiu’er, who was starting to take off her dress. "Qiu’er, Yue Xuelian has agreed to the exchange of disciples, and she chose Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan to be sent to our sect."
"Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "I just learned this information from Feng Yao, but I’m sure she’s already gone to the Celestial Moon Sect before. Since they are going to send three disciples, we should also send three disciples there."
"Who are you going to send to the sect?"

Zhang Fei [5] thought of the names of three women first. "I will send Nanfeng Yunxi to the sect, and she will also oversee our alchemy shop there. Besides her, I also plan to send Senior Sister Yan Yinqing and Xiao Laoshu."

"Eh?" Qing Qiu’er wasn’t surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s decision to send Nanfeng Yunxi to the Celestial Moon Sect, but she was puzzled by his decision to choose Yan Yinqing and Xiao Laoshi. "Why did you choose the last two women to go to the sect?"

Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained to her. "I heard from Tianshi Shengjie that the Celestial Moon Sect lacks experts in the soul and medical paths, so I chose Yan Yinqing and Xiao Laoshi to go to the sect because they are still virgins. I couldn’t possibly send Elmyra to that sect because she is our main healer, and the rest are no longer virgins. Senior Sister Yingyue is Wu Lianzhi’s mother and Yue Qinhua is Senior Brother Liangren’s wife, so I can’t send them either."

"I see." Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding. "In that case, you should send me out, and I will talk to those three people right away so we can arrange the exchange of disciples with the Celestial Moon Sect as soon as possible. But what about the building for our alchemy shop in the Celestial Moon Domain?"

"I think you should discuss that matter with Yue Xuelian, and it would be great if she could provide a building for us so we don’t have to waste jewels on purchasing a new one." Qing Qiu’er, Yan Jinwu, and Sima Huiqing laughed upon hearing that because Zhang Fei [5] was indeed stingy in spending jewels, and he wanted to use his jewels exclusively for those closest to him. "I’ll send you out now, and you can talk to the three women."
After Zhang Fei [5] sent Qing Qiu’er out of the training space, he continued to dual soul cultivate with Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing.
The Alchemy Hall.
Qing Qiu’er had already sat down with Nanfeng Yunxi, and she informed her about Zhang Fei [5]’s decision to send her to the Celestial Moon Sect, including his plan to open an alchemy shop there.
Nanfeng Yunxi was initially hesitant about it, but she changed her mind after Qing Qiu’er told her that the Celestial Moon Sect was a women-only sect, and she immediately agreed with it.
"You can prepare now, and I’ll take you to the sect after I speak with Yue Xuelian again."
"Yes, Sect Master."
Nanfeng Yunxi immediately returned to her room to prepare everything, and Qing Qiu’er went to the Soul Hall to meet Yan Yinqing.
The Soul Hall.

Qing Qiu’er sat down with Yan Yinqing and explained to her about Zhang Fei’s desire to send her to the Celestial Moon Sect, but her expression showed reluctance to join the sect. She preferred to stay at the Moonlit Passion Temple because her master, parents, brothers, and sisters lived there, and she did not want to be separated from them.
"Do you mind that, Yinqing?"

"Yes," Yan Yinqing nodded to Qing Qiu’er. "I understand the importance of maintaining good relations with the Celestial Moon Sect, but I have no interest in joining that sect. I always have difficulty adapting to new environments, and it takes a long time, which will disrupt my cultivation. Therefore, I don’t want to join that sect, and you can choose someone else."
Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding. "Alright, I won’t force you to go to the Celestial Moon Sect. I will discuss with Zhang Fei [5] to choose another candidate."
"Thank you."
After Qing Qiu’er left, Shang Yingyue walked over to Yan Yinqing. "You don’t want to go to that sect because of our junior brother, right, Senior Sister?"
"Hmm?" Yan Yinqing turned to her. "What—"

"Senior Sister, I’m a woman too, okay?" Shang Yingyue put her arm around her shoulders. "You always say you don’t have feelings for our junior brother, but we know you’ve been in love with him since we were still living in the Three Mortal Realms, so you don’t need to deny it anymore. You’re not willing to admit your feelings to him because he has so many women beside him, right?"

Yan Yinqing looked at Shang Yingyue before releasing a soft sigh. "You’re right about everything, Junior Sister. I’ve been in love with him since we were in the Three Mortal Realms, but I didn’t dare admit my feelings for him. I’ve always dreamed of getting a husband who is completely loyal to me, like your husband is loyal to you. I’ve never fallen in love with any man before, and our junior brother is the first love of my life. I can’t act like all his other wives, including your daughter, and I want him to love only me. Unfortunately, it will never happen because he loves all his wives, and I can’t possibly force him to leave them for me, so I prefer to bury my feelings."
"Why don’t you want to try it first?"

"No." Yan Yinqing shook her head. "I know how I feel, so I don’t want to try that kind of thing, and I prefer to live as I am now. I still love him, but it doesn’t rule out the possibility that I will find another better man in the future, and I might fall in love with that man."

Shang Yingyue nodded in understanding and changed the subject. "If that’s the case, you should accept Qing Qiu’er’s offer to join the Celestial Moon Sect, and you might be able to move on with your life. Moreover, you can return here whenever you want, so I think it shouldn’t be a big deal. If I weren’t married, I wouldn’t think twice about joining the sect, and I would gain a lot of new knowledge there."
"Do you think joining that sect is a good choice for me?"

"I don’t know," Shang Yingyue replied with a slight shake of her head. "I don’t know about the situation in the sect, and your character is difficult to predict, so I don’t know if you’ll be a good fit for the sect or not. However, I think you can give it a try first, and you can tell our junior brother if you’re not comfortable there, so he’ll find someone else to replace you."

Yan Yinqing fell into deep thought after hearing Shang Yingyue’s words. Although she didn’t want to part with them, she felt that going to the sect was the best opportunity to forget Zhang Fei. "You’re right! At least I can try joining there first, and I’ll tell our junior brother if I’m not comfortable there."
"You should contact Sister Qiu and inform her about this."
"Yeah."

"Where is the entry portal to that place actually located?

"Do you think there are other remains of that heretical sect there, Master?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1517: Elders’ Idea
paragraphs: Qing Qiu’er sat opposite Xiao Laoshu and informed her of Zhang Fei’s decision. "What do you think about that? If you don’t want to go to their sect, we won’t force you to go, and we’ll find another candidate to fill the spot."
"Hmm?" Xiao Laoshu turned to Tian Yishen at her side. "What do you think about that? Should I go to the Celestial Moon Sect?"

Tian Yishen nodded at her. "You’ve learned medical techniques for thousands of years, and your skills in this field have already matched mine. It’s time for you to spread your wings, and that sect is the best choice for you because it’s a women-only sect. Moreover, you can come back to this sect whenever you want, so you can come back here when you miss me or need my help."
"You’re right," Xiao Laoshu immediately gave her answer to Qing Qiu’er. "I will go to that sect together with Nanfeng Yunxi and Yan Yinqing, but when will we leave?"

Qing Qiu’er thought for a while. "Since the three of you have agreed, I will contact Yue Xuelian now. Her three disciples are ready to move to our sect, so I think the three of you can move there as soon as possible."
"If so, I’ll go back and get ready now, so we can leave anytime." Xiao Laoshu immediately left the two of them to pack.

Tian Yishen looked at Xiao Laoshu and sighed. She had helped him for thousands of years, so he felt heavy about parting with her. Despite his feelings, he didn’t stop her, and he hoped that she would become a better healer in the future.
"Don’t worry, Laoshu will be fine in the Celestial Moon Sect."

"Yes," Tian Yishen nodded to Qing Qiu’er. "Laoshu is a smart and sociable girl, and there are only women in that sect, so I’m sure she’ll be fine there. Perhaps, she’ll be an even better healer if she leaves my side, and I can’t wait for the day she surpasses me."
"I’ll go meet our elders now."
"Yes."

Qing Qiu’er had arrived at the main hall, and several female elders were waiting for her there. "Soon, three disciples from the Celestial Moon Sect will come to our sect for a disciple exchange program, and I will be entering seclusion with Zhang Fei and the others. I’ll leave the three of them to you all, and you must take excellent care of them. This will be the beginning of a relationship between the two sects, and I hope it will pave the way for us to recruit more disciples in the future."
"Who will join our sect, Sect Master? Who will we send to the Celestial Moon Sect?" Fang Roulan asked.

"From the Celestial Moon Sect, Yue Xuelian decided to send Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan." The elders were surprised to hear the first name because they knew she was the caretaker of the Moon Tower. "From our sect, I will send Nanfeng Yunxi, Yan Yinqing, and Xiao Laoshi. We will also open an alchemy shop in their domain, and Nanfeng Yunxi will manage the shop, assisted by disciples from their sect."

The female elders nodded in understanding, and they were also pleased that their sect could establish a relationship with the Celestial Moon Sect, something that had never happened in the past because their sect was a dual cultivation sect.

Then, Yin Huayan spoke to Qing Qiu’er. "Sect Master, what do you think about changing our sect’s name? As long as the image of a dual cultivation sect persists, we will always have difficulty finding new disciples, so we are considering changing our sect’s name."

Qing Qiu’er raised an eyebrow upon hearing that because the name of the Moonlit Passion Sect was left behind by the past leaders, and she had never once thought about changing the name of their sect. However, she was aware that their sect would never progress if they still used the same name, and that had been proven by their activities to recruit new disciples in the last few months, which only produced a few new disciples.

Qing Qiu’er wanted her sect to become more advanced and bigger because they had worked hard to improve everything, and they had built many halls, including recruiting people from various races. "I will discuss this matter with Zhang Fei first because he prefers to avoid recruiting too many disciples, especially those lacking the ambition to improve. He only wants to recruit those who have steadfastness in cultivation and high ambitions to improve themselves, so our efforts will be fruitful."

The female elders understood Zhang Fei’s wishes because they also had the same wishes as him, and they wanted their sect to develop further, especially after the significant changes they had made. "Please discuss this matter with him and persuade him, Sect Master."
"I will." After the female elders left, Qing Qiu’er contacted Yue Xuelian, informing her of Zhang Fei’s wishes, especially about the building for their alchemy shop.
Thereafter, Qing Qiu’er returned to the mountaintop and awaited Yue Xuelian’s reply, as she needed to discuss the building matter with her sect elders.
After speaking with Qing Qiu’er, Yue Xuelian asked Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan to prepare to go to the Moonlit Passion Temple. She then went to see Yue Qianrou in her room.
"Why are you here, Big Sis?"

"Qing Qiu’er has already selected three disciples to join our sect." Yue Xuelian sat beside her and explained to her about Nanfeng Yunxi, Yan Yinqing, and Xiao Laoshi. "In addition, she hopes that we can provide an empty building for their alchemy shop, and Nanfeng Yunxi will be in charge of the shop. I will assign Yue Mingyi to assist her since they are both alchemists, and our disciples can learn about alchemy from her."

"Even though we’ve agreed to establish a relationship with their sect, we can’t let them move around unsupervised, Big Sis." Yue Qianrou tried to remember a few things. "We can give them the empty southern building for their alchemy shop, which will make it easier for us to monitor them. Moreover, the building is quite large, so it’s suitable for a shop, and we’ll spread the news to the residents of this domain once they open their shop."

"You’re right," Yue Xuelian agreed with her, and she immediately contacted Qing Qiu’er, informing her of their decision regarding the shop. "She said there’s no problem with it, and she’ll send one of her sect’s alchemy gods to arrange the shop."
"I think it’s good." Yue Qianrou then asked her. "So, when will they come here? When will our disciples leave for their sect?"

Yue Xuelian considered it first. "I think Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan can leave for the Moonlit Passion Sect today. As for their disciples, they will probably wait a few days because the alchemy god needs some preparations for the shop, so their three disciples will come here at the same time as her."

"I don’t think it’s a problem." Yue Qianrou immediately contacted one of their sect’s elders. "I’ve asked Yue Wanxian to lead several disciples to clean up the building so that their alchemy god can arrange everything straight away, and she can open the shop faster."

"I hope the cooperation between the two sects will bring many benefits to us." Yue Xuelian immediately stood up from her seat, but Yue Qianrou grabbed her hand. "Is there something you want to talk to me about?"
Yue Qianrou pulled Yue Xuelian to lie on the bed, pinned her down, and held her hands beside her head. "Big sis."
"What is it?"
"Nothing." Yue Qianrou immediately let go of Yue Xuelian’s hand and got up from above her. "I will continue my cultivation."
Yue Xuelian inwardly sighed as she stood up. "Qianrou, you know I always love you, right? If you want something from me, you can tell me directly, and I will fulfill your request."

"I know." Yue Xuelian stared at Yue Qianrou for a while before leaving her room. "Tch! You will never understand my suffering when I turned into a corpse demon! I turned into a demon like this because you left me in that cursed place! Will you fulfill my request if I ask you to become a demon like me?"
Yue Qianrou immediately calmed her anger, closed her eyes, and started cultivating again.
"Sect Master."

Yue Xuelian nodded to Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan. "Since the three of you are ready, you can depart for the Moonlit Passion Temple now. When you guys arrive at the Twin Flames Main Domain, you must contact Qing Qiu’er to pick you up, or you won’t be able to reach her sect due to the numerous formations there."
"Eh?" The three women were surprised by that. "Did they change the domain too, Sect Master?"

"Yes." Yue Xuelian created a qi screen, displaying the situation in the Twin Flames Main Domain, shocking them. "I myself was shocked when I went there because the domain had changed a lot compared to the last time I went there, and they had set up many formations there, including a flight restriction formation. If you don’t contact Qing Qiu’er, you will never be able to go to her sect because the forest is filled with many misleading and illusory formations."
The three women nodded in understanding. "In that case, we’ll head to the Twin Flames Main Domain, and we’ll contact Sect Master Qing once we arrive there."
"Take care."

"I myself was shocked when I went there because the domain had changed a lot compared to the last time I went there, and they had set up many formations there, including a flight restriction formation.
If you don’t contact Qing Qiu’er, you will never be able to go to her sect because the forest is filled with many misleading and illusory formations."
The three women nodded in understanding.
"In that case, we’ll head to the Twin Flames Main Domain, and we’ll contact Sect Master Qing once we arrive there."
"Take care."

chapters.title: Chapter 1518: Three Women Arrives
paragraphs: When the three women arrived at the Twin Flames Main Domain, Qiu Yue was already waiting for them. She immediately enveloped them in her aura before flying them to the floating plateau.

Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan had previously heard about and seen the changes in the Twin Flames Main Domain on the qi screen. However, the feeling was different when they witnessed the changes in the domain in person.

A thousand years ago, they came to the domain to explore the Endless Night Dungeon, but the situation there was far different from what they had seen in the past, with the entire area now covered in dense forests.

They recalled that the domain had hundreds of sects and clans, but the formations covering the entire area made them undetectable. They were truly shocked by this because the domain, which had once been a nest of cultivators, now possessed defenses that surpassed those of other domains; even the Celestial Moon Domain did not have such strong defenses.

Upon arriving at the Moonlit Passion Temple, they were shocked once again to discover that the sect had two guardians as powerful as Yue Xuelian and three layers of formidable barriers. ’Since when did the sect have two guardians with cultivation at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm?’

Qiu Yue introduced the three women to Tian Kui and Serpentera, explaining that they would be joining their sect from that point forward, so the two guardians needed to become acquainted with them. She immediately took them into the sect and led them to the residence of the representatives of other sects, where Tian Zhiling and the others lived.

Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan had already seen that many races lived in the Moonlit Passion Sect, but members of the winged race were not included in their calculations. "You guys can rest for now, and I will take you to look around the sect this morning."
"Elder Yue, I will take them to look around this sect this morning." Qiu Yue nodded to Tian Zhiling and left the area straight away. "Are you surprised to see me here?"
"Why would a winged race like you join a human sect? Did your leader allow you to join this sect?" Yue Liangyu returned the question.

Tian Zhiling shook her head. "There are two camps within my Winged Race: one is my leader’s group and the other is Grand Elder Yizu’s group, and I am part of the latter. I am an unimportant member of my race, so my leader does not know I am here. In fact, Tian Huangjin and Tian Huotian also joined this sect, but they are returning to our domain because our leader has emerged from her seclusion."

"Oh." Yue Liangyu nodded in understanding because she herself had heard about the split within the winged race. One group was loyal to their first ancestor and waited for her return, and another group contained people who wanted to be independent and free from her influence. "They are Yue Liuxian and Yue Bingxuan, and the three of us will be the unofficial disciples of this sect from today."
"I know." Tian Zhiling nodded at her. "Sect Master Qing has already explained everything to me, and she asked me to help you three adapt to the environment in this sect."
"I see." Yue Liangyu nodded in understanding.
"Are you okay with them being here?" Yue Liuxian suddenly asked, pointing her index finger at the female demons gathered not far away.

"Haha," Tian Zhiling laughed softly. "Like the three of you, I was also surprised by the presence of demons in this sect. I’ve lived here since the opening ceremony, so I’m used to their presence. They are not like other demons, and they don’t have bad thoughts or intentions, so the situation went smoothly. If the three of you live with them for the next few days, you guys will understand what I mean."

Yue Liuxian nodded to her. "This is the first time I’ve seen humans, demons, and winged races living in one place. Therefore, I’m not used to the situation yet, and I may need a few days to adapt to it."

"It’s okay; that’s completely understandable, but you’ll gradually get used to their presence." They looked at the two female demihumans who had just arrived. "They’re Long Xiaolian and Huli Wanqing."
"Oh? New disciples?" Huli Wanqing asked in surprise.
Tian Zhiling immediately introduced the three women. "They are Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan from the Celestial Moon Sect, and they will be joining us starting today."

"The Celestial Moon Sect is a women-only sect, right?" Long Xiaolian asked them. "I’ve met members of your sect when I ventured into the Thousand River Domain in the past. If I remember correctly, their names were Yue Yuyao and Yue Xianyan, and we spent quite a long time together."
Yue Liuxian nodded at her. "Those two women are our juniors, and they are going to another domain to carry out a mission. Do you two feel comfortable in this sect?"

"Hehe," Long Xiaolian giggled. "At first, I was worried that they wouldn’t accept me because I’m a demihuman, but the people here are nice, and they accepted us as one of their own. I found excellent masters in both the sword path and body cultivation path, so I’m pleased to have joined this sect. Although their cultivation is far below mine, their understanding of both fields far surpasses mine, and I’ve learned a lot from them."

"Me too," Huli Wanqing said with a nod. "Master Lin Jingxia has profound knowledge in the field of alchemy, and she has already reached the alchemy god rank, even though her cultivation is still at the Celestial Lord Realm. I am much stronger than her in cultivation, but I am inferior to her in alchemy, and I learned many new things about it from her."
Yue Liangyu nodded in understanding to the two women, but Yue Liuxian showed an expression of impatience for morning, as she couldn’t wait to explore the areas of the Moonlit Passion Temple.
"Do you know where Helian Xun’er is?" Yue Bingxuan asked Tian Zhiling.
Tian Zhiling shook her head. "Helian Xun’er was one of Zhang Fei’s wives, and she entered into seclusion with him and his other wives."
"Oh?" Yue Bingxuan was surprised by that.

"She’s right, Bingxuan." Yue Bingxuan turned to Yue Liangyu. "I met Helian Xun’er and Princess Tianshi at the Moon Tower, and they were both Zhang Fei’s wives. I don’t think they’ll be coming out of seclusion anytime soon, so you’ll have to wait some time to meet her."
"I see." Yue Bingxuan nodded at her.

"Do you three want to see an interesting place? You guys can cultivate faster there because the concentration of Yin Qi there is higher than anywhere else." The three disciples of the Celestial Moon Sect agreed with that, so Tian Zhiling immediately led them to the Celestial Yin Lake, but the two female demihumans did not join them.
They had already arrived at the edge of the Celestial Yin Lake, and the three disciples of the Celestial Moon Sect could feel the strong Yin Qi emanating from within the lake.
Yue Bingxuan crouched by the side and dipped his hand into the water. "The Yin Qi in this lake is truly strong, and I’ve never felt anything this strong anywhere else."
"Let me try." Yue Liuxian did the same with her friend and the results surprised her. "Where did this lake come from? How could this lake form naturally on such a floating plateau?"

Tian Zhiling spoke directly to her. "This lake is related to an old story in this domain, but I don’t know much about it myself, so I can’t explain it to you. The three of you are part of this sect now, so you can cultivate in this lake if you like. You guys don’t need to worry about those male disciples and elders because they don’t cultivate here, and they do it in the Celestial Yang Lake in the Blazing Union Sect."
"What about that residence?" Yue Liangyu pointed her finger to the side.

"Oh!" Tian Zhiling explained to her directly. "That residence is Zhang Fei’s, but he hardly ever stays there. Usually, all of his wives gather there, especially when they’re not in seclusion. Moreover, he’s not a peeping tom, so you don’t need to worry about him."

Yue Liangyu didn’t comment on that and took off her dress, followed by Yue Bingxuan and Yue Liuxian. After the three of them were naked, they immediately entered the Celestial Yin Lake, absorbing the Yin Qi within. ’This Yin Qi is truly powerful! I didn’t expect that this sect had such a secret, and no one ever knew about it.’
Tian Zhiling shook her head as she watched the three women quickly sink into their cultivation, and she left the area to return to her room.
Qing Qiu’er watched the three women from the mountaintop with a smile. "Are your preparations complete, Nanfeng Yunxi?"
"Yes."

"I see." Qing Qiu’er nodded slightly. "Lin Jingxia will be going with you to the Celestial Moon Sect this morning, and the people from the sect have already prepared an empty building for our alchemy shop. Zhang Fei wants you to manage the shop and teach alchemy to the sect’s disciples, but you don’t need to teach them anything too profound."
Nanfeng Yunxi certainly understood Zhang Fei’s intentions. "I’ll head back now, and I’ll leave for the sect in the morning."
"Alright."

chapters.title: Chapter 1519: Join The Celestial Moon Sect
paragraphs: Lin Jingxia, Nanfeng Yunxi, Yan Yinqing, and Xiao Laoshu were already standing in front of Qing Qiu’er, who was briefing them about various aspects of the Celestial Moon Sect. "The four of you can leave for the sect now, and Yue Xuelian will meet you at the sect gate."
"Yes, Sister Qing."
After the four women left, Qing Qiu’er went to the Celestial Yin Lake to check on Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan.
When she arrived there, Qing Qiu’er saw the three women still focused on absorbing the Yin Qi within the lake, with the elders from the Moonlit Passion Temple cultivating in another area of the lake.
A portal suddenly opened beside Qing Qiu’er, and Helian Xun’er walked out of it. "Hehe! I haven’t seen Yue Bingxuan for a long time, so I asked Zhang Fei to send me out."
"What plans does he have for the three women?"

"He’s not interested in them, so he doesn’t have any plans for them." Helian Xun’er looked at Yue Bingxuan. "I’m familiar with her, and our relationship is like that of siblings, so I want her to be his wife."

Qing Qiu’er looked at Yue Bingxuan, and she felt that she was far superior to the other two, making her worthy of becoming a member of Zhang Fei’s harem. However, he had changed a lot since ascending to the Paradise Realm, and he had limited himself in his pursuit of women.

"I know he limits himself in looking for new women, but I am sure that he will not reject Yue Bingxuan, and I will make sure that happens." After she said that, Helian Xun’er immediately took off her dress and entered the Celestial Yin lake, swimming towards the three women.
Qing Qiu’er knew Zhang Fei was busy with Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing, so she did not return to the training space; instead, she went somewhere else to take care of something.
Yue Bingxuan’s eyelashes trembled as she felt Helian Xun’er’s embrace around her waist, so she immediately opened her eyes and turned to her. "Xun’er?"

"Hehe." Helian Xun’er giggled and hugged Yue Bingxuan. "It’s been a long time since I last saw you, Sister Bingxuan. The last time was when I asked for ingredients to make the spirit wine, and I have been busy at the Star Tower ever since."
"Yes." Yue Bingxuan nodded and hugged her back. "I’m glad that you’re alright, Xun’er."
Helian Xun’er immediately let go of their embrace and pulled Yue Bingxuan to the side of the lake. "I still didn’t expect that Yue Xuelian would send you here."

"My coming to this sect was actually Vice Sect Master Qianrou’s idea." Helian Xun’er felt a bit surprised by Yue Bingxuan’s statement, and she began to wonder about Yue Qianrou’s true intentions. "I originally didn’t want to join this sect, mainly because it is a dual cultivation sect. However, I immediately agreed after Sect Master Xuelian told me about the changes in this sect, and she also told me that you were here."

Helian Xun’er nodded slightly. "This sect has changed since Zhang Fei’s arrival, and we have various halls now. If you want to learn in any field, you can go to those halls and learn from them. Jian Kuang is the best in the Sword Hall. Hun Di’s capacity as a soul cultivator is beyond doubt, and he is much more skilled than the people in the Immortal Soul Palace, so you can learn that field from him. If you want to deepen your knowledge in the body cultivation path, you can go to the Body Hall and meet Cai Yinzhi."
"What about formation arrays and domains?"

"Oh." Helian Xun’er just remembered that Yue Bingxuan was genuinely interested in those two fields. "You can learn about formation arrays from Sister Duanmu Luolan, and you can go to Sister Shangguan Yan if you want to learn about domains. However, they are currently in seclusion with Zhang Fei, so you will have to wait a long time to meet them; instead, you can learn from Liao Hanxue and Yuan Hao while you wait for them to return."
"I know about Liao Hanxue, but who is Yuan Hao?"
"Yuan Hao is Duanmu Luolan’s son, but you don’t need to worry about him because he is already married to Shangguan Miyuan, and he is not a dual cultivator."

"Oh." Yue Bingxuan nodded slightly, and she had no problem learning from Yuan Hao as long as she could learn more things about domains. "Why did you leave your seclusion? I heard that you are already one of Zhang Fei’s wives, so you should accompany him."

"Hehe," Helian Xun’er giggled. "I’ve liked Zhang Fei ever since he challenged the Star Tower, and his cultivation only broke through to the Earth Realm then. However, I’m not his wife yet, and I’m still training to improve myself in several areas, especially my speed and body strength."
"How did you improve both of them?" Yue Bingxuan asked in a curious manner.

Helian Xun’er smiled amusedly when she saw Yue Bingxuan’s expression, and she took out a bottle of Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi before handing it to her. "I increased my body strength using this, and I increased my speed using another method."
Yue Bingxuan received the bottle, opened the lid, and smelled its contents. "This."
"Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi," Helian Xun’er said as she nodded.
"Why are you giving it to me?"

"It can help you become stronger." Helian Xun’er looked at her. "Even though you are a disciple of the Celestial Moon Sect, I know you are different from them because we have known each other for a long time. The effect will not be optimal without his dual cultivation technique, but you can try his yang qi if you wish, and you will definitely be surprised by its power."

Yue Bingxuan seemed undecided by that and thought about it over and over again, especially since she had never swallowed any man’s Yang Qi before. Helian Xun’er also didn’t force her to swallow it and waited for her to decide for herself, but she hoped that she would use it.

After thinking for some time, Yue Bingxuan decided to drink Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi in the bottle. She was surprised because she couldn’t taste or smell anything from it, but she could feel the power of his yang qi.
"What do you think of his yang qi?"

"I’m like drinking plain water, and it doesn’t smell at all." Yue Bingxuan raised both hands and clenched her fists. "I don’t feel any effects, but I can feel the power of his yang qi, and my body is getting warmer because of it."

Helian Xun’er nodded at her. "I felt the same way when I first ingested his yang qi, but the effects were noticeable after I combined it with his dual cultivation technique. If you like, I can teach you that technique, and you can experience its great benefits for yourself."

"No." Yue Bingxuan rejected her offer with a shake of her head. "I enjoy learning new things, but I’ve never thought about becoming a dual cultivator, and I’ll strive to become strong on my own. Let’s talk about something else; we haven’t seen each other for a long time, so I want you to tell me a lot about yourself, including your relationship with Zhang Fei."
Helian Xun’er told Yue Bingxuan everything, starting with everything that had happened since they last met.
Lin Jingxia, Nanfeng Yunxi, Yan Yinqing, and Xiao Laoshu had already arrived at the Celestial Moon Sect. Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou welcomed them, bringing them into their sect.

Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou seemed confused because their cultivation was still at the Celestial Lord Realm, but Lin Jingxia informed them that they had come from the Three Mortal Realms several years ago. "So, which of you four will join our sect?"

"They will join this sect, and I will only help to organize our alchemy shop." After Lin Jingxia pointed at them, Yue Qianrou looked at the other three women. "Nanfeng Yunxi is an alchemist, and her abilities are already very high. Although she has not yet reached the God Rank, she will reach that stage soon."
"What about you two?" Yue Xuelian asked the other two women.

Yan Yinqing surprised Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou by activating her soul domain. "I may not have reached the level of my master or junior brother, but I am one of the best in the soul cultivation path. I heard that your sect is not that skilled in that field, and I can teach them to deepen their abilities in that field."
"Yes." Yue Xuelian nodded at her. "The best soul cultivators in our sect are Yue Bingxuan and Elder Yue Yanyue, but they are still far behind expert soul cultivators like Hun Lingwu."

Yan Yinqing turned angry after hearing Hun Lingwu’s name. "Tch! Please don’t mention that old bastard’s name in front of me! If only my strength was enough to fight him, I would have castrated his dick!"
"Eh?" Both Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were surprised by that. "Do you have a problem with Hun Lingwu?"

"That old bastard used unconventional methods to influence Senior Sister Jing Qiuyue and me, making us constantly think about him." After Yan Yinqing made that statement, Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou exchanged glances. "Fortunately, our junior brother has already done something about that old man, and we are finally free from his influence."
"Who is your junior brother?"
"Zhang Fei."

If you want to learn in any field, you can go to those halls and learn from them.
Jian Kuang is the best in the Sword Hall.
Hun Di’s capacity as a soul cultivator is beyond doubt, and he is much more skilled than the people in the Immortal Soul Palace, so you can learn that field from him.
If you want to deepen your knowledge in the body cultivation path, you can go to the Body Hall and meet Cai Yinzhi."
"What about formation arrays and domains?"
"Oh." Helian Xun’er just remembered that Yue Bingxuan was genuinely interested in those two fields.
"You can learn about formation arrays from Sister Duanmu Luolan, and you can go to Sister Shangguan Yan if you want to learn about domains.
However, they are currently in seclusion with Zhang Fei, so you will have to wait a long time to meet them; instead, you can learn from Liao Hanxue and Yuan Hao while you wait for them to return."
"I know about Liao Hanxue, but who is Yuan Hao?"
"Yuan Hao is Duanmu Luolan’s son, but you don’t need to worry about him because he is already married to Shangguan Miyuan, and he is not a dual cultivator."
"Oh." Yue Bingxuan nodded slightly, and she had no problem learning from Yuan Hao as long as she could learn more things about domains.
"Why did you leave your seclusion?
I heard that you are already one of Zhang Fei’s wives, so you should accompany him."
"Hehe," Helian Xun’er giggled.
"I’ve liked Zhang Fei ever since he challenged the Star Tower, and his cultivation only broke through to the Earth Realm then.
However, I’m not his wife yet, and I’m still training to improve myself in several areas, especially my speed and body strength."
"How did you improve both of them?" Yue Bingxuan asked in a curious manner.
Helian Xun’er smiled amusedly when she saw Yue Bingxuan’s expression, and she took out a bottle of Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi before handing it to her.
"I increased my body strength using this, and I increased my speed using another method."
Yue Bingxuan received the bottle, opened the lid, and smelled its contents.
"This."
"Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi," Helian Xun’er said as she nodded.
"Why are you giving it to me?"
"It can help you become stronger." Helian Xun’er looked at her.
"Even though you are a disciple of the Celestial Moon Sect, I know you are different from them because we have known each other for a long time.
The effect will not be optimal without his dual cultivation technique, but you can try his yang qi if you wish, and you will definitely be surprised by its power."
Yue Bingxuan seemed undecided by that and thought about it over and over again, especially since she had never swallowed any man’s Yang Qi before.
Helian Xun’er also didn’t force her to swallow it and waited for her to decide for herself, but she hoped that she would use it.
After thinking for some time, Yue Bingxuan decided to drink Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi in the bottle.
She was surprised because she couldn’t taste or smell anything from it, but she could feel the power of his yang qi.
"What do you think of his yang qi?"
"I’m like drinking plain water, and it doesn’t smell at all." Yue Bingxuan raised both hands and clenched her fists.
"I don’t feel any effects, but I can feel the power of his yang qi, and my body is getting warmer because of it."
Helian Xun’er nodded at her.
"I felt the same way when I first ingested his yang qi, but the effects were noticeable after I combined it with his dual cultivation technique.
If you like, I can teach you that technique, and you can experience its great benefits for yourself."
"No." Yue Bingxuan rejected her offer with a shake of her head.
"I enjoy learning new things, but I’ve never thought about becoming a dual cultivator, and I’ll strive to become strong on my own.
Let’s talk about something else; we haven’t seen each other for a long time, so I want you to tell me a lot about yourself, including your relationship with Zhang Fei."
Helian Xun’er told Yue Bingxuan everything, starting with everything that had happened since they last met.
Lin Jingxia, Nanfeng Yunxi, Yan Yinqing, and Xiao Laoshu had already arrived at the Celestial Moon Sect.
Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou welcomed them, bringing them into their sect.

Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou seemed confused because their cultivation was still at the Celestial Lord Realm, but Lin Jingxia informed them that they had come from the Three Mortal Realms several years ago.
"So, which of you four will join our sect?"
"They will join this sect, and I will only help to organize our alchemy shop." After Lin Jingxia pointed at them, Yue Qianrou looked at the other three women.
"Nanfeng Yunxi is an alchemist, and her abilities are already very high.
Although she has not yet reached the God Rank, she will reach that stage soon."
"What about you two?" Yue Xuelian asked the other two women.
Yan Yinqing surprised Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou by activating her soul domain.
"I may not have reached the level of my master or junior brother, but I am one of the best in the soul cultivation path.
I heard that your sect is not that skilled in that field, and I can teach them to deepen their abilities in that field."
"Yes." Yue Xuelian nodded at her.
"The best soul cultivators in our sect are Yue Bingxuan and Elder Yue Yanyue, but they are still far behind expert soul cultivators like Hun Lingwu."
Yan Yinqing turned angry after hearing Hun Lingwu’s name.
"Tch!
Please don’t mention that old bastard’s name in front of me!
If only my strength was enough to fight him, I would have castrated his dick!"
"Eh?" Both Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were surprised by that.
"Do you have a problem with Hun Lingwu?"

"That old bastard used unconventional methods to influence Senior Sister Jing Qiuyue and me, making us constantly think about him." After Yan Yinqing made that statement, Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou exchanged glances.
"Fortunately, our junior brother has already done something about that old man, and we are finally free from his influence."
"Who is your junior brother?"
"Zhang Fei."

chapters.title: Chapter 1520: Yue Qianrou’s Thoughts
paragraphs: Yue Xuelian was curious about Zhang Fei, but she wasn’t curious about him personally, but rather about his abilities, especially after hearing so much about him from Yue Yuling. She was one of the cultivators who had long stood at the top of the cultivation world in the Paradise Realm, but she had never heard of someone who possessed abilities in so many fields at once.

Yue Qianrou thought of something she had never considered before. ’If Zhang Fei possesses such outstanding abilities, could he possibly find a way to reverse my corpse demon transformation and return me to human form? He is in seclusion now, and Qing Qiu’er says that he won’t be coming out anytime soon. I will try to find him in the future, and I hope he has a way to turn me back into a human again.’
"Does that mean he takes care of all your sect’s affairs?"

"No." Yan Yinqing shook her head at Yue Xuelian. "My junior brother has never liked dealing with sect matters, so all sect matters remain in the hands of Sister Qiu’er, Sister Feiling, and the elder. Even so, he fully supports our sect, and he provides many things for the disciples, including pills."
"Zhang Fei is the best among us in alchemy, and I have learned a lot from him in the past years." Ling Jingxia added.
"I’ve heard about that, and I heard he’s also an expert in many fields." Yue Xuelian then looked at Xiao Laoshu. "If I may ask, what field are you in?"

"Medical." Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were surprised once again. "I have studied medical knowledge for thousands of years, and I used to manage one of the best clinics in the Xianjin Realm. Although I am confident in my medical abilities, I cannot be satisfied , and I want to continue to improve them. When Sister Qiu’er asked me to join this sect, I immediately agreed to her request."
"Our sect has many healers, but only a few have extensive abilities in that field, so I hope you are willing to work with them to improve the health aspect in this sect."
"That’s what I came here for."
Thereafter, Yue Xuelian led Lin Jingxia and Nanfeng Yunxi to an empty building, which they would use as their alchemy shop.

Meanwhile, Yue Qianrou took Xiao Laoshu to see the sect healers, and she left her there after introducing them. She then led Yan Yinqing to another location and asked her. "Is Zhang Fei’s ability really that great?"
"Hmm?" Yan Yinqing turned to her. "Which ability of his are you referring to? If you’re asking about dual cultivation skills, he—"
"No," Yue Qianrou interrupted her. "I’m not interested in dual cultivation, so I don’t want to hear about it, but I want to know his other abilities."
"Like?"
"Does he have an ability to reverse a curse technique?"

Yan Yinqing first recalled all of Zhang Fei’s abilities that he had used in the past. "My junior brother indeed has many abilities, but I have never seen him use an ability to break a curse before. He may have such a technique, but I don’t know for sure about all his abilities, so you should meet him and ask him directly."
"Zhang Fei is still in seclusion, right?"

"Yes." Yan Yinqing nodded at her. "I don’t know how long he’ll be in seclusion this time, but he already said that he won’t come out before all his wives reach the Celestial King Realm, so I think they’ll be in there for a very long time.
"I see," Yue Qianrou sighed in her heart. "I heard he has hundreds of wives, so it will probably take him decades to help them all break through to the Celestial King Realm."

’Haha! If you knew about his training space, you would definitely be shocked by it. Moreover, my junior brother’s yang qi is stronger than any man’s, so I don’t think they would take that long.’ Yan Yinqing naturally wouldn’t tell Yue Qianrou about it because it was Zhang Fei’s secret, and she was an outsider. "Why don’t you try asking someone else for help?"
Yue Qianrou shook her head. "I’ve asked several people for help, but none of them can help me."
"What kind of curse has affected you?"
"I’m not affected by any curse, but my distant family is, so I want to find someone who understands curse techniques to save her."
’What a liar.’ Yan Yinqing didn’t comment on that; instead, she asked Yue Qianrou, mainly about the rules in the Celestial Moon Sect.

Soon, they arrived at the elder’s hall, and Yue Qianrou left Yan Yinqing with Yue Yanyue, who was also a soul cultivator. The female elder took her elsewhere, and they talked about many things there, especially about the path of soul cultivation.
Yue Xuelian had already brought Lin Jingxia and Nanfeng Yunxi to the empty building, and she left the two women there.
"I feel that this sect is really gloomy, Senior Jingxia."
Ling Jingxia nodded in agreement. "After all, this sect is a women-only sect, and most women stick to their groups, so the situation here is much different from that in the Moonlit Passion Sect."
"Phew! I hope this sect is different from the female sect in my old realm."
"Are all the women in the sect having romantic relationships with each other?"

"Yes! They are all lilies! I was shocked the first time I joined that sect, and I immediately ran away, even though I had only been there for a day." Lin Jingxia smiled when she saw Nanfeng Yunxi’s terrified expression. "I hope the disciples in this sect don’t like those women, or I’ll run away from here and return to our sect."

Lin Jingxia nodded at her. "You can return to our sect if you are not comfortable here, and I’m sure Zhang Fei will understand your reasons. Let’s start arranging the pills so we can open this shop as soon as possible, and I will stay here to help you for a few days."
"Alright."
Meanwhile, Tian Zhiling and Helian Xun’er took Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan to look around all the halls in the Moonlit Passion Temple so they could make their choices.
Yue Liangyu and Yue Liuxian repeatedly turned to look at Yue Bingxuan, mainly because they felt the presence of a man’s yang qi in her body.

Yue Liuxian was simply curious about the owner of the yang qi within Yue Bingxuan’s body, but she didn’t ask anything. On the other hand, Yue Liangyu seemed annoyed by it, and she stole a glance at Helian Xun’er, who was walking ahead of them. ’Tch! She must have given Zhang Fei’s yang qi to Bingxuan! They have a close relationship, and she is one of his wives, so I think she is trying to pull her over to his side.’

Yue Liangyu didn’t ask Helian Xun’er anything, but she believed her guess was correct, and the yang qi inside Yue Bingxiuan’s body belonged to Zhang Fei. However, she didn’t expect her sect sister to consume his yang qi, especially since it was forbidden in their sect.

After they toured all the halls of the Moonlit Passion Temple, Yue Liangyu decided to join the Sword Hall because she was a female swordmaster, and she wanted to learn more about the sword path from Jian Kuang.
Yue Liuxian decided to join the Assassin Hall and the Speed Hall because they were related to each other, but she also decided to join the Book Hall to gain new knowledge.

Meanwhile, Yue Bingxuan decided to try all the halls because she was interested in all fields, but the ones that piqued her interest were the Soul Hall and the Body Hall. She considered the two complementary for her, so she decided to join them both. Although Hong Quan and Cai Yinzhi were much weaker than her, she didn’t underestimate them. As for Hun Di, he was indeed weaker than her, but his soul level was far above hers, and she was eager to train under his guidance.
After that, Tian Zhiling left them and went to the Medical Hall, and Helian Xun’er returned to the training space to continue her training.
Qing Qiu’er also returned to the training space after she left some messages to the elders, and she immediately went to see Zhang Fei [5], informing him about the three women’s decision.
"I didn’t expect that Xun’er would give my Yang Qi to Yue Bingxuan."

"Hehe." Qing Qiu’er took off her dress. "Helian Xun’er and Yue Bingxuan have been friends for a long time, and their relationship is like that of sisters, so she probably wants to draw her into your harem. Moreover, that woman is interesting, and she’s interested in many things like you; otherwise, she wouldn’t have joined all the halls. Therefore, you should consider taking her into your harem, and she will be very helpful to us."

Zhang Fei [5] pulled Qing Qiu’er into his lap and kneaded her breasts. "I already told you that I don’t want to add members to my harem for now, right? I want to focus on all of you now, and I will also focus on getting those who are already by my side, like Nalan Shizhe, Tianshi Shengjie, Helian Xun’er, and a few others."
"Alright! I won’t force you to take Yue Bingxuan into your harem." Qing Qiu’er pushed him onto the bed as she released her soul and nine avatars. "Let’s do it now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1521: Seven Days Later
paragraphs: Qing Qiu’er had already inserted Zhang Fei’s dick into her body, but she didn’t move her body. They began to cultivate their dual souls, with their avatars cultivating beside them. "The elders gave me the idea to change the name of our sect, so it will be easier for us to develop it. As long as we use the name of the Moonlit Passion Temple, we will have a difficult time recruiting disciples because of our past reputation, let alone recruit those with high talent."

"They are indeed right about that," Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement. "However, they are also wrong about that because a sect’s reputation is not built overnight, and we need to work hard to build it. "Our sect has undergone significant changes, and we now offer many more beneficial opportunities than other sects. Those disciples will be at their own loss if they don’t want to join us, especially because we can give them much better opportunities than those sects."
"So, we will maintain our sect’s name?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] decided without hesitation. "The name of our sect is inherited from our seniors, and I have always respected the legacy of my predecessors, so I do not wish to change the name of our sect. We don’t need to worry about the number of our disciples now, as their number will continue to grow over time, and we just need to do a few other things to attract their attention to our sect."
"For example?"

"We can hold competitions with other sects, and we will do it in public places so they can see our abilities firsthand." Qing Qiu’er raised an eyebrow, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained to her. "Competitions don’t need to involve fighting, and we can do it using other methods, such as alchemy, blacksmithing, and others."
Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding. "When will we hold those competitions?"
"After our seclusion."

"Isn’t that too long?" Qing Qiu’er asked with a frown. "You said that we’ll stay in seclusion until they break through to the Celestial King Realm, and the majority of their cultivation is still at the Celestial Lord Realm. Besides, they’re different from you because you can dual cultivate with all of us, so I think it will take them years or even decades to reach that level."

"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] kneaded her breasts. "Why are you so impatient? We made all those changes in a year and a half, remember? We don’t need to rush with the next change, and we need to take one step at a time. If we change too quickly, the other sects will not let us continue to develop, including the Divine Samsara Sect."

Qing Qiu’er thought about his words before speaking. "The Divine Samsara Sect still hasn’t made a move right now, and some of them are on good terms with us, such as Jin Nanqing, Luo Lianjin, and Xuan Yun. If our sect changes too drastically and surpasses them, they might turn against us. We do have Feng Yao’s protection, but we can’t keep relying on her, and we must be able to protect our sect."

"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] nodded to her. "I am grateful for Feng Yao’s protection, but we still have to rely on ourselves to protect our sect. Although our sect has changed, the strength of our members is still not on par with those powerful sects. Thus, we must continue to improve our abilities and strength so they won’t be able to suppress or oppress us in the future, and our path to becoming the strongest sect will be smoother."
"You’re right," Qing Qiu’er agreed. "Let’s start our dual cultivation, and I’ll help you break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm as soon as possible."
"Let’s do it."

Four women walked into the main room, and they saw Zhang Chen sitting on Zhang Fei’s lap with their genitals connected to each other. They didn’t move and sat quietly with their eyes closed, and their souls were the same as their bodies.

Meanwhile, all the other women sat on the side of the room while cultivating, with dozens of Zhang Fei’s tails coiled around their waists, channeling his yang qi into their bodies. His soul also released many tails that wrapped around all the women’s souls.

A giant Yin-Yang diagram formed above them, with a white aura covering Zhang Fei’s body and countless black auras covering the bodies of all the women. In addition, a giant black and white lotus continued to rotate in their midst, channeling their qi and soul power into each other’s souls.
"What kind of technique is this?" Tian Yaoqin looked at the lotus and the Yin-Yang Diagram.

Qi Qingxiu immediately explained to her. "This technique is the Lotus Ascension Art, the signature technique of the Moonlit Passion Sect. Zhang Fei said that all women who have unwavering hearts and absolute trust in him can create a black lotus within their souls. All the women can combine it with his white lotus to create a black and white lotus, which accelerates the increase in their soul power. You and Mingran became his women not long ago, and you guys still don’t have unwavering hearts and absolute trust in him, so you can’t create it yet."

"Zhang Fei once told me about that technique during my first dual cultivation session with one of his clones." Dong Xuanyin pointed to the lotus. "Although I haven’t experienced the effects of that technique, I can sense that the Yin and Yang Qi flowing through their bodies is strong, much stronger than usual. At first, I was confused by their cultivation speed, but I figured it out after seeing the technique."
"Does that mean you’ve formed your black lotus, Qingxiu?" Ye Mingran asked her.

"Hey! I’ve never had another man in my life, and Zhang Fei is the first. Moreover, we’ve been together for quite some time, so I formed my black lotus long ago." Qi Qingxiu proved it by removing her soul from her body, allowing the three women to see the black lotus within. "Even though I have created it, my lotus has not yet fully bloomed like his other wives’, mainly because they already formed their lotuses decades ago. He told me that to make it bloom, I have to dual soul cultivate with him more often, but I can’t do that because I still have to improve myself, so I divide my time by practicing at the training ground."
"Unwavering hearts and absolute trust, huh?"

"Yes." Qi Qingxiu turned to them. "You both did have husbands in the past, but they died long ago. Therefore, you guys must banish their memories from your hearts, or you will never be able to form the black lotus in your souls."

Ye Mingran and Tian Yaoqin didn’t refute Qi Qingxiu. Although they had surrendered their bodies to Zhang Fei, they still held the memories of their husbands in their hearts. Their husbands were long dead, but they had been together for so long, so they couldn’t forget their memories so easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 1522: Divine Samsara Sect’s History
paragraphs: Night falls quickly.
Lin Jingxia and Nanfeng Yunxi calculated the income from their alchemy shop for a day, and the results were much greater than they had previously expected.

"Phew!" Nanfeng Yunxi leaned back in her chair. "The people in this domain are truly wealthy, Senior Jingxia. Fortunately, we have a large stock of pills because we’ve concocted many over the past decade, plus Zhang Fei’s. Otherwise, the buyers’ demand would overwhelm us, and we would lack a lot of stock."

Lin Jingxia nodded in agreement. "Of all the pills, Zhang Fei’s seven basic pills sold the most this day, which proved that his previous guess about the weakness of basic pills in this realm was correct. We even increased the stock of basic pills several times, but they always sold out."

"That’s true." Nanfeng Yunxi took the shop sales report book. "Healing pills, recovery pills, qi essence pills, nine-cycle vitality pills, phoenix restoration pills, and several others are also selling well today. Fortunately, Zhang Fei has provided us with enough stock to last for several months; otherwise, we wouldn’t be able to sell any more, as all the items were sold out in just one day. We also sold many body tempering liquids, created by the Hong Clan."

Lin Jingxia nodded slightly. "Apart from Zhang Fei’s pills, our pills are also selling significantly, and we have to concoct them again so we don’t run out of stock. However, not many people in the domain have become beast tamers because beast pills haven’t sold well, and our stock has only decreased by ten percent from the initial stock."

"You’re right, Jingxia." Lin Jingxia and Nanfeng Yunxi turned to Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou, who had just arrived. "Our sect doesn’t have many beast tamers, and we also don’t have beast races in our sect, so your beast pills won’t sell very well here."
"I see." Lin Jingxia nodded in understanding. "I don’t think it’s a problem because beast pills are supplementary pills, and they’re expensive."
"Were the majority of the pills in this shop concocted by Zhang Fei?" Yue Qianrou asked.

Lin Jingxia nodded at her. "Even though I am a god-rank alchemist, my ability in concocting pills is not as fast as Zhang Fei’s. To concoct the same pills, I need a few weeks or a few months, but he can concoct them in a few days."
"How can Zhang Fei concoct pills so quickly?"

"Zhang Fei has never concocted pills in front of me, so I don’t know how he was able to concoct them so quickly." Then, Lin Jingxia reminded them. "Even though we’ve opened an alchemy shop here, I hope you won’t drastically reduce your purchases of pills from the Divine Samsara Sect. You should gradually reduce them. If you stop your purchases immediately, they’ll become suspicious, and we don’t want to have any problems with them. They’re much stronger than us now, and they wield considerable influence in this realm."
Yue Xuelian herself already understood the situation in their realm. "Don’t worry, we won’t stop purchasing items from the Divine Samsara Sect, but I will reduce our purchases gradually."
"Yeah." Lin Jingxia turned to Nanfeng Yunxi. "You should be able to handle this shop by yourself, right? I’m going back to our sect now, and you can contact me if you need help."

Nanfeng Yunxi nodded at her. "Since several other alchemists from this sect helped me, I don’t think I will be overwhelmed in handling this shop. If I need additional pills, I will contact you directly, and you can send someone here."
"Alright." After she said goodbye to Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou, Lin Jingxia immediately left the Celestial Moon Sect to return to the Moonlit Passion Sect.
"I’ll go back to my room, Big Sis." Yue Qianrou instantly disappeared from their sight.
"Yunxi, close this shop and go rest." After saying that, Yue Xuelian left the shop and returned to her private quarters.

Nanfeng Yunxi quickly tidied up everything in the shop, and she left a few minutes later. She was sure that customers would still be flocking to the shop tomorrow, and Lin Jingxia had already returned to the Moonlit Passion Temple, so she needed plenty of rest to handle everything herself.

In her private quarters, Yue Xuelian sat cross-legged on her bed. She felt restless because of something, which started after her meeting with Feng Yao last time. She had repeatedly checked her body, but she could never find anything. "What exactly did Empress Huo inject into my body at that time? Ever since she injected it into my body, I’ve felt many emotions I’d never felt before. I also feel a connection with someone, but I don’t know the identity of that person."
Yue Xuelian closed her eyes to cultivate, and a faint crimson color immediately enveloped her body, which came from Feng Yao’s crimson flame that she had injected into her body a week ago.

Yue Xuelian’s expression changed as an image of a person slowly appeared in her mind, but she didn’t recognize the person because they had never met before, which made her wonder about the person’s identity and Feng Yao’s purpose for doing that to her.

Yue Xuelian tried to erase the image of that person from her mind, but she couldn’t; instead, it grew clearer in her mind. She chose to ignore it and tried to focus on cultivating, but she suddenly saw an unusual sight even though her eyes were closed.

Yue Xuelian’s face turned red as she saw the sight, and she tried to erase it, but it grew clearer with each passing moment. Once the image became completely clear, she was shocked when she recognized some of the people in it.

"What’s really going on? Why can I see all those naked women? Moreover, two of the women are Demon God Qi Qingxiu and Demon God Ye Mingran, and dozens of other women come from various races." Yue Xuelian opened her eyes, breathed in the night air, and tried to remember something. "Could all those women be Zhang Fei’s wives? What were they doing? How could I see them? All the women were sitting around him, and his many tails curled around their naked bodies, which means I saw what he saw. Besides, I could see a giant black and white lotus floating in the middle of them, and the Yin-Yang diagram was spinning above them continuously."

Yue Xuelian closed her eyes and observed their activities. She realized that all the women were dual soul cultivating with Zhang Fei, but she was more curious about the giant black and white lotus because it channeled their qi and soul power into each other’s souls.

Suddenly, a crimson flame came out of Yue Xuelian’s body and turned into Feng Yao, and she smiled faintly at her expression. ’I deliberately made you observe their interactions with Zhang Fei so that you could see their situation for yourself, and you would realize that he could help you become a more capable cultivator in all aspects.’

Yue Xuelian’s face grew redder as she saw Shang Yumei shift from Zhang Fei’s lap and Shang Xinyu take over her position, making her realize that they were not only dual soul cultivating but also dual cultivating with him.

"Is he really doing both at the same time with all those women? How can he do that? I don’t know anything about dual cultivation, but I’m quite familiar with soul cultivation." Yue Xuelian muttered to herself as she observed the lotus and the diagram. "Could the lotus and the diagram help them? I’ve never seen a man dual soul cultivated with dozens of women at once, but he did it so calmly because their soul power flow was so stable."

In the end, Yue Xuelian did not continue her cultivation, and she watched all the women swap positions from time to time, taking their turns to dual soul cultivate with Zhang Fei. She was sure Feng Yao connected her with him, but she couldn’t understand her reasoning for doing so.
’I hope it will change the future of you and this sect.’ Feng Yao observed Yue Xuelian for some time before turning into a crimson flame, and she immediately entered her body again.

Lin Jingxia had already arrived at the alchemy hall in the Moonlit Passion Temple, and Tian Shuixiang asked her about the situation in the Celestial Moon Sect. "I’ve seen several female sects in the past, but I’ve never seen one like theirs."

"Yes." Tian Shuixiang nodded at her. "The Celestial Moon Sect has existed for a very long time, much longer than our sect. In the past, they were one of the strongest in this realm, but they declined after some of them decided to join the Divine Samsara Sect."
Lin Jingxia looked at him with raised eyebrows. "Did their members really join that sect?"

"They did." Tian Shuixiang nodded at her. "That sect was originally formed to guard the portal to the Forgotten Land, and it was founded by a combination of all the powerful sects and clans in this realm. Everything went normally at first, but they severed ties with their original sects and clans, which caused those sects and clans to weaken due to the loss of their main members."
"So that’s why the Divine Samsara Sect became the strongest sect of the human race."
Tian Shuixiang looked outside. "Zhang Fei still doesn’t know the depths of that sect, and Liang Huizhong is nothing more than a puppet for the people behind the sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 1523: Tian Shuixiang - Lin Jingxia
paragraphs: "Who actually controls the Divine Samsara Sect?"

"I don’t know their exact identities, but they are the old monsters of the human race, and I heard their strength is on par with the ten demon gods." Tian Shuixiang’s words shocked Lin Jingxia. "Although they haven’t shown themselves to the public for hundreds of thousands of years, the people of this realm believe they still live in seclusion. If our sect grows too quickly and becomes a threat to their existence, I’m sure they will come out of their seclusion to attack us. Although Zhang Fei is far stronger than most cultivators in this realm, I’m not confident he can face them all at once, and this sect will be destroyed at their hands."

Ling Jingxia didn’t expect that there were still old monsters hiding in the Paradise Realm, let alone them gathering in the Divine Samsara Sect. "Do you think Feng Yao can handle them? I’m sure she’ll intervene if those people decide to break out of their seclusion and attack us, and she’ll mobilize her subordinates to assist us."

"Feng Yao is indeed powerful, but those people have lived since before Empress Huo. Those old people are truly powerful, and I’m not sure if she will be able to face all of them by herself." Tian Shuixiang paused and thought. "Many formation arrays have been set up in this domain, but those people might be able to breach them and attack this sect. "I know your plan and your reasons for locking her up in this place, but you can at least give her a chance to meet her mother, and you can bring her back here after they meet. After all, she has been a prisoner of the Celestial Demon Race for a long time, so I can understand her longing for her family."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally understood Shang Xueli’s feelings, but he didn’t want to risk bringing her back to the Slaughter Blood Domain to meet Shang Luohu. He was worried that Shang Zhanluo would notice his daughter’s presence and end his seclusion to save her, and he was not ready to face the Asura Demon God with his current strength.
"What if you meet them somewhere else?"
"Where?"

"The Ashen Lotus Monastery." Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought of that place. "That domain is where the giant Yin-Yang Lotus resides, and no one can enter it except you. I think it would be fine if you take Shang Luohu there, and Shang Xueli can reunite with her mother there, so you don’t have to risk facing Shang Zhanluo."

[Master, I think Tianshi Shengjie’s idea is quite good, and the two souls of the giant Yin-Yang Lotus can help you suppress Shang Luohu. She won’t be able to do anything to you, let alone take her daughter away from you.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded slightly and opened the gate to the domain. "Go in first, and I’ll pick up Shang Luohu afterward."
"Let’s go." Tianshi Shengjie pulled Shang Xueli to her feet and disappeared into the gate.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] quickly got dressed, but he did not rush out of the training space. He asked his two wives, Xie Jingxian and Ba Shuxiang, to get dressed and go to that domain. After the two women left, he came out of the training space and went to the Slaughter Blood Domain.

Shang Luohu, who was relaxing in her chamber, was surprised by the voice transmission from Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Why did he come here and ask me to meet him at this hour? Moreover, he didn’t explain his reasons to me, and he forbade me to bring Shang Zhui with me."

After thinking seriously about the situation, Shang Luohu immediately got out of bed and changed her clothes, as she couldn’t possibly meet him in her nightgown. She then went to meet Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Within a few minutes, Shang Luohu had already arrived in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately opened the gate to the Ashen Lotus Monastery. "Go inside now."
"What—"

"I won’t hurt you or anything, and you’ll be happy once you get there." Shang Luohu was suspicious of Zhang Xiaolong [3] because he wouldn’t explain anything to her, and she feared that the place behind the gate was a trap for her. "If you don’t enter now, I might change my mind, and you will regret the opportunity before you."
Shang Luohu sighed and entered the gate, followed by Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately closed it.
The next moment, Shang Zhui and Shang Dongzhu appeared on the scene. "Are you sure it’s okay for us to let our Empress go with that kid?"

"She’ll be fine." Shang Dongzhu was confused by Shang Zhui’s confidence toward Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Our Empress is stronger than you, remember? I don’t know where that kid took her, but I’m sure he has no bad intentions toward her. Even if he does, I’m sure that our empress can defeat him and come back here."

Shang Zhui agreed with that. "I’m sure our empress will return safely, so you don’t need to worry about her."
"Let’s go back."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Shang Luohu and Shang Xueli for a moment, but he did not disturb them and took his two wives away with him toward the main area, where the giant Yin-Yang Lotus was located.
