"It’s me, Mother." Shang Xueli hugged her mother tighter.
"I miss you, Mother."
"Xueli...
My daughter..." Shang Luohu cried so hard after realizing that Shang Xueli was not an illusion, and she hugged her very tightly as if she was afraid of losing her again.
"Xueli... you finally came back to me..."
Shang Xueli felt truly happy to be able to hug her mother again.
"I’m back, Mother."
I’m glad you’re safe and back to me, Xueli." Shang Luohu released her daughter from her arms and grabbed her face.
"Are... are you okay?
Did Zhang Fei treat you well?"
"Yes." Shang Xueli wiped away her mother’s tears.
"Zhang Fei never restricted my movements, and he always treated me well.
I knew all his wives, and they didn’t mind my presence in their place.
Moreover, I trained to strengthen myself there ever since he took me away from the Celestial Race Domain, and I’ve become a little stronger now."
Shang Luohu nodded slightly.
"How long have you been with them?"
"This." Shang Xueli was confused about answering her mother because the flow of time in the training space was four times faster than the outside world.
"I’m not sure how long I’ve lived with them, Mother."
"How could you not know how long you stayed with them?"
Shang Xueli sighed inwardly.
"I can’t explain the truth to you because Zhang Fei forbade me from telling anyone, Mother.
The most important thing is that I’m healthy and safe, so you don’t need to worry about my condition anymore.
However, I can’t return to our domain yet, and we must wait for my father’s decision before we can be together again."
Shang Luohu was curious about that, but she realized that her daughter couldn’t tell her anything.
She wanted to be reunited with her daughter immediately, but she knew that Zhang Fei would never let her daughter return to her.
The only way for them to be reunited was to persuade her husband, but she knew that Shang Zhanluo would never bow to anyone, which complicated their situation.
"Xueli, I—" Shang Luohu wanted to say something, but she and Shang Xueli were suddenly transported to another place, where they saw the giant Yin-Yang Lotus.
"Hmm?"

Shang Luohu and Shang Xueli were shocked when they saw Zhang Xiaolong [3] and his two wives already naked inside the giant Yin-Yang Lotus, with a white thread and two black threads connecting them to the lotus.
Unlike Shang Xueli, who was accustomed to seeing Zhang Fei and his clones naked, Shang Luohu felt embarrassed by the sight.
Before they could react, two black threads shot out from the black section of the lotus and wrapped around their waists, pulling them into it.
"Shit!" Shang Luohu cursed as her dress melted by itself, leaving her naked.
She couldn’t do anything as the lotus pulled her soul out of her body, and it began to absorb her soul power, shocking her.
She tried to stop it, but her efforts were unsuccessful, and the lotus continued to absorb it.
The same thing happened to Shang Xueli; her dress melted by itself, and the lotus slowly absorbed her soul power.
"Don’t worry, let the lotus absorb your soul power." Shang Luohu and Shang Xueli turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had his eyes closed.
"This lotus is the guardian of the balance of this universe, but it is in a weak state now, and it needs our soul powers to strengthen itself.
Moreover, the lotus will not absorb all your soul power, and it will stop on its own when it feels it has enough, so you don’t need to resist it.
Shang Luohu didn’t refute Zhang Xiaolong [3] because she could feel that the lotus was absorbing her soul power very slowly, so it wouldn’t cause any problems for her.
However, she felt uncomfortable being naked in front of another man, but she was powerless to escape because the lotus bound her waist and absorbed her soul power.
Unlike her, Shang Xueli didn’t think much of her situation, and she allowed the lotus to absorb her soul power.
Shang Luohu covered her naked body with her hands and legs.
"What exactly is this lotus?
Why is it in this domain?"
"This lotus is the Ying-Yang Lotus, and this universe will be destroyed without it."

chapters.title: Chapter 1525: A Month Passed
paragraphs: Shang Luohu looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in disbelief. "What do you mean by that?"

"This universe and everything in it are formed by Yin and Yang, be it humans, demons, beasts, or everything else." Shang Luohu and Shang Xueli understood the concept of Yin and Yang, but they still did not comprehend the significance of the lotus. "The giant Yin-Yang Lotus is the embodiment of Yin and Yang in this universe, and this universe will be destroyed if the lotus weakens. It happened once in this domain, and the balance between Yin and Yang almost collapsed when the lotus weakened, which led to mass destruction and extinction."
"Then—" Shang Luohu stopped talking when she saw Yin Lianhua and Yang Lianhua appear above Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Who are they?"

"They are the spirits of the giant Ying-Yang Lotus." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked up at the two. "The male spirit is Yang Lianhua, and the female spirit is Yin Lianhua. The lotus gave birth to them to maintain the balance between Yin and Yang. Everything went smoothly, and Yin and Yang became balanced again to this day. Unfortunately, the lotus continued to weaken, so it brought us here because it needs our Yin and Yang to restore itself; otherwise, this universe will be destroyed if the lotus weakens and disappears."
"Huh? How could there be a disturbance in the balance between Yin and Yang? Does that mean the lotus will absorb our Yin and Yang dry?"

"No," Zhang Xiaolong [3] denied with a shake of his head. "The lotus will never absorb our Yin and Yang dry, and it will only absorb a little of both from us so we can recover our bodies. My wives and I spent some time here, and I’m still alive today, so you don’t need to worry about that. If the lotus has had enough of absorbing our Yin and Yang, it will release us, and we can go back out."

Shang Luohu was skeptical about it, but she could feel that the lotus only absorbed a small amount of her yin qi at a time, so it didn’t have much of an impact on her. "How long will this lotus absorb the yin and yang in our bodies? If I leave my domain for too long, Shang Zhui and the others will worry about me, and they will go to your domain to look for me. Moreover, my husband will come out of his seclusion at any time, and he will be furious if he can’t find me in our domain."

"I can’t confirm that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought for a moment. "I will ask Tian Shuixiang to contact Shang Zhui and inform him about your situation, so that old man should not worry about you. As for your husband—"

"You don’t need to worry about that." They looked at Yang Lianhua. "We will know when the Asura Demon God will come out of his seclusion, and the lotus will release this woman before that. That way, you can send her back to her domain, and her husband will not create chaos in your sect."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to him. "Please tell me when the Asura Demon God comes out of his seclusion, and I will immediately send his wife back to their domain. After all, he is still too strong for me, so I would rather not have problems with him now, which will only harm me."
"Yes." Thereafter, Yang Lianhua and Yin Lianhua disappeared from their sights.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke to Shang Luohu again. "You don’t have to worry anymore, right? For now, let the giant Yin-Yang Lotus absorb your yin qi, and it will release you once the two spirits detect your husband’s movements. As for Shang Zhui, my other clone has already asked Tian Shuixiang to contact him, so he should be able to control the situation in your domain."

"I hope so." Shang Luohu inwardly sighed because she was uncomfortable being naked in front of another man, but fortunately, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not look at her at all, giving her some relief. She looked at her daughter. "Xueli, please tell me about your life after you are free."

Shang Xueli looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] first, but he didn’t say anything to her. She began telling her mother about her life after she was freed from the Celestial Demon Race, but she didn’t mention the training space or anything related to it.

Tianshi Shengjie was at the lake in the eastern area of the Ashen Lotus Monastery, and she was shocked when she felt that the qi inside was much stronger than it had been a few months ago. She wanted to join the female ice phoenixes in the lake, but a gate suddenly opened beside her, and she knew that Zhang Fei had opened it to pick her up.

Tianshi Shengjie wanted to try cultivating in the lake with the female phoenixes, but Zhang Fei’s training space was much more beneficial for her, especially since she could cultivate and train at the same time. She canceled her intention and immediately entered the training space, where she started practicing with the others inside.

In his room in the Slaughter Blood Domain, Shang Zhui sighed to himself after he heard a voice message from his son, Tian Shuixiang, telling him that Shang Luohu was fine and was spending time with Shang Xueli.

Although he wasn’t sure about their situation, Shang Zhui was relieved that Shang Luohu was fine, and he was also happy that she could see Shang Xueli again. However, he was worried that Shang Zhanluo would suddenly come out of his seclusion and be unable to find his wife, which would cause major problems.

Shang Zhui walked to the window of his room and looked far away. "I hope my empress will return before my emperor comes out of his seclusion, or he will lead us to attack the Moonlit Passion Temple. I know that Zhang Fei is strong, but he can’t possibly protect his sect from my emperor’s wrath, and the casualties will be enormous if that happens. Moreover, not only his sect but also my asura demon race will suffer losses, particularly if Empress Huo takes action to defend them."
Shang Zhui let out a soft sigh before informing the other four asura guardians about their empress, and he told them that she was in seclusion elsewhere, asking them not to worry about her.

Shang Dongzhu, who knew about Shang Luohu’s departure, did not really believe Shang Zhui’s words. He thought that their empress had fallen into Zhang Fei’s hands, and he deliberately captured her to pressure their emperor.
Shang Dongzhu wanted to report the incident to Shang Zhanluo, but he couldn’t approach his seclusion chamber without his permission, so he waited for his emperor to summon him.

Time passed quickly, and a month had already passed. The giant Yin-Yang Lotus finally released Shang Luohu, but it didn’t release Shang Xueli. "Mother, you must return to our domain first, or my father will be furious if he can’t find you there."
"Yes." Shang Luohu nodded at her daughter before looking at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Please take good care of my daughter and please send me back to my domain now because I’ve been gone too long."

"Don’t worry, I guarantee nothing will happen to your daughter." Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the gate to the Slaughter Blood Domain. "Shang Zhui and the others must be worried about you, so you should return to your domain now, and I will take you to see your daughter again another time."
"Take care of yourself, Xueli. I will wait for your father to finish his seclusion, and I will talk to him about you after."

Shang Xueli shook her head at her mother. "Mother, I also want to return to your side, but you must not tell my father that I’m with Zhang Fei, or he’ll lead the others to attack the Moonlit Passion Temple. The important thing is that you know that I’m fine, so you don’t need to worry about me, and we’ll be together again when the time comes."

Shang Luohu was also aware of this, but she wanted to be reunited with her daughter as soon as possible because they had been separated for too long. "Alright, I won’t say anything to your father, and I’ll wait for you to return to our side."
"Yes, Mother." Shang Luohu sighed softly and went straight into the gate, which was immediately closed by Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "How long will the lotus absorb our soul power?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at her. "We can only wait for the lotus to finish by itself, and I will take you back to my training space after that."
"I see." Shang Xueli nodded in understanding. "How are you going to convince my father to side with you?"

"Haish." Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a disappointed sigh hearing that. "Your father is too stubborn, and he has ambitions to become the ruler of all the demon races, so it won’t be easy to win him over to my side. For now, I don’t have a solution for that, and I will focus on building my strength first, so I can face your father in the future."

Even though they had been separated for a long time, Shang Xueli remembered her father’s character by heart, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] would not be able to convince him without showing his strength. "Have you never thought about dual cultivating with me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1526: Three Asura Demons
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Shang Xueli. "Would you believe me if I said that I am not interested in you?"
"Why?"

"You are indeed a princess, but you’re not my criteria." Zhang Xiaolong [3] hugged Xie Jingxian and Bai Shuxiang on either side. "Originally, they were my enemies, but I liked them, so I took them as my wives."

Xie Jingxian and Bai Shuxiang smiled as they recalled their first meeting with Zhang Xiaolong [3]. Back then, he was much weaker than them, but he managed to defeat them when they tried to attack him. Since then, they have been together for decades, and he took them by his side, including when he ascended to the Paradise Realm.
Shang Xueli looked at the two women. "Are they evil beasts?"
"Xie Jingxian is the Corrupted Dragon-Tiger with the shadow demon bloodline, and Bai Shuxiang is the Three-Eyed Demon Ape."
"Eh?" Shang Xueli was surprised by that. "Aren’t the Corrupted Dragon-Tiger and the Three-Eyed Demon Ape the generals of the four perils? I’ve met them in the past, before I married Mo Zixiao."

"You’re wrong about that." Even though Shang Xueli lived with them, Zhang Xiaolong [3] deliberately kept some things under wraps and didn’t tell her about them, especially about his science capsule. "I met them in the Three Mortal Realms, so they have nothing to do with their two generals."

Shang Xueli nodded slightly because she didn’t know anything about the Three Mortal Realms, so she didn’t know whether Zhang Xiaolong [3] was lying to her or not. "How long will the lotus absorb our soul power?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his chin. "Back then, the lotus only absorbed our soul power for a month, but our numbers were several times greater than now, so I thought we would be spending quite a while here. Moreover, the lotus does not absorb our soul power for free; it also provides us with something in return, and you can personally feel the effect on your soul."
Shang Xueli did feel another effect on her soul, and it slowly strengthened according to the amount of her soul power absorbed by the lotus, which she had never experienced before.
"Let’s stop talking, and you should focus on cultivating your soul using the gifts of the lotus."
"Yeah."

As soon as Shang Luohu returned to their domain, Shang Zhui and the four asura guardians appeared in the asura palace, and they were relieved to see their empress return safely after she had been missing for a month.
"Did something happen to you, Empress?"
"Did you encounter any trouble out there, Empress?"
"Why did you leave for so long without informing us?"
Shang Dongzhu was the most relieved among them. "Fortunately, our emperor has not yet emerged from his seclusion; otherwise, your departure would have brought great trouble, Empress."
"That’s enough." Shang Zhui stopped them. "Did you find anything useful for you, Empress? Did you enjoy your time while you were away?"
Shang Luohu nodded to Shang Zhui. "Even though I only went out for a month, I thoroughly enjoyed my time. Moreover, I discovered something interesting, and it helped me improve my soul power."
"Where is that place, Empress?" Three of the four asura guardians asked.
Shang Dongzhu was also curious about that place, and he was certain that Zhang Fei was the key to getting there, but he didn’t ask Shang Luohu anything.

’These guys are so curious about that place!’ Shang Luohu shook her head at them. "To be honest, I don’t know how to get to that place, as I arrived there by chance. After I finished cultivating my soul there, I was automatically sent out of that place, and the portal disappeared by itself. I still wanted to spend time there, but I was worried about my husband’s reaction if he couldn’t find me, so I had to stop. Moreover, there was nothing there besides ruins, so there was nothing else interesting there."
"What did you find there, Empress?"

"A giant black and white lotus, and it pulled me into it to help me increase my soul power." The four asura guardians tried searching in their memories about the lotus, but they had never heard of or seen it in their entire lives. "Alright, you guys should go back to your respective places now so I can rest in peace."
The three asura guardians left with disappointed looks, but not Shang Dongzhu, who chose to stay behind. "Did Zhang Fei really not do anything to you, Empress?"
"What do you think he did to me, Dongzhu?" Shang Dongzhu shook her head at Shang Luohu. "He didn’t do anything to me, and I spent time with my daughter there."
"Princess Xueli? Is she really in Zhang Fei’s hands?" Shang Dongzhu asked in shock.

"My daughter has been in Zhang Fei’s hands since Mo Shentian sealed his domain." Shang Dongzhu was even more shocked to hear that. "I don’t know how he managed to get my daughter out of there, but she is safe by his side. He didn’t return my daughter to me because he wants something from our demon race, but I’m not sure we can fulfill his wishes."
"What does Zhang Fei want from our demon race?"

"Peace and cooperation." Shang Dongzhu put on a look of disbelief. "Zhang Fei doesn’t want enmity with any race; instead, he wants to establish beneficial relations with everyone. You may not believe me, but Zhui and I have seen the situation in his domain, and all races live there in harmony."
"Is that true, Zhui?"

"Yes," Shang Zhui created a screen so that Shang Dongzhu could see everything for himself. "I’ve never been to that sect, but Princess Fengxue has gone there and seen the situation for herself. All these images are what she saw at that time, and you can see for yourself all the races gathered in that sect in harmony."

Shang Dongzhu looked at the screen, observing all the races communicating with each other. He could see that humans, beasts, demons, natural races, winged races, and demihumans were interacting with each other without differentiating one another, which was something he had never seen in his entire life. He had often seen and heard that humans, beasts, and natural races often had beneficial relations with each other, but he had never witnessed demons and winged races living in one place without fighting because the two races were eternal enemies.
"How could Zhang Fei convince all the races to live together in one place?" Shang Dongzu asked after the qi screen disappeared.
Shang Luohu shook her head in response. "I don’t know how Zhang Fei managed to do that, but it’s a good thing, right?"

"Yes," Shang Dongzhu agreed with her. "Although we are a demon race born of war and blood, I have long desired peace among all races. Unfortunately, all races have their interests, and some are hostile to each other due to past issues, such as the demon race and the winged race."

"That’s right." Shang Luohu nodded slightly. "Just like you, I am tired of the hostility between all races, and I hope that peace will prevail between us. Unfortunately, we have not been able to find peace because of the old grudges between all races or the ambitions of all their leaders, but that hope has appeared with the presence of Zhang Fei. Although his sect is only small-scale, he has proven that all races can live together in one place, and I hope he can bring that peace to this realm."
Shang Dongzhu released a soft sigh. "Do you really believe that Zhang Fei can bring peace to all races in this realm, Empress?"

"Yes," Shang Luohu answered with great confidence. "Zhang Fei cannot bring peace by himself, but he has many strong people who share his vision beside him, and they will help him to make it happen in the future."
"For example?"

"Empress Huo and Long Wuzhao are his strongest allies, and he still has many other allies." Shang Dongzhu wasn’t surprised to hear those two names, but he felt that they weren’t enough to help Zhang Fei bring peace to the Paradise Realm. Moreover, the Golden Dragon King had tried in the past, but his efforts failed miserably. "Peace is indeed difficult to achieve, but I believe that he will succeed in bringing peace to all races in this Paradise Realm. Although it will take time and a long process, this realm will enter an era of peace for the first time at that time."
Shang Dongzhu nodded his head repeatedly. "What do you think if I go to see Zhang Fei for a talk, Empress?"

"Zhang Fei is in seclusion, and he won’t be out for the next few years, so you can only meet him then." Shang Luohu looked away. "Dongzhu, I hope you won’t tell my husband about my daughter’s presence with him, as he may attack his sect to free her. Xueli will be fine, and she will return when she has become powerful. At that time, she will be worthy of being the demon god of our race, and she will lead us to a better future."
"Are you sure Princess Xueli will have the ability to succeed him, Empress?"

"A hundred percent." Shang Luohu looked at him. "Honestly, I want to reunite with my daughter as soon as possible, but I think it would be better if she stayed with Zhang Fei for now, and he would help her become a worthy successor for our demon race."

"You are indeed a princess, but you’re not my criteria." Zhang Xiaolong [3] hugged Xie Jingxian and Bai Shuxiang on either side.
"Originally, they were my enemies, but I liked them, so I took them as my wives."
Xie Jingxian and Bai Shuxiang smiled as they recalled their first meeting with Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Back then, he was much weaker than them, but he managed to defeat them when they tried to attack him.
Since then, they have been together for decades, and he took them by his side, including when he ascended to the Paradise Realm.
Shang Xueli looked at the two women.
"Are they evil beasts?"
"Xie Jingxian is the Corrupted Dragon-Tiger with the shadow demon bloodline, and Bai Shuxiang is the Three-Eyed Demon Ape."
"Eh?" Shang Xueli was surprised by that.
"Aren’t the Corrupted Dragon-Tiger and the Three-Eyed Demon Ape the generals of the four perils?
I’ve met them in the past, before I married Mo Zixiao."
"You’re wrong about that." Even though Shang Xueli lived with them, Zhang Xiaolong [3] deliberately kept some things under wraps and didn’t tell her about them, especially about his science capsule.
"I met them in the Three Mortal Realms, so they have nothing to do with their two generals."
Shang Xueli nodded slightly because she didn’t know anything about the Three Mortal Realms, so she didn’t know whether Zhang Xiaolong [3] was lying to her or not.
"How long will the lotus absorb our soul power?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his chin.
"Back then, the lotus only absorbed our soul power for a month, but our numbers were several times greater than now, so I thought we would be spending quite a while here.
Moreover, the lotus does not absorb our soul power for free; it also provides us with something in return, and you can personally feel the effect on your soul."
Shang Xueli did feel another effect on her soul, and it slowly strengthened according to the amount of her soul power absorbed by the lotus, which she had never experienced before.
"Let’s stop talking, and you should focus on cultivating your soul using the gifts of the lotus."
"Yeah."

As soon as Shang Luohu returned to their domain, Shang Zhui and the four asura guardians appeared in the asura palace, and they were relieved to see their empress return safely after she had been missing for a month.
"Did something happen to you, Empress?"
"Did you encounter any trouble out there, Empress?"
"Why did you leave for so long without informing us?"
Shang Dongzhu was the most relieved among them.
"Fortunately, our emperor has not yet emerged from his seclusion; otherwise, your departure would have brought great trouble, Empress."
"That’s enough." Shang Zhui stopped them.
"Did you find anything useful for you, Empress?
Did you enjoy your time while you were away?"
Shang Luohu nodded to Shang Zhui.
"Even though I only went out for a month, I thoroughly enjoyed my time.
Moreover, I discovered something interesting, and it helped me improve my soul power."
"Where is that place, Empress?" Three of the four asura guardians asked.
Shang Dongzhu was also curious about that place, and he was certain that Zhang Fei was the key to getting there, but he didn’t ask Shang Luohu anything.
’These guys are so curious about that place!’ Shang Luohu shook her head at them.
"To be honest, I don’t know how to get to that place, as I arrived there by chance.
After I finished cultivating my soul there, I was automatically sent out of that place, and the portal disappeared by itself.
I still wanted to spend time there, but I was worried about my husband’s reaction if he couldn’t find me, so I had to stop.
Moreover, there was nothing there besides ruins, so there was nothing else interesting there."
"What did you find there, Empress?"

"A giant black and white lotus, and it pulled me into it to help me increase my soul power." The four asura guardians tried searching in their memories about the lotus, but they had never heard of or seen it in their entire lives.
"Alright, you guys should go back to your respective places now so I can rest in peace."
The three asura guardians left with disappointed looks, but not Shang Dongzhu, who chose to stay behind.
"Did Zhang Fei really not do anything to you, Empress?"
"What do you think he did to me, Dongzhu?" Shang Dongzhu shook her head at Shang Luohu.
"He didn’t do anything to me, and I spent time with my daughter there."
"Princess Xueli?
Is she really in Zhang Fei’s hands?" Shang Dongzhu asked in shock.
"My daughter has been in Zhang Fei’s hands since Mo Shentian sealed his domain." Shang Dongzhu was even more shocked to hear that.
"I don’t know how he managed to get my daughter out of there, but she is safe by his side.
He didn’t return my daughter to me because he wants something from our demon race, but I’m not sure we can fulfill his wishes."
"What does Zhang Fei want from our demon race?"
"Peace and cooperation." Shang Dongzhu put on a look of disbelief.
"Zhang Fei doesn’t want enmity with any race; instead, he wants to establish beneficial relations with everyone.
You may not believe me, but Zhui and I have seen the situation in his domain, and all races live there in harmony."
"Is that true, Zhui?"
"Yes," Shang Zhui created a screen so that Shang Dongzhu could see everything for himself.
"I’ve never been to that sect, but Princess Fengxue has gone there and seen the situation for herself.
All these images are what she saw at that time, and you can see for yourself all the races gathered in that sect in harmony."
Shang Dongzhu looked at the screen, observing all the races communicating with each other.

He could see that humans, beasts, demons, natural races, winged races, and demihumans were interacting with each other without differentiating one another, which was something he had never seen in his entire life.

He had often seen and heard that humans, beasts, and natural races often had beneficial relations with each other, but he had never witnessed demons and winged races living in one place without fighting because the two races were eternal enemies.
"How could Zhang Fei convince all the races to live together in one place?" Shang Dongzu asked after the qi screen disappeared.
Shang Luohu shook her head in response.
"I don’t know how Zhang Fei managed to do that, but it’s a good thing, right?"
"Yes," Shang Dongzhu agreed with her.
"Although we are a demon race born of war and blood, I have long desired peace among all races.
Unfortunately, all races have their interests, and some are hostile to each other due to past issues, such as the demon race and the winged race."
"That’s right." Shang Luohu nodded slightly.
"Just like you, I am tired of the hostility between all races, and I hope that peace will prevail between us.
Unfortunately, we have not been able to find peace because of the old grudges between all races or the ambitions of all their leaders, but that hope has appeared with the presence of Zhang Fei.
Although his sect is only small-scale, he has proven that all races can live together in one place, and I hope he can bring that peace to this realm."
Shang Dongzhu released a soft sigh.
"Do you really believe that Zhang Fei can bring peace to all races in this realm, Empress?"
"Yes," Shang Luohu answered with great confidence.
"Zhang Fei cannot bring peace by himself, but he has many strong people who share his vision beside him, and they will help him to make it happen in the future."
"For example?"

"Empress Huo and Long Wuzhao are his strongest allies, and he still has many other allies." Shang Dongzhu wasn’t surprised to hear those two names, but he felt that they weren’t enough to help Zhang Fei bring peace to the Paradise Realm.
Moreover, the Golden Dragon King had tried in the past, but his efforts failed miserably.
"Peace is indeed difficult to achieve, but I believe that he will succeed in bringing peace to all races in this Paradise Realm.
Although it will take time and a long process, this realm will enter an era of peace for the first time at that time."
Shang Dongzhu nodded his head repeatedly.
"What do you think if I go to see Zhang Fei for a talk, Empress?"
"Zhang Fei is in seclusion, and he won’t be out for the next few years, so you can only meet him then." Shang Luohu looked away.
"Dongzhu, I hope you won’t tell my husband about my daughter’s presence with him, as he may attack his sect to free her.
Xueli will be fine, and she will return when she has become powerful.
At that time, she will be worthy of being the demon god of our race, and she will lead us to a better future."
"Are you sure Princess Xueli will have the ability to succeed him, Empress?"
"A hundred percent." Shang Luohu looked at him.

"Honestly, I want to reunite with my daughter as soon as possible, but I think it would be better if she stayed with Zhang Fei for now, and he would help her become a worthy successor for our demon race."

chapters.title: Chapter 1527: Shang Zhanluo’s Situation
paragraphs: "What kind of place did Zhang Fei take you to, Empress?" Shang Zhui asked after Shang Dongzhu left the asura palace.

"An ancient domain." Shang Zhui was shocked to hear that. "I didn’t tell this matter to Shang Dongzhu, but I believe you, so I will tell you the truth. According to Zhang Fei, the name of that domain is the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, home to the giant Yin-Yang Lotus."

"The giant Yin-Yang Lotus and the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain." Shang Zhui had never heard of these two, even though he had lived for so long, and he was sure that none of the old cultivators in the Paradise Realm knew about them.

"Yes." Shang Luohu nodded at him. "I can’t show you the domain image, but the lotus embodies Yin and Yang in this universe, and it will perish if the lotus weakens or vanishes. It happened once in the past, which caused total destruction in that domain and the extinction of all its inhabitants. That’s why the lotus requires the soul power of all living beings to become powerful, but not everyone can enter the domain because the portal is nowhere to be found."
"How did Zhang Fei find the portal?"

"Zhang Fei found the portal because of fate, and I just learned that his beast identity is a heavenly fox, which never existed in the Paradise Realm." Shang Zhui agreed with Shang Luohu because he himself had never heard of that fox race. "The gate you saw a month ago is one of his fox abilities, and he can use it to access any domain, including the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain."
"Does that mean Zhang Fei and Princess Xueli are in that domain?"

"Yeah." Shang Luohu looked outside. "I don’t know how long they will stay in that domain, but the giant Yin-Yang Lotus is very helpful for us, especially in increasing our soul power. That’s why I’m sure my daughter will be fine, and she will surpass her father to become the demon god of our asura demon race."

Shang Zhui was still skeptical because he hadn’t seen the giant Yin-Yang Lotus with his own eyes, but he could see the confidence in Shang Luohu’s eyes. "I hope you’re right, Empress. Our asura demon race will never change as long as my emperor is in power, and we need a new leader to change and improve everything. Unfortunately, Princess Fengxue has never been interested in power, and she is more interested in living unfettered. Therefore, our only hope is Princess Xueli, but she is still lacking in all aspects because she was confined for a long time in the Celestial Demon Domain, so she still has to develop herself to have the qualities of a leader of our demon race."

"Yeah," Shang Luohu sighed heavily as she remembered Shang Xueli’s past situation. "Although my daughter had a bad situation in the past, she is free now, and she is training hard to improve herself with Zhang Fei. I don’t know when my daughter will return to my side, but I hope she will be strong when she returns. Has my husband shown signs of coming out of his seclusion?"

"My emperor hasn’t shown any signs of coming out of his seclusion, but I heard a commotion coming from inside his chamber two weeks ago." Shang Luohu turned to Shang Zhui with a raised eyebrow. "I don’t know what happened to him in there, but the commotion lasted for a whole week, and he hasn’t made a sound since that day."
"Do you think something happened to my husband?"
"I can’t go inside, so I can’t check my emperor’s situation."
"Let’s go there, Zhui."
"Yes,"
Some time later, they had arrived in front of Shang Zhanluo’s seclusion chamber. Shang Luohu pressed her palm against the door while closing her eyes, and her mouth muttered something.
*Crack*

After a creaking sound was heard and the door opened by itself, Shang Luohu immediately led Shang Zhui into the room. They found Shang Zhanluo meditating in the center of the room, his body enveloped in a blood-red aura, but he was unaware of their presence.

Shang Luohu walked over to Shang Zhanluo, squatted in front of her husband, and grabbed his wrist. She used her senses and qi to examine his insides for some time, but she found nothing unusual inside, and she could feel that everything was normal. "What actually happened two weeks ago? It’s unusual for him to make a fuss when he’s in seclusion."
"Is my emperor okay, Empress?"

"Yeah." Shang Luohu stood up and faced Shang Zhui. "I don’t know what happened to him two weeks ago, but I didn’t detect anything abnormal in my husband’s body, Zhui. His heartbeat is normal, and the flow of qi in his body is also normal."
"That’s weird." Shang Zhui looked at Shang Zhanluo, whose expression was calm. "What exactly happened to my emperor two weeks ago? Why did he make such a big fuss then?"
Shang Luohu shook her head slightly and walked out. "Let’s leave now, or he will be angry if he wakes up because of our presence."

After they left the room and resealed the entrance, Shang Zhanluo opened his eyes. However, his red eyes had turned dark, resembling dark blood, and his gaze showed something evil. He didn’t say anything or move, and he closed his eyes a moment later, causing the blood-red aura enveloping his body to grow stronger.
"I’ll return to my room to rest, Zhui."

"Yes, Empress." Shang Zhui didn’t leave, and her eyes stared thoughtfully at the entrance to Shang Zhanluo’s seclusion chamber. He sensed something had happened to his emperor, but his empress didn’t feel anything inside his body, which made him feel strange. "Sigh! I have to monitor my emperor’s condition, or it will be too late if something happens to him. If something happens to him, I’m sure Demon God Sha Mo will lead his subordinates to attack us, and we won’t be able to fight them without his presence."
Shan Zhui stuck something to the entrance to Shang Zhanluo’s seclusion chamber, and he left the place afterward.
*Tap... Tap...*
A woman wearing a black robe and veil walked into a throne room, and the man sitting there immediately asked her. "How did it go? Did you succeed in your task?"

"I’ve already done it, Demon God Sha Mo." Sha Mo was delighted after hearing that. "I didn’t expect Shang Luohu to leave the Asura Palace, and she was gone for a whole month, which allowed me to infiltrate the area around Shang Zhanluo’s seclusion chamber and use the item. I didn’t report to you immediately because I was waiting for the effect to work on him, and it has been affecting him since two weeks ago."
"Shang Luohu left her domain for a whole month?"

"Yes, Demon God. I don’t know Shang Luohu’s destination, but she was gone for a whole month, and she only came back today." Sha Mo fell into thought after hearing the news because the Asura Empress had never left the Slaughter Blood Domain for so long before, let alone when her husband was in seclusion. "Although Shang Zhanluo has been affected by the effects of the item, the results won’t be immediately visible. However, the effects will continue to erode his consciousness, and he will transform into a bloodthirsty demon who isn’t concerned about friend or foe. After all, he is a demon god like you, and he is a demon born of blood and war, so the effects will take quite a long time, about five years."

"I’m not in a rush to get rid of Shang Zhanluo, so I’ll wait for the effects to take full effect before acting. If I succeed in getting rid of him, his asura demon race won’t be able to rise again because he hasn’t chosen his heir yet, and no one can inherit his power if he dies first. After I get rid of them, I will devise a plan for Mo Shentian, but I have to be more careful in dealing with him." Sha Mo took a bag and threw it to the woman, who accepted it with joy. "What about the other demon gods?"

The woman shook her head at Sha No. "Jiu Mozu and Jiu Moze are always on guard in their NineNether Demon domain, so I don’t dare go there for now. Ku Shenzu is too terrifying, and I don’t want to die at his hands. You don’t need to ask about Qian Yan because he will detect my presence in his domain and kill me immediately. What about the other demon gods? Don’t you want to take any action against them?"

"You don’t have to do anything to them." Sha Mo smirked. "Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran are indeed strong, but they are not my opponents, and I can eliminate them at any time. Unfortunately, I still haven’t managed to locate Wu Mian’s true body, so I can’t do anything to him. As for Qi Qingxiu, I’ll take care of her after I subdue the Celestial Demon Race, and she will help me deal with Ku Shenzu and Qian Yan."
The woman nodded slightly. "If you need my help again, you can contact me directly, and I’ll be happy to help you as long as the payment is good."
"Leave."
After the woman left, another woman appeared beside Sha Mo, and her appearance was more like a female monster than a demon. "Why did you let that witch go, husband?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1528: Heavenly Fiend Demon Race
paragraphs: "Haha," Sha Mo pulled the woman onto his lap and kissed her. "Why should I kill that witch, Sha Yuan? The number of the witch demon race isn’t that significant now, and they possess many abilities that are useful to us. Although Wu Han isn’t as skilled as Wu Zu, she’s second only to her as a witch, and she managed to do something to Shang Zhanluo, so I won’t kill her."
Sha Yuan narrowed her eyes at him before sighing softly. "How about you give Wu Han to our son?"

"No," Sha Mo immediately refused. "Even though I need Wu Han to smooth out my plans, I don’t want a witch like her in my demon race. She is worthy enough to be asked to work together, but she is not worthy to be by our son’s side. Women like Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, or Nalan Shizhe are much more worthy of accompanying him."

"I never liked Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran, and I wanted to kill those two damn bitches." Sha Mo smiled bitterly at Sha Yuan’s furious expression, but he knew exactly why his wife hated the two female demon gods so much. "Compared to them, Qi Qingxiu is more suitable to accompany our son because he has never been with any man before. Unfortunately, Qiongxi is infatuated with him, and he has ambitions to marry her. You and our demon race are strong, but it’s impossible for you to defeat that evil mythical beast, especially if his three friends help him."

Sha Mo nodded his head slightly, as he himself realized the difference in strength between him and the four perils. Even though he was a demon god and his cultivation had reached the Celestial God Realm, the four perils were stronger than him because they were demon beasts, and their beast ranks had already exceeded the mythical rank. "I may not be able to defeat them now, but I may be able to defeat them in the future. After that, I will attack the other races, and I will start with the winged race."

"I hate Tian Qiye! She killed my second son, but I can’t take revenge on that bitch. I hate Long Wuzhao more because he repeatedly interfered in our affairs, and he stopped us from killing her several times." Sha Yuan looked at her husband. "I think you don’t need to kill Shang Zhanluo, and we can use him to cause a commotion in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain. When that hateful dragon emperor is off guard, we will seize the opportunity to kill him, and I will use his body parts as decoration for our palace."

"I understand your wishes, but you underestimate Long Wuzhao too much." Sha Mo released a soft sigh before continuing. "If you believe that Shang Zhanluo is sufficient to make the dragon emperor panic and lower his guard, then you are mistaken about his capabilities. If he was that weak, Mo Shentian, Qian Yan, and the four perils would have attacked the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain first. In fact, they fear him even though they have an advantage in numbers, so I’m sure he hasn’t shown his true strength all this time, and they know that his true strength is more terrifying than he has ever shown."
"Is it true that Long Wuzhao is much stronger than he has shown so far?"

"Even if the ten demon gods work together to attack Long Wuzhao using all our strength, we will still lose to him." Sha Yuan was still skeptical of it, even though her husband said it with a serious expression. "Besides, he still has Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong by his side, and those two dragons are no less powerful than him. The former is a Void Dragon, and no demon has a void element. The latter is a Celestial Dragon, and his light element is second only to the Winged Race. They choose to recognize him as their emperor, and they always act according to his orders."
"So, what should we do to take revenge for Tian Qiye and Long Wuzhao?"

Sha Mo shook his head in reply. "I want to kill them, but Long Wuzhao is still too strong for me, and I heard that Tian Qiye’s angelic rank has already risen to the True Divine, allowing him to become the leader of the Winged Race. That’s why we have to be patient for now, and we will move after I succeed in becoming the leader of all demon races."
"Sigh."
*Tap... Tap...*
Sha Mo and Sha Yuan looked in the direction of the footsteps, looking at their son, Sha Huo. "Father! Mother! I’m back."
"How was your adventure out there? Did the other cultivators recognize your disguise?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1529: Three Other Artifical Dolls
paragraphs: "But Mother—"

"I said no." Sha Yuan didn’t give her son a chance to speak. "Other cultivators might not be able to see through your disguise, but Empress Huo is on a different level than them. She may appear harmless on the outside, but everyone knows that she is the most dangerous person; even Mo Shentian doesn’t dare to fight her directly because she is too dangerous."

Sha Mo spoke to his son. "Son, you may not have heard of this matter, but your ancestor once fought with Empress Huo in the past, and she was completely powerless before her. She brutally battered him, causing severe injuries that sidelined him for several thousand years. Since the Moonlit Passion Temple is under her protection, you should not approach that sect, let alone join them."
"I understand, Father."
"Son, I want to ask you something."
"What do you want to ask me, Mother?"

"Do you remember when Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha infiltrated our domain a few months ago?" Sha Huo nodded at her mother. "Do you have any interest in those two princesses of the Celestial Demon Race? Since they intruded into our domain to seek your attention, I thought—"
"No," Sha Huo refused. "Mother, you’ve seen Shang Xueli’s condition before, right?"
"Shang Xueli looked like a soulless doll at that time."

Sha Huo nodded at her mother. "Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha can’t do anything to me, but Mo Shentian is on my father’s level. If I marry either of them, he won’t let me return to our domain, and he might do the same to me as he did to Shang Xueli. Thus, I will never approach them, let alone marry one of them."
"Alright, you can go now." After Sha Huo left, Sha Yuan looked at her husband. "Our son is too mature, but I’m worried because he has never shown interest in any woman, husband."

"Hahaha," Sha Mo laughed at that. "What do you have to worry about? Have you forgotten that we married when I was much older than our son? He may not have found a female demon who can catch his attention yet, but I’m sure he will find one suitable in the future. Besides, we don’t need to rush this matter, and we should wait for the right time to make our move. At that time, I will capture Qi Qingxiu for our son, and our demon race will become stronger with her as his wife."

Sha Yuan agreed with her husband. "I think there is no woman worthy of being our son’s wife other than Qi Qingxiu, and I think you should give Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe to him as his servants so our demon race will be even stronger with three female demon gods by our son’s side."
"Hahaha," Sha Mo laughed again. "Didn’t you want to kill Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe? Why do you want to give them to our son now?"

"I did hate Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe, and I wanted to kill them. However, they are demon gods, and they will be useful to our son, so I changed my mind about them." Sha Mo agreed with that. "Therefore, we don’t need to kill them, and they will serve our son as his concubines."

Sha Mo lifted his wife to her feet. "Let’s discuss this matter in the future, and I will wait until Wu Han’s items have completely affected Shang Zhanluo. When he and his asura demon race have fallen into my hands, I will use him to attack Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe, and they will never guess that he is in our control."
"Alright."

After he helped all his wives and partners improve their soul power for half a year in the pavilion, and their soul power experienced significant growth, Zhang Fei decided to stop dual soul cultivation with all of them. He asked them to train in the training space first, and he would dual cultivate with them after a few days.

This way, Zhang Fei’s five clones could use the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror to help their wives to increase their soul power, especially since he had already used it to help his main harem members for a full half a month.
Qi Qingxiu spoke directly to him. "Hey, you used an artificial doll to replace Tian Yaoqin in the Radiance Domain, right?"
"Do you want that too?"
"Yes." Ye Mingran nodded to him. "Although your great-grandmaster can take care of everything, I can’t be absent for too long, and I must return to my domain soon."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and turned to Dong Xuanyin. "Do you need it too?"
"No," Dong Xuanyin answered with a shake of her head. "You’ve already entered my private quarters in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, so you should know that there’s nothing there."
Zhang Fei first called his mother-in-law, Nalan Shizhe, before purchasing three artificial dolls.
{You got artificial dolls x3.}
{3,000,000,000,000 has been deducted from your balance.}

When Nalan Shizhe arrived in the room, she let out a soft sigh upon seeing Zhang Fei still naked; however, her attention quickly shifted to the three artificial dolls, as she had never seen anything like them before. "What are these dolls for?"

"These dolls serve to replace the three of you in your domains, so no one will know if you’re absent, and you can monitor the situation there from here." Zhang Fei’s answer confused Nalan Shizhe. "You don’t need to be confused about that, and you can see them soon, but I need your hair and blood."

Nalan Shizhe, Ye Mingran, and Qi Qingxiu gave a few strands and a few drops of their blood to Zhang Fei, who right away put them inside the dolls. A few minutes later, they were stunned when the three dolls transformed into them, and they observed it with extreme seriousness, but it didn’t move an inch.

"These dolls are artificial dolls, and they can transform into anyone using that person’s hair and blood." They looked at Zhang Fei [5] curiously, but he didn’t want to explain anything to them about the system. "To move these dolls, inject a bit of your consciousness and soul power into them, and they will replace your position in your demon races."

Nalan Shizhe, Ye Mingran, and Qi Qingxiu followed Zhang Fei’s instructions, but they were truly surprised when they did, especially because the dolls moved according to their wishes. Furthermore, they could sense that the three dolls’ auras and cultivation matched their own, making them confident that people wouldn’t know they were just dolls.

After that, Zhang Fei sent the three puppets back to the Eternal Night Demon Domain, the Seven Emotions Demon Domain, and the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain. "This way, the other demon gods won’t know if you three are absent, and I’ll send you guys back there if the situation requires you to be there."
"I see." Nalan Shizhe nodded in understanding. "In that case, I’ll return to the training ground to train with the others, and you guys can continue with your activities."
After Nalan Shizhe left, Qi Qingxiu turned to Zhang Fei and asked him a question. "Why don’t you dual cultivate with them directly?"

"We can’t just improve our cultivation, okay?" Zhang Fei looked outside. "They must balance their cultivation progress with the improvement of their combat abilities; otherwise, they will be unable to face the enemies that come their way. They want to travel freely, but I can’t protect them all if they scatter, so they must be able to protect themselves. Their combat abilities have improved since they entered seclusion with me decades ago, but they aren’t enough to face the old cultivators from the Paradise Realm."

"Not only them, but we also have to improve ourselves." Ye Mingran let out a soft sigh. "We may be demon gods, but some of the other demon gods are far stronger than us. If we don’t improve our strength and combat abilities, we definitely won’t be able to defeat them."
"If we want to stand above them, we have to reach the primordial demon rank."

"You guys will never be able to reach the primordial demon rank or the origin heaven rank." The four women turned to Zhang Fei. "I once met the former primordial demon, and he told me that only one demon can reach that stage."
"That demon is you, right?"

Zhang Fei shook his head at Dong Xuanyin. "I can’t be sure yet because my demon rank is still at the Overlord Rank, but one person might be able to reach that rank in the future. However, that person isn’t in any realm because she lives in the Lotus Limbo World, and no living creature can enter that place, or they will be imprisoned there for their entire lives."
"The Lotus Limbo World?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at them. "The Lotus Limbo World is one of the worlds directly connected to the giant Yin-Yang Lotus, and the other is the Lotus Luminous World. I’ve never been to either world myself, so I can’t describe the details of either world. The former is a dark world, and it’s filled with souls condemned for their decision to challenge fate. The latter is the world without evil, burdens, and worldly emotions."
"Doesn’t that mean the Lotus Limbo World is very scary?" Ye Mingran asked with a frown.
Tian Yaoqin was even more curious about the Lotus Luminous World. "Does a world without evil, burdens, and worldly emotions truly exist?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] first sent his two wives into the training space before checking on the female ice phoenixes, but they were focused on their cultivation.
He didn’t disturb them and returned to the Moonlit Passion Temple to check on the situation there, but he didn’t enter and check everything using his senses.
Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to inspect the construction of the residences for the Qiao, Wu, Tang, Zhang, You, and Tan Clans.
With the help of the members of the giant race, the construction of their residences, which had begun two and a half months ago, began to take shape.

He was confident that all the residences would be completed within the next two months because they didn’t need particularly large residences, and all the clans could move to the Twin Flames Main Domain once they were finished.

After he finished checking everything, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to the Radiant Starfall Domain, the Lotus Expanse Domain, the Twilight Domain, the Azure Cloud Domain, and the Heavenly Mistveil Domain to check all his alchemy shops.
He met Feng Shanxi and all the women from the Blazing Nirvana Domain who were assigned by Feng Yao to protect his shop, and he also increased their stock of pills.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn’t chat with them for long and went to the Celestial Moon Domain disguised as a woman, where he met with Nanfeng Yunxi to increase the stock of pills, which had been running low.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not stay long in the Celestial Moon Sect because he did not want the people from the sect to notice his presence in their sect, and he left for another domain.
Shortly after Zhang Xiaolong [3] left, Yue Xuelian appeared on the roof of the alchemy shop and looked in the direction he left.
"Why did he come to my sect, even though he knew it was for women only?"

Ever since Feng Yao had done something to her two months ago, Yue Xuelian had been able to see everything Zhang Fei and his five clones saw, so she immediately realized it as soon as he arrived at her sect.
She was completely shocked to learn that he had hundreds of women by his side, but what shocked her most was that he shared them with his clones.

Naturally, Yue Xuelian also knew about the giant Yin-Yang Lotus because she could see Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s activities there, but she was shocked to find out that she also had connections with Shang Luohu.
She already knew that he had a connection with the three female demon gods, but she didn’t expect that he also had a connection with the Asura Demon Empress.

For the past two months, Yue Xuelian couldn’t concentrate on cultivating because the activities of Zhang Fei and his five clones with all those women kept popping up in her mind, and she didn’t meet him because she was too embarrassed to do so, especially after everything she saw during that time.

Yue Xuelian had tried to contact Feng Yao to ask her purpose for connecting her with Zhang Fei and his five clones since two months ago, but she had not given her any answer at all, making her wonder about her true motives.

Yue Xuelian also had many questions about the black and white lotus that appeared when Zhang Fei and his five clones cultivated dual souls with all those women, but she could only keep them to herself.
Even though Yan Yinqing, Nanfeng Yunxi, and Xiao Laoshu were in her sect, she couldn’t possibly ask them about it, as they would suspect her.
"Why are you here, Big Sis?
What are you looking at?"
"Nothing." Yue Xuelian shook her head at Yue Qianrou.
"I couldn’t concentrate on my cultivation, so I just wandered around to check out the situation."
’Tch!
Who are you fooling?
Your expression clearly shows that you saw something earlier!’ Yue Qianrou kept her thoughts to herself and did not press Yue Xuelian for more information.
"This shop is developing really fast, and all the cultivators in this domain keep coming to our sect just to buy pills.
In addition, Nanfeng Yunxi’s ability in alchemy is excellent, so our elders and disciples have learned a lot from her in the past two months."
"Yes." Yue Xuelian nodded slightly.
"I still didn’t expect the Three Mortal Realms to produce such powerful alchemists, like Lin Jingxia and Nanfeng Yunxi.
Moreover, the Moonlit Passion Temple still has several other powerful alchemists, and their sect has already surpassed the Divine Samsara Sect.
Even so, they can’t show their abilities openly, or the people behind the sect will attack them."
Yue Qianrou sighed heavily after recalling that.
"Unfortunately, many of our predecessors chose to join the Divine Samsara Sect, which caused our sect’s strength to decline significantly.

Although we have worked hard to maintain our sect, we have encountered many obstacles in its development, and the number of disciples joining us has continued to decline year after year as they prefer to join that sect.
If this condition continues, I’m afraid our sect will end up like other sects, especially if our sect cannot get new disciples in the future."
"I’m worried about that too." Yue Xuelian looked at the statues of the past sect leaders.
"The portal to the Forbidden Realm’s appearance marked the start of the sects’ and clans’ decline, especially after the powerful members of each sect and clan chose to guard it.
However, the desires of these powerful members suddenly changed, leading them to sever their ties with their respective sects and clans in order to establish the Divine Samsara Sect.
Since that time, the sect has gotten stronger while the other clans and sects have gotten weaker."
Yue Qianrou looked at her and asked again, "What will happen if there are no more disciples willing to join our sect, Big Sis?
Even if there are disciples willing to join us, their quality won’t be outstanding, especially since talented disciples prefer to join the Divine Samsara Sect."
"I don’t know." Yue Xuelian fell silent for a minute.
"If conditions continue to worsen, and fewer and fewer disciples are willing to join us, I think we’ll have to think of another way to maintain our sect."
"For example?"
"Merger with another sect." Yue Qianrou raised an eyebrow.
"We don’t have any other choice, right?
Eventually, we will reach a dead end, especially if there are fewer and fewer disciples who want to join our sect.
That’s why I think it’s the best solution for us and other sects, but we can’t just merge with any sect."
Yue Qianrou didn’t want to admit it, but their sect had indeed declined over time.
"Have you thought about which sect you will offer to merge with us?"
"I haven’t thought about that yet, and I want to check the situation first." Yue Xuelian flew away.
"I’m going back to my room, Qianrou."
Yue Qianrou did not leave the place and thought about several sects.
"I don’t think there’s any sect better than the Moonlit Passion Temple right now, but I’m not sure our people would agree if our sect merged with them."
Yue Xuelian had returned to her room and was sitting on her bed, but the activities of Zhang Fei and his clones appeared in her mind as soon as she closed her eyes.

Yue Xuelian sighed heavily at that, but she tried hard to ignore it all and began cultivating. ’If this situation doesn’t end, I’ll go to Zhang Fei and ask him to persuade Empress Huo to revoke her technique from me so I can cultivate in peace again.’
Xie Yao, who was having sex with Xie Yan, was surprised by Zhang Xiaolong’s [3] appearance in their valley.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was indifferent to their activities, and he also showed no interest in the female lust demon, Xie Yan.
"What’s your decision?
I’ve been waiting for four months, but you two still haven’t contacted me to tell me your decision."
The two lust demons immediately stopped having sex, and they sat facing Zhang Xiaolong [3] without bothering to get dressed.
Xie Yan tried to tease him by showing off her lower body to him, but he didn’t spare her a single glance, irritating her.
Xie Yao spoke directly to him.
"Honestly, I want to join you for a peaceful life and a secure future, but the conditions you’ve set for us are too difficult.
We can help in other ways, but not by infiltrating Qian Yan’s domain.
If that demon beast god discovers our presence, he will immediately eat us alive."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was aware of the situation and he did not dare to enter Qian Yan’s domain because of it, so he wanted to use the two lust demons for assistance.
"Is there anything we can do for you besides that?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Xie Yao.
"I can handle other matters myself, so I don’t need your help.
Since you can’t meet my requirements, you can forget about joining me."
"We—" Xie Yao didn’t continue his words because Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already disappeared from their sight, making her sigh heavily.
"What do you think we should do now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1534: Meeting His In-Laws
paragraphs: "There’s nothing we can do, right?" Xie Yan turned to ask as she sighed. "We want peace for our race, but Zhang Fei insists on us investigating Qian Yan’s domain, which is obviously impossible for us to do. Let alone investigate his domain, that demon beast god will immediately know of our presence the moment we set foot there, and he will eat us alive."

Xie Yao agreed with his wife. "If Zhang Fei were willing to loosen his conditions a bit, we might be able to fulfill his request. Unfortunately, he’s not willing to bend one bit, so there’s nothing we can do about it. Moreover, this valley and this domain will always protect us, so I think our race will be fine here."
"Yeah," Xie Yan climbed onto his husband’s lap again. "Should we find another way to get Zhang Fei to agree to help us?"
"Another way?"
"I don’t know, but I think there must be another way to convince him."
"You might be right about that, but I don’t have any other options right now, so we’ll figure it out while we have sex."
"Alright."
Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was inside the mountain where Mo Tianshen and Morgana were in seclusion, but he didn’t show himself so as not to disturb them.

Almost four months had passed since Mo Tianshen inherited the remaining strength of the former Celestial Demon God, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] could feel his power and demonic aura growing stronger, even though he was still far from the level of his big brother, Mo Shentian.

After observing Mo Tianshen for a while, Zhang Xiaolong [3] left the place. He didn’t immediately leave the Endless Domain, and he was thinking about what else needed to be done to prevent evil cultivators from invading the Twin Flames Main Domain.
[Master, if you really want that, you must go to meet the Will of the Universe in the Era of the Beginning.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] agreed with the female AI because the woman was the only one who could do that. "Do you think she would be willing to destroy those gates, Mei? The gates have been at the border for a long time, and all cultivators in the Paradise Realm use them to travel between domains, but they always bring trouble and endless war to all races. If those gates disappear, all domains will be scattered from one another, and everyone will need a long time to travel from one to another, which can reduce the trouble and war in this realm."

[I can’t answer that, Master. You should meet that woman and discuss this matter with her, and you will get the answer you want. If she agrees with your request, you have to go to all domains to save their locations in the gate feature, so you can go wherever you want at any time and from anywhere.]
"That’s right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened a gate and disappeared inside.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] arrived at the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary to meet his parents-in-law, and he found Huang Xiaoyi busy with Big Xingying and Chen Mengyao who were four and a half months and two and a half months pregnant. "Your pregnancy is quite big now, sister-in-law."

"Hehe," Bing Xingying giggled. "Isn’t this because of your help, brother-in-law? If you hadn’t helped me with your lust demon’s abilities, I might never have been able to conceive with my husband’s child since I’m a void spirit and he’s a human."
"Have you checked your child’s gender?"
"A boy."
"That’s good, isn’t it? My brother-in-law is the successor to my father-in-law, and a successor will be ready to replace him in the future."

"Haha," Bing Xingying laughed. "Brother-in-law, why do you say that? Our father-in-law can lead this sect for tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands of years, okay? Moreover, I’m still four and a half months pregnant, so that’s still too far in the future."

"That’s true." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Chen Mengyao. "Although you’re only two and a half months pregnant, and we don’t know the gender of your child yet, I can sense a strong sign of life in your womb, Sister-in-law."

Chen Mengyao nodded as she rubbed her belly. "I really can’t wait to find out the gender of my child, Brother-in-law. Unfortunately, I still have to wait another month and a half for that, so I’ll patiently wait for that day."

"I hope you will have a daughter, so our parents-in-law will be happy to have a pair of grandchildren." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked around. "Where are my father-in-law and brothers-in-law? Why didn’t they accompany you?"

"Your brothers-in-law have become more diligent with their cultivation after their two wives became pregnant, and your father-in-law is speaking to the five ancestors in a special place." Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow slightly when Huang Xiaoyi mentioned Luo Shiwen and the others. "Why did you suddenly come here? Why didn’t you bring Yunxiao with you?"

"Yunxiao is in seclusion with my real body, and I’m using this clone to check on some things." Zhang Xiaolong [3] sat in front of Huang Xiaoyi. "Mother-in-law, I came here to discuss something with you two, and I need Sister-in-law Xingying to take me somewhere."
"What do you want to discuss with us?"

"What do you think if those gates at the border were destroyed?" Huang Xiaoyi, Bing Xingying, and Chen Mengyao stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in shock. "I know that the gates make things easier for everyone in this Paradise Realm, but their existence always brings trouble and endless war to all races. If they are destroyed, the domains in this Paradise Realm will be separated, like in the Three Mortal Realms, and each will be independent. Since the distance between each domain will be very far, the demon races will not be able to easily invade other domains, and they will need a long time to do so, so I believe peace and order will be more guaranteed."

Huang Xiaoyi agreed with Zhang Xiaolong [3], but the gates had existed for millions of years or more, and all cultivators in the Paradise Realm were accustomed to moving from one domain to another freely. If all the gates were destroyed, and all the domains were separated by vast distances, then civilization would have to be rewritten. Moreover, not all domains were prosperous; some were quite backward compared to others, which would cause the people in those domains to suffer for an extended period before they could improve their circumstances.

Bing Xingying then said, "Actually, this Paradise Realm used to be no different from the Three Mortal Realms, and those gates didn’t exist before the extraordinary events that occurred in this universe, so cultivators had to travel a long way to get from one domain to another. However, that was a very long time ago, millions or billions of years ago, so all the cultivators in this realm will probably have difficulty adapting to such a situation, especially those who live in lesser and backward domains."
"Were these Paradise Realms truly separated from each other in the past, Xingying?"

"Yes, Mother." Bing Xingying created several qi screens, showing images of the Paradise Realm in the past. "I obtained all these images from the inherited memories of the previous void spirit, and she inherited them from her predecessor. Long ago, the Three Mortal Realms and the Paradise Realm were connected to each other, but something happened that forced this universe to form a barrier separating the two in order to prevent powerful cultivators from this realm from invading there. At that time, those gates did not exist in this realm, and they only appeared several million years later, so all cultivators in this realm had to travel manually."
Helian Xueyi nodded slightly as she watched all the images that appeared on all those qi screens, not expecting that the Three Mortal Realms and the Paradise Realm had the same situation in the past.
"Does that mean the people of this Paradise Realm have to return to the culture of the past? Wouldn’t that mean everyone will experience hardship in the future?" Chen Mengyao asked.

"Sister-in-law, hardship is a part of life for cultivators, okay? If they are unable to overcome such hardships, they will never become accomplished cultivators, and they will continue to face oppression from stronger cultivators in other domains."

Chen Mengyao didn’t argue with Zhang Xiaolong [3] because she was aware of it, but the impact of destroying the gates would not only affect renowned cultivators from powerful clans and sects but also lesser-known cultivators who might not have any ties to any sects or clans, and the impact would make them suffer greatly.

Huang Xiaoyi shared Chen Mengyao’s thoughts, but she felt that the situation would be better if all the domains were separated from each other. This would prevent evil cultivators and demons from roaming freely in other domains, improving the lives of the people there, even if they had to adapt to their new situation. "Can we really do that, Son?"

"For now, this matter is still just my idea, and I don’t have an answer for it yet." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Bing Xingying. "However, someone can give me an answer about whether my idea is feasible or not, and Sister-in-law Xingying can take me to that person."
Huang Xiaoyi also turned to her daughter-in-law. "Who exactly is that person, Xingying?"
"Mother, that person has no name or form, and she calls herself the Will of the Universe."

chapters.title: Chapter 1535: Meet The Will Again
paragraphs: "The Will of the Universe,"

Bing Xingying nodded at Huang Xiaoyi. "Big Sis isn’t a true living being, but she is the embodiment of the will of this universe. That’s why she knows everything that happens in this universe, from the smallest to the largest incidents and from the most recent to the most ancient history."

"How did you know her, Son? Why did she choose to appear to you but not to other living beings?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] told Huang Xiaoyi about the battle of righteous and heretic cultivators that occurred in the Sky Jade Realm many years ago, which left him stranded in the space until he met that woman. "Did she meet you because you are the next ten-tailed fox?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her and created a qi screen, showing all the interior of the Era of the Beginning, which attracted the attention of Huang Xiaoyi and Chen Mengyao.
"Eh? Why do statues of beasts occupy the first room, Brother-in-law?"

"The beast races were the first to be born in this universe." Huang Xiaoyi and Chen Mengyao turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Before other living creatures were born in this universe, the beast races already existed. The strongest among them were the ten-tailed fox born of Yin and Yang, the Primordial Genesis Beast born of Yang, and the Primordial Nihility Beast born of Yin. The old fox died long ago because it sacrificed itself for the future, but those two primordial beasts still live today in the Primordial Realm."
"The Primordial Realm?"

"The Primordial Realm is the first and oldest in this universe, and the Ancient Realm was born after it. I know about that realm, but I don’t have much information about it." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at them and continued. "If you remember about Senior Puyang Shangren and the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu we met in the Forbidden Land, they were natives of the Ancient Realm. All the clans in the Forbidden Land were part of the Ancient Clans, but they were stranded in this Paradise Realm due to a matter in the past, and they couldn’t return there because the Primordial Flame disappeared."
"The Primordial Flame?"
"The Primordial Flame is the lifeblood of the Forbidden Land, but someone took it from the Temple of the Forgotten Flame, and all the inhabitants there suffered the consequences."
"Who took the Primordial Flame?"
"Me," Feng Yao spoke as she emerged from Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s body. "I took the Primordial Flame, but I will not tell you about my purpose now, and you will know it in the future."
"Secretive as ever."
Feng Yao looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Do you really want to destroy those gates? Have you considered the risks to all the cultivators in this Paradise Realm?"

"What risks?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a shake of his head. "The cultivators in this Paradise Realm are far stronger and more established than those in the Three Mortal Realms, right? If the cultivators there can adapt to such a situation, I’m sure those living here can too, though they might need some time to adapt."

"That’s true," Feng Yao agreed with him. "However, those gates have existed for so long, and all the cultivators in this Paradise Realm have become accustomed to using them to travel, so they will need a longer time to adapt to the situation. In contrast, the cultivators in the Three Mortal Realms have never experienced such a situation, so they have already adapted to their situation long ago."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally understood that, but he felt that the Paradise Realm would be much better off without those gates, and the people from the lesser domains would be safer if other people had to travel a long time to get to their domains. "They are experienced cultivators, so they should be able to adapt quickly to their new situation. If they can’t do that, then let nature select them, and the population in this realm will be more stable."

"Haha," Feng Yao softly laughed. "I already expected that you would answer like that, but I agree with you. The population in this Paradise Realm is already too large, and it’s time for them to undergo selection. Natural selection will wipe out those who are too weak, while strong cultivators will survive without much difficulty."

Huang Xiaoyi, Chen Mengyao, and Bing Xingying could only listen to their interactions silently, making the three of them feel that Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Feng Yao had no concern for the fate of other living beings.
"Since you can access all domains via the gate, I don’t think it’s a big deal for you, and you can set up some things in other domains to help the people there."

"Why should I help them? They are cultivators, so they should find their path to their fate and future." Zhang Xiaolong [3] paused for a moment before continuing.
