chapters.title: Chapter 1536: Talk With The Will
paragraphs: "Wasn’t the Paradise Realm no different from the Three Mortal Realms in the past? Weren’t all the domains also separate from each other before you created the barrier that separated them?"

{You’re right; the two realms were indeed no different in the past.} The Will of the Universe created two qi screens: the first shows when the two realms were still one, and the second shows when the two realms were separated by the universe barrier, plus the appearance of all the gates. {As I said in the past, the universe created the barrier because the Primordial Nihility Beast sent those ancient mythical beasts to the Three Mortal Realms, and the barrier served to imprison them there.}
"Will those ancient mythical beasts be free if you remove those gates?"
{Those gates and their prisons are not connected, so the ancient mythical beasts will remain imprisoned even if the gates disappear.}

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was relieved to hear that because the cultivators in the Paradise Realm and the Three Mortal Realms would not be able to face so many angry ancient mythical beasts, and they would destroy many realms if they were freed from there.

{However, it is important to remember that the situation in the Paradise Realm differs from that in the Three Mortal Realms, and the cultivators in the Paradise Realm are accustomed to easily traveling to other domains, which means they will require a considerable amount of time to adjust to the new circumstances.}

Zhang Xiaolong [3] understood this, but he believed that the situation in the Paradise Realm would be significantly improved if those gates did not exist. "I think you’re underestimating those cultivators, and I’m sure they can adapt quickly. They might have a challenging time at first, especially those living in lesser domains, but I’m sure they’ll be able to accept their situation. Moreover, their domains won’t have to face attacks from cultivators from other domains, especially those evil beasts and demons, so their lives will be better than they are now."

{That’s true! All living creatures, especially humans, have the ability to adapt quickly. In the Paradise Realm, their population is the largest compared to other races, and many domains have more advanced technology than others, such as the Sky Pillar Domain. However, the lesser domains don’t have any of that, so you should consider a solution for them before deciding to remove those gates, as they will be overwhelmed by their new circumstances.}

Zhang Xiaolong [3] wasn’t concerned about the people from other domains, and he wanted to remove those barriers for the safety of his sect and everyone around him. However, he realized that his wish would have a wide impact on all residents of the Paradise Realm, and not all of them could adapt to the new situation quickly.

Bing Xingying asked her. "Big Sister, can you connect all the human-inhabited domains without those gates? If that were possible, they would still be able to travel to other domains, and they wouldn’t have to deal with demons and evil beasts."

{I can’t do that, Xingying. Although there are many gates, they are one entity. All of them will disappear simultaneously, so all the domains will be separated from each other, as in the past. The only way to travel from one domain to another is—}
"Teleportation device like the one I used in the Three Mortal Realms."

{However, you don’t need to use your teleportation portals; instead, you can ask the people from the Sky Pillar Domain to create them for you. I’m sure it won’t be difficult for them to create them since all domains are within the scope of the Paradise Realm, but it might take them a long time to create so many. Besides, you should talk to some people about this matter, as it will affect members of their races.}

Zhang Xiaolong [3] agreed with that. "I think all the beast and natural races won’t have a problem with that because they almost never have relations with other races, and their domains are self-sustaining. The winged race isn’t much different from them, and their race isolates itself from other races. As for the evil beast and demon races, it would be much better if they couldn’t easily invade other domains because they always bring chaos wherever they go."
{What about the demihuman races?}

"I’ve visited the Heavenly Mistveil Domain, and the demihuman races live quite prosperously there. Moreover, they don’t like contact with other races, and I also have a shop there, so I think it won’t be a problem for them." Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought of another solution for the demihuman race. "If that’s still not enough, I can do other things for them."
{For example?}

"My parents-in-law are from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and Liao Yunxiao is from the Sky Pillar Domain. I think they will be willing to help the demihuman race, and the demihumans will accept them because they are my family."
{I think all of that can be done, but it will require a lot of effort because the Paradise Realm will change completely if I remove those gates.}

"Isn’t that better than endless chaos in all domains? I know the universe created the gates to make life easier for cultivators in the Paradise Realm, but they also result in endless chaos. Although the situation in the Three Mortal Realms is also chaotic, it is much better than in the Paradise Realm, and some realms are much calmer without major chaos." The Will nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "If this Paradise Realm continues like this, it will end up like the Ancient and Primordial Realms, and there will only be destruction in it. Although removing those gates will not guarantee peace, it will at least slow down the destruction, so this Paradise Realm will not end the same as the two realms above it."

The Will sighed upon hearing that. {The birth of living beings has created chaos, and this chaos continues to persist even as new living beings and realms are formed. The chaos grows worse with each passing day, and it has become like a cancer to this universe. If we fail to end the chaos, it will lead to the destruction of this universe and the extinction of all living beings. The only hope to stop this chaos is you, the heir of the ten-tailed fox.}

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head. "Even if I evolve into the ten-tailed fox, I cannot stop the chaos by myself. You are the universe’s will, and you’ve seen the chaos that destroyed the Primordial and Ancient Realms. If you don’t help prevent it, this Paradise Realm will be destroyed like those two realms, and it will be too late once that happens. Therefore, I want to prevent the chaos from spreading further, and the initial solution is to remove those gates. All cultivators in this realm will feel the impact, but I’m sure they will be grateful for it. Although they will have to adapt for quite some time to the new situation in this realm, they will eventually get used to it. Therefore, I want you to remove those gates as soon as possible, and you can witness the changes for yourself."
{I hope you’re right about that, Zhang Fei. You should return to your domain now, and I’ll remove those gates after you return there.}
"Alright." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Bing Xingying, who immediately brought him out of the Era of the Beginning.
Not long after they left, a crimson flame appeared in the room and turned into Feng Yao, and Huo Ling immediately emerged from her body.
Huo Ling looked at the Will of the Universe before looking at her master. "Are you sure it would be okay if this Paradise Realm returned to its past state, Master?"

Feng Yao didn’t answer Huo Ling immediately and walked towards the wall, where the picture of the beginning of their universe was located. "The situation in this universe is already too dire, and it continues to move towards total destruction. If the situation continues like this, this universe will disappear forever, but I have no solution to stop that destruction. Zhang Fei’s method will not be able to stop the chaos, but it will slow down the destruction of this universe, and he will probably find another way to save it in the future."

"Haish," Huo Ling hissed while shaking her head. "I still don’t understand why you have so much confidence in Zhang Fei, Master. I know he is different from other living beings, but he is too weak to be able to bring about change in this universe, and he will probably fail to save it."

"Haha," Feng Yao laughed and turned to face Huo Ling. "Zhang Fei is still weak, but I also don’t have a solution to save this universe. So why don’t we try his method and return the situation in this Paradise Realm to how it was in the past? Perhaps his method won’t work perfectly, but it will at least give him plenty to think of a better way to save this universe."
Huo Ling sighed softly. "I still don’t believe Zhang Fei will succeed in saving this universe, so I’ll wait and see what happens in the future."
"Let’s go back."

After Feng Yao disappeared, the Will of the Universe waved her hand, and a great change that shook the Paradise Realm began to occur. {Let’s see if your method will be effective in stopping the destruction of this universe, Zhang Fei.}

chapters.title: Chapter 1537: Chaos In The Paradise Realm I
paragraphs: A great panic occurred at the border of the Paradise Realm as soon as the gates began to crack, and the people there rushed in without caring about their destination. The guards at the gates, unable to stop the crowd, ultimately decided to follow the people through the gates according to their origins.
"What happened, Yao’er? Why is our domain shaking so violently?" Feng Jiu asked her as soon as Feng Yao returned.
Feng Tian also found it strange, as he hadn’t experienced anything like an earthquake since he and his wife arrived in the Paradise Realm years ago. "Did you do something, Yao’er?"
"It wasn’t me, but Zhang Fei." Feng Jiu and Feng Tian exchanged shocked glances before following their daughter to the balcony. "Look at that."
Feng Jiu and Feng Tian looked at the portal to enter the Blazing Nirvana Domain, but it slowly disappeared. "What happened to the portal?"

"All portals connecting the border and all domains will disappear soon, which happened because Zhang Fei asked the Will of the Universe to remove them." Feng Jiu and Feng Tian looked at Feng Yao again, as they didn’t understand how Zhang Fei could do such a thing. "After today, all domains in the Paradise Realm will no longer be connected to each other, and it will take a long time to travel to other domains, like in the Three Mortal Realms."
"Were you the one who gave Zhang Fei the idea to do that, Yao’er?"

Feng Yao shook her head at her mother. "Zhang Fei came up with the idea himself because he wanted to protect his sect and the people around him, and he was the only person who could speak with the Will of the Universe."

"Why did you lie to me? The woman you summoned a few months ago is the Will of the Universe, right?" Feng Yao just smiled and did not answer her mother, making Feng Jiu sigh heavily. "Does that mean your other identity is this universe itself, Yao’er?"

Feng Tian was shocked to hear his wife say that because he had been in seclusion ever since Feng Yao brought them to her domain, and he didn’t know anything that happened after that. "Is your mother right, Yao’er? Are you the universe itself?"
"Haha," Feng Yao softly laughed. "You two can think whatever you like for now, and you will know all the answers in the future."
Feng Jiu and Feng Tian sighed as soon as Feng Yao disappeared from their sight, but her silence convinced them that their suspicions were correct. "What exactly happened to our daughter, Husband?"

"I don’t know," Feng Tian replied with a soft sigh. "Yao’er has been mysterious since she was born and growing up, and I’ve never been able to understand her. If she is indeed the embodiment of this universe itself, I think she has another purpose that she is deliberately hiding from us."
Feng Jiu fell silent as she stared at the portal, which was getting fainter. "What will happen in the future? Are we really going to lose our only daughter?"
"I don’t have the answer for you."

Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, Tianshi Bailong, and Feng Jinhuang also sensed the change. They immediately left their private quarters to check the situation, but they were shocked to see the portal connecting the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain and the border begin to disappear.
"What happened, Golden Dragon Emperor? Why did the portal start to disappear?" Feng Jinhuang asked dengan tampang serius.
"Brother Xukong."

"Yes," Long Xukong immediately entered the void to check the border, but he returned to their side shortly after. "The situation at the border is very chaotic, Brother Wuzhao. Those gates suddenly cracked by themselves, which caused all the portals to start disappearing."

"If those gates disappear, all the domains in this Paradise Realm will be scattered like in the Three Mortal Realms, and we will need time to travel to other domains." Tianshi Bailong turned to Long Wuzhao. "Do you think this incident has something to do with Empress Huo?"
Long Wuzhao thought for a long time before answering him. "I don’t think today’s incident has anything to do with Empress Huo, and I feel like it has something to do with Zhang Fei."
"Zhang Fei?" Long Xukong, Tianshi Bailong, and Feng Jinhuang were shocked by this. "Do you really think that kid did this, Golden Dragon Emperor?"
Long Wuzhao shook his head slightly. "That’s just my guess, and we have to find Zhang Fei to confirm it."
"Shall we go see Zhang Fei now?"

"Bring us to Zhang Fei, Brother Xukong." Long Xukong immediately opened a hole into the void, and the four mythical beasts hurriedly entered it, heading toward the Twin Flames Main Domain. They had to move quickly before all the gates disappeared completely, or it would take them a long time to arrive at that domain.
In the Floral Mirage Domain.
Jia Leixuan stood in the air with Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun, staring at the disappearing portal. "What exactly is happening? Why is the portal starting to disappear on its own?"
"If the portal disappeared on its own, it means something happened at the border and those gates."
Jia Lingzhu turned to her husband. "What do you think caused today’s incident, Old Man?"

"The gates have existed since the time of our ancestors, and no one has ever been able to destroy them. Even the terrible catastrophes of the past didn’t affect them, so I have no idea what caused it." Jia Shengyun furrowed his brows when he remembered something. "Could it be that this incident has something to do with Zhang Fei?"
"Zhang Fei?"
Jia Shengyun nodded at them. "Zhang Fei has many mysterious abilities, and all his actions are difficult to predict. Yuyan is currently in seclusion, so I can’t contact her to ask about this matter."

"How about we go to the Twin Flames Main Domain now? The portal hasn’t disappeared, so we should still be able to go there through the border." Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu exchanged glances for a moment before agreeing with Jia Leixuan, and the three quickly disappeared into the portal, heading toward the Twin Flames Main Domain.
Just like the fairy race, the other natural races were also wondering about the incident, but they had never met Zhang Fei before, so they didn’t think he was the cause.

Although the change was sudden, they were glad the portal disappeared because people wouldn’t be able to enter their domains at will if it disappeared, which guaranteed the safety and peace of their races.
Chaos also broke out in the Radiance Domain.
Tian Qiye and all the grand elders by her side, including the puppet Tian Yaoqin, stood in the sky, watching the portal continue to disappear.
"Leader, what do you think happened? Why did the portal disappear by itself?" Tian Liefeng asked.

"I don’t have an answer to that," Tian Qiye replied with a shake of her head. "Even though this incident is truly strange, I think it will be beneficial for us. Some demon gods are always thinking of invading our domain, and they won’t be able to do so if those gates at the border disappear. Even if they still want to invade our domain, they will need to undertake a long journey to reach it, and we can prepare to fight them."
"Could it be that Empress Huo caused this, Leader?" Tian Hanyun asked.
"Empress Huo has been powerful since the past, but she never thought about destroying those gates, so I think the mastermind behind today’s incident is someone else."
"Are those mythical beasts the culprit?"

Tian Qiye first considered several possibilities. "If Long Wuzhao or the others wanted to destroy those gates, they could have done so in the past, but they never tried. Whoever caused today’s incident must have the same thoughts as us. Although the disappearance of those gates will make it difficult for us to go to other domains, we don’t need to worry about that because our domain has everything, and we also never cooperate with other races."
"So, are we not doing anything to investigate this matter?"

"Honestly, I always harbor the hope that those gates will disappear, so we don’t need to guard and think about external threats, and we can focus on our race." Tian Qiye looked toward the residences of Tian Yizu and the others. "You don’t need to bother with today’s events because they will benefit us, and I want you all to focus on reaching the Celestial God Realm as soon as possible so you can evolve like me. After you all evolve, we will go to one of the demon domains, and we will destroy those heretics."
"Which demon race will we target first, Leader?"

"The Eternal Night Demon Race." Tian Liefeng and the others were not surprised by Tian Qiye’s answer. "Ye Mingran has never attacked us, but her predecessor repeatedly attacked us in the past. Many members of our race died due to these past attacks, so we will begin our actions against her demon race. Let’s go back and continue your seclusion, and you don’t have to leave until you reach that stage."

Tian Liefeng and the others immediately returned to their respective places, but Tian Qiye remained standing at her spot as she looked at Tian Yaoqin. She was still suspicious of her, but she couldn’t find anything wrong with her. "Could it be that my suspicions about her were wrong?"
"What happened to the portal, Father?" Tian Huangjin asked her father.

chapters.title: Chapter 1538: Chaos In The Paradise Realm II
paragraphs: Tian Yizu looked at the fading portal. "The situation in the Paradise Realm will change completely after this, and all the domains will be scattered far apart, just like in the Three Mortal Realms."
"Huh?" Tian Huangjin was shocked and looked up at the sky. "What exactly happened? Why did the portal suddenly disappear by itself?"

"I don’t know the exact cause, but I suspect today’s incident had something to do with Zhang Fei." Tian Huangjin felt that his father’s suspicion was correct that Zhang Fei was the cause of today’s mysterious incident. "I’ve tried contacting him, but he didn’t give me an answer, and Tian Zhiling told me that he’s taken all his wives into seclusion."
"Yizu!" Tian Wei, Tian Xuanyin, and Tian You’an ran into the room. "Do you think the cause of today’s incident is Zhang Fei?"

Tian Yizu nodded to them. "I don’t have proof, but I’m sure that Zhang Fei is the cause. Although this incident happened suddenly, I think it’s beneficial for all races. With the disappearance of those gates, all domains will be isolated from each other, so those evil beasts and demons will not be able to invade other domains as easily as in the past, and casualties will decrease significantly."
"I think the disappearance of the gate will not have much of an impact on the winged races, beast races, natural races, and demon races, but the impact will be significant for the human races."

Tian Yizu agreed with Tian Wei. "Humans are the most selfish and greedy race, and they will never be satisfied with their achievements. Eventually, many battles will occur in the human domains, and the situation in all domains will become chaotic. Even so, we should not concern ourselves with them; instead, we must focus on the situation within our domain."
"You mean?"

Tian Yizu nodded to Tian You’an. "With all the domains separated from each other, the threat from other races to our race will be significantly reduced or even disappear completely. Tian Qiye will start thinking of ways to get rid of us, and she will try to pull all members of our race to her side, so we must always be wary of her and her loyalists."
Tian Wei, Tian Xuanyin, and Tian You’an’s expressions turned serious after Tian Yizu said that. "What should we do now?"

"Nothing." Tian Yizu looked at them. "For now, we must focus on our cultivation to reach the Celestial God Realm and evolve as soon as possible so we can strengthen our position within our race, and Tian Qiye won’t be able to get rid of us that easily. Alright, you guys can go back to your respective places and focus on your cultivation, and you don’t need to take care of other matters because the people under us can take care of them."
After they left, Tian Huangjin asked her father. "What if I go to the Moonlit Passion Temple to look for Zhang Fei, Father?"

"Hmm?" Tian Yizu thought for a moment. "I think you can go there, and Tian Qiye won’t bother you with your departure now. I want you to stay there for a while and focus on your cultivation so you won’t get involved in our race’s affairs if he suddenly makes a move against us. Oh! Don’t forget to invite Tian Huotian to go with you."
"Yes, Father." Tian Huangjin left the place as she contacted Tian Houtian, and the two of them went straight to the Twin Flames Main Domain since the portal had not yet disappeared completely.
Tian Yizu stood alone and sighed softly. "Ancestor, I hope you quickly regain your old strength so you can lead our race to a better future."
In the Celestial Demon Race Palace, Mo Zainan stood alone on the balcony, staring at the fading portal.

"After several generations, the portal will soon disappear. Although this event happened suddenly, I believe this will be the best opportunity for my demon race, especially since other demon races will not be able to invade our domain as easily as before." Mo Zainan contacted her subordinates and ordered them to calm down their demon race members, who appeared boisterous due to the appearance of the portal. "Anqi and Yousha, I hope you two will be fine in the Moonlit Passion Temple. If you two run into trouble in the sect, you should ask Zhang Fei to help you."

Shang Luohu stood on the balcony of the Asura Demon Palace, with Shang Fengxue, Shang Zhui and the four asura guardians standing behind her, looking towards the fading portal. "This Paradise Realm will undergo a great change after several generations, and all domains will be separated from each other with the disappearance of those gates."
"How could this happen, Empress?"
"Those gates have existed since ancient times, but they suddenly self-destructed."
"The gates’ disappearance will hinder our travel to other domains, but it will also hinder the other demon gods’ travel to our domain, so I think this is best for everyone."
"Fortunately, we have never been dependent on other domains, so the disappearance of the gates will not have much of an impact on our race."

Unlike the four asura guardians, Shang Zhui had other thoughts about the disappearance of those gates, and he had already tried asking Tian Shuixiang about it. Although his son didn’t have an answer to his question, he was certain that his suspicion about the mastermind behind today’s events was Zhang Fei. ’How could he do that? Those gates have existed for millions, if not billions, of years, and there had never been any problems with them before, but he destroyed them without warning.’

Shang Fengxue also had the same thoughts as Shang Zhui, especially after she saw all the changes that Zhang Fei had brought to the Moonlit Passion Temple. ’Sister-in-law, do you think that the disappearance of those gates was the work of that kid?’

’Yes,’ Shang Luohu nodded at her sister-in-law. ’I still can’t gauge the depth of Zhang Fei’s strength, but I’ve seen some things related to him, and I’m sure he has a way to destroy those gates without everyone realizing he’s the culprit.’
’For example?’
’I can’t tell you all about that, but I can tell you that Zhang Fei is our only hope for peace, and today’s incident is one solution.’
Shang Fengxue immediately flew away. ’Since you are unwilling to tell me the truth, I will go to the Moonlit Passion Temple to find the answer myself.’
’A stubborn girl!’ Shang Luohu turned to the others. "You may all leave now and calm our race members who are panicked by today’s events."
"Yes, Empress."
After the four Asura Guardians left, Shang Zhui asked his empress. "Do you have the same thoughts as me, Empress?"
"Zhang Fei is the cause of the disappearance of those gates, but we need not dwell on that, and I hope our Asura Demon Race will be calmer after today."
"I hope you are right, Empress."

Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu looked towards the portal, wondering about the cause of its disappearance. The Nine Nether Demon God ordered the demons under him to manage the situation within their domain, especially since panic and commotion were sweeping across their race.
"Do you think our master is the cause of the disappearance of those gates, Master?"

Jiu Moze nodded slightly. "Our master has unlimited power, and he has many powerful cultivators by his side, so I believe he is the cause of the disappearance of those gates. Since all domains will be separated like in the past, it will be difficult for us to travel to other domains, but it will also be challenging for the other demon gods to travel to our domain. This situation will bring peace to our demon race for a while, and our members will be able to better prepare themselves while waiting for our master’s next orders."
"What do you think our master’s plan is, Master?"
"We don’t need to question his plans, and we just need to wait for him to give us orders."
Wu Mian, the Faceless Demon God, sat on one of Arbeola’s trunks, looking towards the portal. "Do you think Zhang Fei is the reason those gates disappeared?"

"Hahaha," Arbeola laughed at that. "Demon God, you’ve seen all of Zhang Fei’s actions in the Netherworld Realm, so you should already know that we can’t underestimate him, right? He may still be weaker than you now, but he was also very weak when he first came to that realm, and his arrival there brought about major changes to that realm."

Wu Mian nodded slightly. "Regardless of where Zhang Fei goes, he is destined to bring change to all those places. He has already brought change to the Netherworld Realm, and he has begun bringing change to this Paradise Realm. I don’t know the plan behind his decision to destroy those gates, but the situation in this realm will be much calmer after today. The other demon gods must be racking their brains to devise other strategies to conquer the other races, but I’m sure their plans won’t be able to be implemented immediately, especially since they need to adapt to these changes first."

"Although the situation will be calmer from today on, Zhang Fei cannot let his guard down for the slightest bit, and he must be vigilant against all eventualities." Then, Arbeola asked him, "Are you going to his domain to ask him?"
"I won’t ask him, and I’ll wait for his next plans."

’For example?’
’I can’t tell you all about that, but I can tell you that Zhang Fei is our only hope for peace, and today’s incident is one solution.’
Shang Fengxue immediately flew away. ’Since you are unwilling to tell me the truth, I will go to the Moonlit Passion Temple to find the answer myself.’
’A stubborn girl!’ Shang Luohu turned to the others.
"You may all leave now and calm our race members who are panicked by today’s events."
"Yes, Empress."
After the four Asura Guardians left, Shang Zhui asked his empress.
"Do you have the same thoughts as me, Empress?"
"Zhang Fei is the cause of the disappearance of those gates, but we need not dwell on that, and I hope our Asura Demon Race will be calmer after today."
"I hope you are right, Empress."
Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu looked towards the portal, wondering about the cause of its disappearance.
The Nine Nether Demon God ordered the demons under him to manage the situation within their domain, especially since panic and commotion were sweeping across their race.
"Do you think our master is the cause of the disappearance of those gates, Master?"
Jiu Moze nodded slightly.
"Our master has unlimited power, and he has many powerful cultivators by his side, so I believe he is the cause of the disappearance of those gates.
Since all domains will be separated like in the past, it will be difficult for us to travel to other domains, but it will also be challenging for the other demon gods to travel to our domain.
This situation will bring peace to our demon race for a while, and our members will be able to better prepare themselves while waiting for our master’s next orders."
"What do you think our master’s plan is, Master?"
"We don’t need to question his plans, and we just need to wait for him to give us orders."
Wu Mian, the Faceless Demon God, sat on one of Arbeola’s trunks, looking towards the portal.
"Do you think Zhang Fei is the reason those gates disappeared?"
"Hahaha," Arbeola laughed at that.
"Demon God, you’ve seen all of Zhang Fei’s actions in the Netherworld Realm, so you should already know that we can’t underestimate him, right?
He may still be weaker than you now, but he was also very weak when he first came to that realm, and his arrival there brought about major changes to that realm."
Wu Mian nodded slightly.
"Regardless of where Zhang Fei goes, he is destined to bring change to all those places.
He has already brought change to the Netherworld Realm, and he has begun bringing change to this Paradise Realm.
I don’t know the plan behind his decision to destroy those gates, but the situation in this realm will be much calmer after today.

The other demon gods must be racking their brains to devise other strategies to conquer the other races, but I’m sure their plans won’t be able to be implemented immediately, especially since they need to adapt to these changes first."

"Although the situation will be calmer from today on, Zhang Fei cannot let his guard down for the slightest bit, and he must be vigilant against all eventualities." Then, Arbeola asked him, "Are you going to his domain to ask him?"
"I won’t ask him, and I’ll wait for his next plans."

chapters.title: Chapter 1539: Chaos In The Paradise Realm III
paragraphs: *Tap... Tap...*
"What do you think happened, husband? What caused the gates to collapse?"

Sha Mo hugged his wife’s waist. "I don’t have any definite information about today’s incident, and I’ve ordered people to inspect the gates, but they don’t know what caused them to collapse. Although the disappearance of the gates will complicate my plans, I’m also grateful for today’s events because the other demon gods won’t be able to attack us easily, which will make our task of protecting our race easier."

Sha Yuan was aware of this, but she was curious about the cause of today’s incident because those gates had existed for generations, and no one had ever been able to destroy them, including the four perils.
"Where is our son?"
"Since I forbade him from leaving, Huo’er has been cultivating in his room."

Sha Mo nodded slightly. "Since those gates will disappear soon, we don’t have to worry about our son escaping and going to other domains. I hope he can continue to focus on his cultivation, and I will pass on my position to him when he is ready."

"Yeah," Then, Sha Yuan asked her husband. "What about your plans for the Asura Demon Race if all domains separate in the future? We don’t have clear information about the distance between our domain and the Slaughter Blood Domain, and you will face difficulties in your plans if the distance between the two domains is too far."

"I’ve thought about that too, but I haven’t found a solution yet. I’ll wait until those gates disappear completely, then I can determine my next move." Sha Mo looked up at the sky. "Even if the distance between the two domains becomes too great, it’s not a big deal for me because Shang Zhanluo will fall under my control soon, and I can control him from here."

Sha Yuan sighed softly. "I hope this matter ends quickly so we can reset everything. Although the disappearance of those gates won’t have a significant impact on our demon race, it will still have an impact on our situation and plans."
"Let’s we wait for what will happen in the future, Wife."
Among the demon races, only the Torture Demon God, Ku Shenzu, and the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God, Qian Yan, were not bothered by the disappearance of those gates.

Hun Lingwu stood on the roof of the Immortal Soul Palace with a gloomy expression, as he sensed the changes within the Samsara Domain, especially with the portal starting to disappear. He thought about leaving his sect and going to the Twin Flames Main Domain, but he was worried that he would have difficulty escaping from there.

Hun Tianyu landed behind his master and asked him, "Master, what exactly happened? I just returned from the border, and all the gates are starting to collapse. If this continues, all the domains in this Paradise Realm will be safely separated, and we will face many difficulties. Currently, all human domains are being hit by mass panic, especially those lesser domains."

"I don’t know." Hun Lingwu sighed heavily. "For now, we shouldn’t go to the other domains because we don’t know the exact situation, and we’ll have trouble returning here if the distance between the domains becomes too great."

Hun Tianyu nodded slightly. "I anticipated that, so I’ve already asked the elders to have all our disciples in the other domains return. Otherwise, our sect will be in trouble if they can’t return to this domain, especially since they don’t have any capable flying artifacts."
"Let’s wait for the process to end, and I will determine my next steps after that."
"What exactly happened in this realm, Grandfather? How could those gates collapse so suddenly?"

Zhi Yongbo shook his head at his son and daughter-in-law. "Today’s events were too sudden, and all the cultivators from all domains surely never expected that those gates would collapse after having existed for generations."
"If all domains are separated like this in the future, I’m sure our domains will experience a significant decline, especially if the distance between them becomes too far."

Zhi Yongbo agreed with them. "Our domain has certainly experienced a decline, but I’m sure it won’t be as significant as some other domains. I’m confident that our domain will flourish once the situation stabilizes and cultivators from other domains adjust to their new circumstances."
"I hope you’re right, Grandfather."
"Where are Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen? Why don’t I see them?"
"They went to the Twin Flames Main Domain when the gates began to collapse."

Zhi Yongbo frowned for a moment. "Although we don’t know the future situation, let them go to that domain for now, and they can return using their flying artifacts later. You two should go now and calm our panicked clansmen and tell them not to worry about the situation."
"Yes, Grandfather."

Unlike the Zhi Clan, the situation in the Fei Clan has become increasingly chaotic with the disappearance of the portal, especially since they haven’t found a solution to cure Fei Juechen. Hun Lingwu can’t do anything to help him, and Zhang Fei has repeatedly refused their requests to restore his condition.

Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang considered trying to meet Zhang Fei again before the gates and portals disappeared completely, but they decided against it and waited for the future situation to be resolved, especially since the widespread panic was sweeping across the domain.
Unlike them, the Liao, You, and Qiao Clans did not panic at all at the change in the situation.
"What exactly is happening in this Paradise Realm, Big Sis?"
Yue Xuelian shook her head at Yue Qianrou. "I don’t know how it happened, but those gates and portals are slowly disintegrating, and all domains will be separated from each other soon."
"Huh?" Yue Qianrou was shocked. "How could that happen? Those gates have existed for generations, and no one has ever been able to destroy them."

Yue Xuelian let out a soft sigh. "I don’t know the reason, but I think the current situation is beneficial for us because we no longer need to submit to the Divine Samsara Sect, and we can reorganize our future after this is over. Moreover, Zhang Fei has an alchemy shop in our sect, and his pills are enough to meet the needs of our domain’s residents."

"Then, what if the distance between our domain and his domain becomes too far? How will his people increase the stock of those pills? If we run out of stock, the people in this domain will probably protest and attack us."
"Hehe," Yan Yinqing giggled as she landed beside them. "Vice Sect Master Qianrou, I understand your worries, but you really don’t need to worry about that."
Yue Qianrou turned to her. "What do you mean by that? How can I not worry about the changing situation?"

"See this?" Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou looked at the object in Yan Yinqing’s hand. "This is the teleportation device my junior brother gave me before we left for this sect, and we can connect the two domains using this regardless of the distance. He gave it to me so that I, Nanfeng Yunxi, and Xiao Laoshu could return to our sect at any time, but I haven’t found the right location to install it, so I still keep it with me."
"Don’t tell me that this sudden change in the realm happened because of Zhang Fei."

Yan Yinqing shook her head slightly. "I haven’t spoken to my junior brother about this matter, so I can’t give you a definite answer, Sect Master Xuelian. As you said before, this change in the realm will be beneficial for this sect because those new disciples don’t have capable flight artifacts to travel to other domains, so they have no choice but to join an existing sect. However, this sect will also have difficulty getting new disciples from other domains, especially because they will also have difficulty coming here."

"Yes," Yue Xuelian was also aware of that, but she wasn’t too worried about it because the female population in the Celestial Moon Domain was several times larger than the male population, and they still had the Moon Tower to scout for talents among cultivators ascending from the Three Mortal Realms.

Yan Yinqing spoke to them again. "If you two want the sect to progress further after the changes to this realm are complete, I think you should go find my junior brother and discuss this matter with him. However, he’s currently in seclusion, and I don’t know exactly when he’ll come out."
"Can Zhang Fei really help us?" Yue Qianrou asked doubtfully.

Yan Yinqing smiled at her. "Vice Sect Master Qianrou, you can doubt others, but you mustn’t doubt my junior brother. I have personally witnessed all his actions in the Three Mortal Realms until he brought us to this realm, so I am certain that he is the only person who can help you all improve this sect."

"Let me see that device." Yan Yinqing handed the teleportation device to Yue Xuelian. "How about we install it near my private quarters? Only Qianrou and the elders can go there, so I think that’s the safest place to install it."

Yan Yinqing nodded at her. "If you feel that’s the best option, we can install it there right now, and I’ll contact my junior brother to install the other half in our sect, so the two domains and sects will be connected from now on."
"Let’s go." Yan Yinqing and Yue Qianrou immediately followed behind Yue Xuelian.

chapters.title: Chapter 1540: Chaos In The Paradise Realm IV
paragraphs: In the demihuman palace, several people stood there with solemn expressions, watching the portal continue to fade.
"Father, are those gates really going to disappear?" Just like his wife, Yao Qianmo also felt worried about the disappearance of the gates.

Long Lingxun stood silently as he looked up at the sky, but his fists were tightly clenched because the change would make it difficult for him to take revenge. Guang Lianyu was aware of her husband’s feelings, but she could only sigh in her heart because he was never willing to listen to her about his old grudge against the demons.

Long Huoyan shook his head at his second daughter, Long Feiyue. "I don’t know what exactly happened to those gates, but today’s events should be good for the future of our race, as other races won’t easily attack us, especially those demons and evil beasts."
"Moreover, our domain is enough to support the lives of everyone who lives here, so I don’t think we need to think too much about that." Huo Jinying continued her husband’s words.
Si Yingwu spoke straight away. "Our domain is indeed rich and fertile, but the number of demihuman races is not small. We will experience serious problems, and the people will probably rebel."

"I’ve thought about that too." Long Huoyan released a soft sigh. "For now, I can’t think of a way out, and we must wait for this sudden change to pass. Our people have been independent for generations, but we still need their help in some things. After all this change is over, I will lead some people to check which domains are closest to ours."
"I don’t think you need to worry about that." Long Huoyan and his family looked at Huo Fengyin. "My empress asks you to remain calm, and Zhang Fei will come here to help you deal with the situation."
"Does today’s incident have anything to do with Empress Huo and Zhang Fei?"

"My empress didn’t do anything." Huo Fengyin looked up at the sky. "My empress told me that today’s incident stemmed from Zhang Fei, but I don’t know what exactly he did because she didn’t tell me the details, and she only asked me to calm you all down."

"Zhang Fei," Long Huoyan muttered. "How could he destroy those gates that have existed for generations? Even Emperor Long and the others couldn’t do that, and those gates remained intact even though they tried to destroy them in the past."

"I don’t know how Zhang Fei could do that, but I know that he is no ordinary cultivator, and the future of this Paradise Realm rests on his shoulders." Huo Fengyin disappeared immediately after she said that.

"My daughter just contacted me, and she said there was no panic at the Moonlit Passion Temple." Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying turned to Si Yingwu. "I think Zhang Fei is indeed the mastermind behind the changes that have occurred in this Paradise Realm, and he has already informed his sect members about this matter. The situation in the sect is very normal, and the people there are not concerned about the disappearance of those gates."
Long Huoyan released a soft sigh. "Let’s wait for this change to complete, and we will also wait for Zhang Fei to come to our domain again."

"Yes," Huo Jinying agreed with her husband. "Even though it’s only been open for three months, Zhang Fei’s alchemy shop has already brought significant changes to our race members, so I think we can trust him on this matter."

The gates situation caused a huge commotion in the Divine Samsara Sect, and everyone in the sect gathered to discuss the situation. They had been relying on people from various domains to strengthen their sect, and they were worried that the gates’ disappearance would greatly affect their sect. With the disappearance of those gates, the distance between all domains would increase, and sects or clans from other domains that had been dependent on them would stop and look for other ways to strengthen themselves.

Liang Huizhong looked at everyone who was continuing to discuss the changing situation noisily in the Paradise Realm. "For now, I don’t have a solution to deal with the changing situation, especially since this incident happened too suddenly. We must first assess the situation and measure the right distance between each domain, as we have no records of their past distance. One thing is certain: our sect and domain will face serious problems, even though these problems will not immediately appear and grow bigger. I want all of you to temporarily halt your activities, and you must prepare to deal with the changing situation; otherwise, our situation will become very dire if we cannot cope with the changes."
"Aren’t you going to tell the ancestors about the changes in this realm, Sect Master?" A female elder asked.

"Do you think I need to do that, Guang Lingfei?" Liang Huizhong asked, shaking his head. "Before I gathered you all here, they had already contacted me and asked me to find the best solution to deal with this sudden change. They were worried that the situation would weaken our sect, but they would not intervene to resolve this issue, and they would only come out of their seclusion if danger threatened the future of the sect."

Guang Lingfei and the elders were disappointed with their ancestors’ decision, but they also understood their intentions. After all, they were top cultivators themselves, and they couldn’t rely on their ancestors to solve any problems that arose.
"Leave now and handle the situation properly."
"What about those disciples, Sect Master? Many of them panicked and left the sect to return to their respective domains, and they’ll have a hard time returning here if those gates disappear."

Liang Huizhong couldn’t blame the disciples because the situation had happened all of a sudden, and he couldn’t possibly stop them from returning to their respective domains to check on their families. "We shouldn’t worry about them for now; instead, we should allow them to help their families first. If they can’t return because the gates are gone, you guys must pick them up again, and I’ll find a way to make it easier for them to come and go. You don’t have to pick them all; just take the most outstanding talents to lessen the burden on our sect due to this sudden change."

All the elders were surprised by Liang Huizhong’s decision, but they also felt that it was the best solution for their sect at this time. After all, they still didn’t know the distance between each domain after the change was over, and they also had to think about the reserve resources stored in their sects and domains.
After a long discussion, all the elders left the place, and Liang Huizhong also went to another place to meet some other people.
In the alchemy shop, three people sat together discussing the sudden changes that had occurred in their realm. They were Jin Nanqing, Luo Lianjin, and Xuan Yun.
"Master, what do you think is really happening?"

Jin Nanqing shook his head at his first disciple. "I don’t know exactly what happened in this realm, but I think this change will bring good things to the other domains. Our sect has monopolized everything since our ancestors discovered the portal to the Forbidden Land, which has caused other sects and clans to decline significantly. With all the domains separated without those gates, our sect will no longer be able to control them, and they will flourish again over time."

"Master, do you think this sudden change has something to do with Empress Huo and Zhang Fei?" Jin Nanqing looked at his second disciple, Xuan Yun, with raised eyebrows. "I say this because their appearance has brought many changes to this realm, especially Zhang Fei’s actions. The first change that occurred was at the Moonlit Passion Temple, and the Twin Flames Main Domain has undergone significant changes since his arrival. The condition of the domain changed greatly, and now many formations cover the entire area there, which makes it difficult for outsiders to enter."

Jin Nanqing nodded slightly. "The changes Zhang Fei brought to the Moonlit Passion Temple and the Twin Flames Main Domain are indeed astonishing, and he managed to persuade many powerful cultivators to join him, including Jian Kuang and Su Shentian. Additionally, he also managed to persuade several renowned clans to cooperate with him, such as the Liao, Qiao, You, and Zhang Clans. I can’t say for sure whether the changes in this realm happened because of him, but I think it’s a possibility. For now, we need to put him and his sect aside and focus on the situation in our own sect. I hope these changes will lead to improvements for all cultivators and their respective domains."
"Yes, Master."
Xiao Jingyi stood atop her residence and looked up at the sky. "Do you think this change will be good for all cultivators and domains, Senior?"

"I don’t know," Huo Xiaoyu replied with a shake of her head. "Whether it’s good or not, we can only see the results in the future. At least this change will reduce the chaos between all races, and the situation will be better with all domains separated from each other."
"I still didn’t expect Zhang Fei to be able to do all this, Senior."
"Haha," Huo Xiaoyu softly laughed. "I don’t know much about Zhang Fei myself, but my empress has full confidence in him, so I will also believe in him."

"I don’t think you need to worry about that." Long Huoyan and his family looked at Huo Fengyin.
"My empress asks you to remain calm, and Zhang Fei will come here to help you deal with the situation."
"Does today’s incident have anything to do with Empress Huo and Zhang Fei?"
"My empress didn’t do anything." Huo Fengyin looked up at the sky.
"My empress told me that today’s incident stemmed from Zhang Fei, but I don’t know what exactly he did because she didn’t tell me the details, and she only asked me to calm you all down."
"Zhang Fei," Long Huoyan muttered.
"How could he destroy those gates that have existed for generations?
Even Emperor Long and the others couldn’t do that, and those gates remained intact even though they tried to destroy them in the past."

"I don’t know how Zhang Fei could do that, but I know that he is no ordinary cultivator, and the future of this Paradise Realm rests on his shoulders." Huo Fengyin disappeared immediately after she said that.
"My daughter just contacted me, and she said there was no panic at the Moonlit Passion Temple." Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying turned to Si Yingwu.
"I think Zhang Fei is indeed the mastermind behind the changes that have occurred in this Paradise Realm, and he has already informed his sect members about this matter.
The situation in the sect is very normal, and the people there are not concerned about the disappearance of those gates."
Long Huoyan released a soft sigh.
"Let’s wait for this change to complete, and we will also wait for Zhang Fei to come to our domain again."
"Yes," Huo Jinying agreed with her husband.
"Even though it’s only been open for three months, Zhang Fei’s alchemy shop has already brought significant changes to our race members, so I think we can trust him on this matter."
The gates situation caused a huge commotion in the Divine Samsara Sect, and everyone in the sect gathered to discuss the situation.
They had been relying on people from various domains to strengthen their sect, and they were worried that the gates’ disappearance would greatly affect their sect.

With the disappearance of those gates, the distance between all domains would increase, and sects or clans from other domains that had been dependent on them would stop and look for other ways to strengthen themselves.
Liang Huizhong looked at everyone who was continuing to discuss the changing situation noisily in the Paradise Realm.
"For now, I don’t have a solution to deal with the changing situation, especially since this incident happened too suddenly.
We must first assess the situation and measure the right distance between each domain, as we have no records of their past distance.
One thing is certain: our sect and domain will face serious problems, even though these problems will not immediately appear and grow bigger.
I want all of you to temporarily halt your activities, and you must prepare to deal with the changing situation; otherwise, our situation will become very dire if we cannot cope with the changes."
"Aren’t you going to tell the ancestors about the changes in this realm, Sect Master?" A female elder asked.
"Do you think I need to do that, Guang Lingfei?" Liang Huizhong asked, shaking his head.
"Before I gathered you all here, they had already contacted me and asked me to find the best solution to deal with this sudden change.

They were worried that the situation would weaken our sect, but they would not intervene to resolve this issue, and they would only come out of their seclusion if danger threatened the future of the sect."
Guang Lingfei and the elders were disappointed with their ancestors’ decision, but they also understood their intentions.
After all, they were top cultivators themselves, and they couldn’t rely on their ancestors to solve any problems that arose.
"Leave now and handle the situation properly."
"What about those disciples, Sect Master?
Many of them panicked and left the sect to return to their respective domains, and they’ll have a hard time returning here if those gates disappear."

Liang Huizhong couldn’t blame the disciples because the situation had happened all of a sudden, and he couldn’t possibly stop them from returning to their respective domains to check on their families.
"We shouldn’t worry about them for now; instead, we should allow them to help their families first.
If they can’t return because the gates are gone, you guys must pick them up again, and I’ll find a way to make it easier for them to come and go.
You don’t have to pick them all; just take the most outstanding talents to lessen the burden on our sect due to this sudden change."
All the elders were surprised by Liang Huizhong’s decision, but they also felt that it was the best solution for their sect at this time.
After all, they still didn’t know the distance between each domain after the change was over, and they also had to think about the reserve resources stored in their sects and domains.
After a long discussion, all the elders left the place, and Liang Huizhong also went to another place to meet some other people.
In the alchemy shop, three people sat together discussing the sudden changes that had occurred in their realm.
They were Jin Nanqing, Luo Lianjin, and Xuan Yun.
"Master, what do you think is really happening?"
Jin Nanqing shook his head at his first disciple.
"I don’t know exactly what happened in this realm, but I think this change will bring good things to the other domains.
Our sect has monopolized everything since our ancestors discovered the portal to the Forbidden Land, which has caused other sects and clans to decline significantly.
With all the domains separated without those gates, our sect will no longer be able to control them, and they will flourish again over time."
"Master, do you think this sudden change has something to do with Empress Huo and Zhang Fei?" Jin Nanqing looked at his second disciple, Xuan Yun, with raised eyebrows.
"I say this because their appearance has brought many changes to this realm, especially Zhang Fei’s actions.
The first change that occurred was at the Moonlit Passion Temple, and the Twin Flames Main Domain has undergone significant changes since his arrival.
The condition of the domain changed greatly, and now many formations cover the entire area there, which makes it difficult for outsiders to enter."
Jin Nanqing nodded slightly.

"The changes Zhang Fei brought to the Moonlit Passion Temple and the Twin Flames Main Domain are indeed astonishing, and he managed to persuade many powerful cultivators to join him, including Jian Kuang and Su Shentian.
Additionally, he also managed to persuade several renowned clans to cooperate with him, such as the Liao, Qiao, You, and Zhang Clans.
I can’t say for sure whether the changes in this realm happened because of him, but I think it’s a possibility.
For now, we need to put him and his sect aside and focus on the situation in our own sect.
I hope these changes will lead to improvements for all cultivators and their respective domains."
"Yes, Master."
Xiao Jingyi stood atop her residence and looked up at the sky.
"Do you think this change will be good for all cultivators and domains, Senior?"
"I don’t know," Huo Xiaoyu replied with a shake of her head.
"Whether it’s good or not, we can only see the results in the future.
At least this change will reduce the chaos between all races, and the situation will be better with all domains separated from each other."
"I still didn’t expect Zhang Fei to be able to do all this, Senior."
"Haha," Huo Xiaoyu softly laughed.
"I don’t know much about Zhang Fei myself, but my empress has full confidence in him, so I will also believe in him."

chapters.title: Chapter 1541: Meet The People I
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] stood in the air above the Moonlit Passion Temple, with Serpentera and Tian Kui standing behind him, looking at the increasingly thin portal.
"Master, don’t you think this change will be detrimental to our domain?"
"Outsiders will find it difficult to go to our domain, but people from this domain will also have difficulty going to other domains, which means they will live a reclusive life ."

"Why do you two have to think about that?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened dozens of gates. "I can send them wherever they want to go, and I will also create several teleportation portals in the future. Compared to some other domains, our domain is much more fertile, and there are many wild beasts living here, so I’m sure the people will have no trouble adapting to their new situation. Besides, other cultivators rarely come here, ensuring their safety and security, so they should be pleased with that."
*Swoosh*

The two leaders of the Sun Moon Sect suddenly appeared beside them, and they were shocked to see the dozens of gates. Chi Hongchen immediately asked him, "Are you the mastermind behind the changes in this realm?"
"Yeah," Zhang Xiaolong [3] said, removing those gates. "What do you guys think of these changes?"

"This change is too sudden, but I think everyone in this domain will be happy without the presence of powerful cultivators from other domains," Guang Yue answered him. "However, this change will impact the future of all sects in this domain, and it will be increasingly difficult for us to recruit new disciples because the majority of people in this realm still look down on dual cultivation sects."
"Do you have any other plans to prevent that from happening?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at them. "I understand your concerns about that, but you two have to remember that all domains will experience the same thing. Moreover, not all domains have sects, and they will have difficulty going to other domains, so we can take advantage of this change for that. For now, we just need to adapt to the new situation, and I will prepare many teleportation portals that will connect our domain with other domains. Once the situation in all domains is stable, you two can send your elders to other domains to recruit disciples."
"How long do you think it will take for the other domains to be calm again?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at them. "Domains like the Heavenlight Main Domain and the Sky Pillar Domain will definitely return to calm quickly, but I doubt that other domains can adapt that quickly, especially those lesser ones. I already have some plans for that, but we’ll have to talk about it later because some people will arrive here soon."
"Some people."

"Over there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] pointed towards the outside of the forest that was not covered by the flying restriction formation, where they saw a void hole open and four mythical beasts come out from inside it. "You guys wait here, and I’ll meet them first."

"This." Feng Jinhuang was shocked after he walked out of the void because the changes in the Twin Flames Main Domain were too significant compared to when he last went to that domain. "Was it Zhang Fei who made all these changes? This domain is filled with formations now, including the flying restriction formation."

"In addition to the flying restriction formation, there are many other formations, including illusion formations and various others." Long Xukong looked at the surrounding area. "Moreover, there is a formation blocking me from opening the void, so I can only bring us here."
Long Wuzhao agreed with him. "This domain is the safest of all domains now, and invaders will not easily enter here."
"Golden Dragon King!" Long Wuzhao and the other three looked at Jia Leixuan, Jia Lingzhu, and Jia Shengyun, who had just arrived.
Before long, Shang Fengxue, Zhi Qian, and Zhi Shen also arrived at the place.

"Stop it, Jinhuang." Feng Jinhuang turned to Long Wuzhao, who stopped him from attacking Shang Fengxue. "We didn’t come here to fight, and this female demon is supposed to be Zhang Fei’s friend. Isn’t that right, Asura Demon Princess?"

"Haha," Shang Fengxue laughed at that. "I’ve been to the Moonlit Passion Temple before, but I can’t say that I’m Zhang Fei’s friend, Golden Dragon Emperor. However, I really like the situation in his sect because all races can live together in a peaceful environment, making it the first sect in this realm that can make it happen."
Long Wuzhao nodded at her. "Zhang Fei’s dream was to create a sanctuary for all races to gather together without hostility, and he successfully started it in the Moonlit Passion Temple."

"Unfortunately, not all domains have been able to achieve the same peace as his sect, and battles continue to occur between all races, particularly between humans and demons." Shang Fengxue said disappointedly.

"However, the situation in this realm will improve after this change, as all domains will be separated by a considerable distance, making it difficult for demons and evil beast races to invade other domains, especially since we do not know the exact distance and location of these domains." Long Wuzhao looked at Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen. "Why did you two come here?"
Zhi Qian cupped his hands toward Long Wuzhao. "I don’t know the cause of the changes in this realm, but I feel that Zhang Fei is the cause, so my sister and I came here to see him."
"According to your recent conversation, it appears that our guess is correct that Zhang Fei is the cause of the changes in this realm," Zhi Shen spoke, cupping her hands toward Long Wuzhao.

"Haha." All of them looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had just appeared before them. "You guys are right; I was the one who caused the changes in this realm, and I did it for the safety and security of everyone in this domain, especially those closest to me. However, I cannot explain to you how I was able to do all this because I did not do it myself, and someone helped me to do it."

"Hey! I’m not concerned about the changes in this realm, and I came here to spar with you again." Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled bitterly. "Since the distance between all the domains will be too far, and I don’t know if I will be able to return to my domain, I will stay in your sect for now."

"Tch! Isn’t that just your excuse?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at her. "If you want to spar, you can spar with Jian Kuang and the others. I don’t have time right now, and I’ll be returning to seclusion after this. Regarding your domain, I can send you back there immediately, so you don’t have to stay here."
Shang Fengxue shook her head in refusal. "I won’t be returning to my domain for now, and I’ll be staying in your sect so I can spar with them every day."
"What about your brother? He’ll surely be furious if he can’t find you when he comes out of his seclusion."

Shang Fengxue shrugged her shoulders. "Since you can send me back to my domain at any time, it’s no big deal, right? My sister-in-law will contact me once my brother comes out of his seclusion, and you can send me back there then. By the way, send me to your sect now, and I’ll spar with them."

"Go in." Feng Jinhuang and the others were shocked when Zhang Xiaolong [3] created a warp portal, and Shang Fengxue immediately entered it. "This is one of my abilities as a heavenly fox, so you guys don’t need to be confused by that."
"Huh? Are you really a beast, Zhang Fei?" Unlike Long Wuzhao and the others, Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen didn’t know that, so they were shocked to hear it.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] instantly returned to his full fox form, making Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen take several steps back because his fox form was simply too massive. "As you two can see, my true identity is a fox beast, the Heavenly Fox to be exact. My fox race does not exist in this realm, and they only exist in the Three Mortal Realms."
Upon seeing Zhang Xiaolong [3] in his complete fox form, Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen inhaled deeply, sensing the powerful light element emanating from him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately returned to his human form and spoke to them. "The changes in this realm will indeed bring problems to all cultivators, and they will need a very long time to adapt to the changes. However, I feel that these changes will have a positive impact on this realm, and the fighting will be greatly reduced, as it will be more difficult for them to travel to other domains. If the situation in this realm does not change, it will be destroyed like the Ancient Realm, and all cultivators in this realm will suffer."
"The Ancient Realm?" That left Jia Leixuan, Zhi Qian, and Zhi Shen puzzled.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at them and created a qi screen, showing them the Ancient Desolation Domain. "The Forbidden Land and this domain are both parts of the Ancient Realm, and you can see the situation in both domains, which are filled with destruction. If the situation in this Paradise Realm remains the same as in the past, then this realm’s fate will inevitably be the same as theirs."

chapters.title: Chapter 1542: Meet The People II
paragraphs: Among them, only Jia Leixuan, Zhi Qian, and Zhi Shen were confused by the Ancient Desolation Domain because they had never seen it before.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke to them again, "If all the domains in this Paradise Realm weren’t separated from each other, many of them would surely be destroyed. As you’ve all seen, many domains in this realm are struggling to develop for various reasons, such as the Celestial Moon Domain and the Sun-Moon Main Domain. The main reason they struggle to develop is not evil beasts or demons, but humans and the Divine Samsara Sect."

"I agree." Jia Leixuan nodded in agreement. "Although my fairy race has never had direct contact with humans, I’ve often heard about the Divine Samsara Sect. They snatched talented people from all domains, which has resulted in all the sects in those domains only having disciples of mediocre talent."

"That’s true." Zhi Qian sighed softly. "Back then, the Divine Samsara Sect forced me and my sister to join them after they discovered our talents, but we refused them because we would rather not cause our Zhi Clan to stagnate."
"After that day, they tried various ways to bring down our Zhi Clan and ruin our reputation, but their efforts were never successful," Zhi Shen added.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded slightly. "Even though I haven’t lived in this realm for long, I could see from the start that the Divine Samsara Sect wasn’t as good as it looked from the outside, and Liang Huizhong was just a puppet of the people above him. Back then, he sent people to my sect to ask for cooperation, but I rejected him because he would target my sect if we became stronger than his sect. I only accepted Jin Nanqing, Luo Lianjin, and Xuan Xun because they didn’t care about politics, and they were completely focused on alchemy. Even so, I wouldn’t fully trust them because they were part of the sect, and they might betray me one day."
"Zhang Fei." They turned to Tian Huangjin and Tian Huotian, who had just arrived. "Does the change in this realm have anything to do with you?"

"Yeah," Zhang Xiaolong [3] recounted some things to the two members of the Winged Race, just as he had told Long Wuzhao and the others earlier. "Aren’t you afraid that Tian Qiye will discover your departure?"
"Our leaders will know of our departure, but she’s busy figuring out how to handle the changes in this realm, so she won’t bother us with our departure," Tian Huotian answered him.

Tian Huangjin added. "Furthermore, all the domains will be separated by a great distance after this, and I’m sure our leader won’t bother to look for us because she doesn’t know about our destination."

"That’s true." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at the portal, which was already getting thinner. "I can’t predict the outcome of the changes, but I’ve heard that the distance between domains in this Paradise Realm is much greater than in the Three Mortal Realms, so it will take years to map everything. At least, all domains will be peaceful in the next few years because people will be busy with that, and they will be more focused on their respective domains."

"You’re right," Long Wuzhao agreed with him. "This sudden change has forced everyone from all domains to focus on themselves, at least for now, and I’m sure the results will only be visible in the next few years. Even so, we can’t let down our guard, as many cultivators don’t care about their domains, and they will find ways to conquer other domains as soon as possible."

"At least, I’ve made preparations to protect my sect and all the cultivators in this domain, and we have ample resources to support us for decades, so we won’t need to travel to other domains until the situation in this realm stabilizes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought for a moment. "I have to prepare several teleportation devices to connect several domains, especially since I have several shops in several domains. I’ve asked Liao Hanxue and the Liao Clan for help with that, but it took them quite a long time to be able to make them."
"If they have made them, you must give one to me, ensuring a direct connection between our two realms."
"You should give me one too, Zhang Fei."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Long Wuzhao and Jia Leixuan. "You two are my allies, so I will give you the teleportation devices."
"That’s good." Jia Leixuan looked at the portal. "Since the portal is almost gone, we will return to our domains now, and we will await the teleportation device from you."

"Zhang Fei." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Jia Shengyun. "Our fairy race already has a connection with you, but you have not yet met the other natural races, so I hope you can arrange a time to meet them as soon as possible."

Jia Lingzhu also spoke to him. "You are the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox, and all natural races have been waiting for your arrival for a long time. However, you still have to convince them to accept you, and they will be loyal to you if you succeed in doing so."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed inwardly and nodded to Jia Yuyan’s grandparents. "I know their support is important, but I don’t want to think about that for now. I want to focus on increasing my strength while helping all my women. We will probably be in seclusion for the next few years, and I will go see them after we emerge from our seclusion."

"Alright, you can arrange everything, and we will help you meet them when you are ready." After they said goodbye to Long Wuzhao and the others, the three members of the fairy race immediately left the Twin Flames Main Domain to return to their domain.

Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen still had many questions for Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially regarding his identity as the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox. After all, the human race knew nothing about the ten-tailed fox, but the portal was already disappearing, so they hurriedly left the Twin Flames Main Domain; otherwise, they would have had difficulty returning to the Sky Pillar Domain if the portal had disappeared.

Feng Jinhuang, who had been silent all this time, finally spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Kid, I’ve wanted to meet you for a long time, but the Golden Dragon Emperor has always hidden your location, and he only brought me to see you today. I have many questions about you and the phoenixes by your side, but we don’t seem to have time to talk now that the portal is about to disappear. I hope you’ll be willing to come to my Phoenix Domain someday, and you must bring them with you."

"I will pay a visit to your Phoenix Domain in the future, Golden Phoenix Emperor." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a nod. "However, I can’t say for sure when I will visit there, and I will contact you when I want to go there."
Feng Jinhuang nodded in understanding. "I’ll wait to hear from you."
