chapters.title: Chapter 1543: Meet The People III
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly received a voice transmission from Yan Yinqing. He hurried to the Celestial Yin Lake area, and he found Su Yao there. "Is my master still in seclusion with you, Elder Zhang?"
"Do you want to meet Feiling? I can send you there, and you can talk to her there."
"Please send me there, Elder Zhang." Su You was taken aback when Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened a portal to the training space, but she didn’t ask anything and went straight into it.
After he closed the portal, Zhang Xiaolong [3] took out half of the teleportation device, and the other half was in Yan Yinqing’s hands.

Soon, the portal emitted a bright light and activated itself, following which Yan Yinqing walked out of it. Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow slightly as the other two women also walked out of the portal, but he was confused by Yue Xuelian’s awkward behavior. ’What happened to her?’
"Are you Zhang Fei?"
"I am." Zhang Xiaolong nodded to Yue Qianrou. "What brings you two here today?"

Yan Yinqing immediately explained to him. "Junior brother, they were concerned about the changes in this Paradise Realm after the gates connecting all the domains disappeared, and they were worried that you would have difficulty traveling to their domain to supply pills. Therefore, I told them not to worry, and I installed the teleportation device near Sect Master Xuelian’s private quarters."
"I see."
"Does the disappearance of those gates have anything to do with you?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn’t want to tell Yue Qianrou about it, but Feng Yao had already told him that she had no malicious intentions, and she was only angry with Yue Xuelian for abandoning her in the ruins of the Ancient Calamity Sect, which resulted in her being cursed and transforming her into a corpse demon. "I don’t know about the gates’ disappearance, and I gave my senior sister the teleportation device to make it easier for her and others to return to this sect. Moreover, my cultivation is still at the Celestial King Realm, so I can’t do such a thing."

Since she could see everything that Zhang Fei and his five clones saw because of Feng Yao’s actions, Yue Xuelian naturally knew when he met the Will of the Universe and asked her to remove all the gates, but she didn’t tell anyone else about it and chose to pretend she didn’t know anything. ’I still don’t understand Empress Huo’s reason for connecting me with him.’

Zhang Xiaolong [3] repeatedly glanced at Yue Xuelian, sensing something strange about her behavior. He couldn’t guess the reason behind it because Feng Yao deliberately didn’t tell him about his actions toward her. "What’s wrong with you, Sect Master Yue?"

"Nothing," Yue Xuelian answered with a shake of her head without looking at him, making Yan Yinqing and Yue Qianrou feel strange about her attitude. "We came here to discuss something with you, specifically regarding the future of our sect."

"Let’s talk at my residence." The three women immediately followed Zhang Xiaolong [3] to a residence not far from the Celestial Yin Lake. However, Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were shocked by some of the protective formations, and they found everything inside the residence to be too modern. "What’s wrong with the future of your sect?"

Yue Xuelian sighed softly. "Although our sect is still one of the supreme sects in this realm, we have been steadily declining since the previous high-ranking officials joined the Divine Samsara Sect, and we have always relied on them for many things. I fear that the major changes occurring in this realm today will have a more detrimental impact on our sect, as other cultivators will have difficulty coming to the domain, and the number of cultivators ascending from the Three Mortal Realms is too small. Therefore, I hope you are willing to help our sect, and I will be truly grateful for that."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Honestly, I also believe that the Divine Samsara Sect poses a major problem for all human sects, but this issue has persisted for too long, making it difficult to change the situation. However, a major change occurred in this realm today, and I think this change will benefit many domains, including your domain."

"You’re probably right about that." Yue Xuelian finally looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], but his activities with all his women appeared in her mind, causing a blush to appear on her cheeks, which did not escape his attention. "However, the change won’t happen soon, as everyone needs time to adapt and remap the domains’ distances and locations, as there are no records of it. Therefore, we have to find a short-term solution to deal with the situation, or our sect will continue to decline. Since you have teleportation devices, I hope you are willing to help us recruit new disciples."

"Do you know what the main mistake of your domain is?" Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in confusion. "It doesn’t matter if your sect is dedicated to women, but it’s a fatal mistake if you dedicate your domain to women as well. Look at the situation of your domain now; the female population is 95% more than the male population, and the majority of talented women choose to join the Divine Samsara Sect, which is causing the decline of your sect. Besides, the birth rate in your domain is too low because they think marriage and children are pointless, but they forget that they won’t live forever, and the population will keep declining as they die. How many girls are born each year?"
"Too small."

"See?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head slightly. "I don’t know about the history of your domain, but I know that it will never survive with the number of women reaching 95% and the birth rate too small."

Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were also aware of the problem, but they faced significant difficulties in increasing the male population in their domain, as they were already accustomed to the high female population there.

"If such conditions continue, I am sure your domain will be destroyed one day, which will also lead to the destruction of your sect." Zhang Xiaolong [3] could only sigh at the expressions of the two women. "I know it won’t be simple to change, as your domain has been like this for thousands, tens of thousands, or perhaps hundreds of thousands of years. With the changes occurring in this realm, the best solution for your domain is increasing the male population there, which might increase the number of new births."
"How do we do that? All the domains will be separated after today, and I have no information about their locations and distances."

"Before you bring men to your domain, the first thing you should do is talk to all the women there." Yue Xuelian could more or less catch Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s meaning. "If you let those men enter your domain and live there without discussing it with those women, I’m afraid they will reject the plan, and they will chase all those men away, which will make the situation in your domain unfavorable."
"Is there any other solution besides that?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought of several solutions to help them. "All sects in this domain are dual cultivation sects, but not all residents are dual cultivators. I’ll ask the elders of my sect to find single women, and they’ll bring them to your sect, so you two can select them yourselves. If you feel those women have good or sufficient talents, you can accept them in your sect. However, this method is only a short-term solution, so you can’t expect too much for the future, and you have to think of other solutions for that."
"What do you think about that, Big Sis?" Yue Qianrou asked.

Yue Xuelian nodded slightly. "I think we can use that solution for now, and I’ll meet with the influential people in our domain to discuss Zhang Fei’s idea with them later. They should already be aware of the risks of the changes in this realm, but I’m not sure they’ll agree with our idea of making major changes to our domain."

"Yes," Yue Qianrou was also sure that the women in their domain would not necessarily agree with that. "If we don’t change our domain’s situation to adapt to the changes in this realm, everything that has been built since our ancestral era will be destroyed by the changing times."

"I have another solution for you two." Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] again. "Unlike you two, I can be cruel to those who don’t want to accept change, so I’m not sure my idea will suit you."
"What’s your idea?"

"Move your sect to another domain." Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were shocked by that. "If the women in your domain don’t agree with the idea of increasing the male population there, I think you don’t need to care about them anymore, and you can move your sect to a better domain."
"Which domain?"

"If you’re not disgusted by dual cultivators, you can move your sect to this domain." Zhang Xiaolong [3] created several qi screens, allowing the two women to view the entire area of the Twin Flames Main Domain. "Currently, my sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal one, and the Hidden Moon Sect of the Empyrean Domain has also moved their sect to this domain."

chapters.title: Chapter 1544: Consideration
paragraphs: "If you two don’t believe me, you can wait here for me for a while, and I’ll fetch the people from the Hidden Moon Sect." Zhang Xiaolong [3] quickly disappeared from their sight.
"How can he move that fast?" Yue Qianrou asked in shock.
"Hehe," Yan Yinqing chuckled. "Vice Sect Master Qianrou, my speed is still far inferior to my junior brother’s, but I’m still much faster than you two."
"Are you serious about that?"
Yan Yinqing demonstrated her speed to the two women by circling the residence, but their eyes and senses could not follow her movements, even though their cultivation was much higher than hers.
After a few laps, Yan Yinqing stopped in front of Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou, smiling at their dumbfounded looks. "What do you think? Can your eyes keep up with my speed?"

"No," Yue Xuelian shook her head slightly, and she didn’t ask anything, as she could see Zhang Fei and all the women training hard in the training space. Although she wasn’t sure how they were training, she knew that it was to increase her speed.
"How did your speed become that fast? How did you train it?"

Yan Yinqing shook her head at Yue Qianrou. "I’ve been training for a very long time using my junior brother’s method, which makes my speed much faster than the cultivators in this realm, including those who have reached the Celestial God Realm. However, I can’t tell you the method without his permission, so you’ll have to ask him about it first."
"I understand." Yue Qianrou was truly curious how Zhang Xiaolong [3] trained his speed to become so fast despite his low cultivation.

Before long, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had returned to them along with Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang, but the presence of the two women made Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou raise their eyebrows because they felt his Yang Qi inside their bodies. ’Are they also his wives?’

Nong Qinwei immediately realized their thoughts. "Long time no see, Xuelian and Qianrou. You’re both right that we cultivate using his yang Qi, but we’re not his wives. In fact, all members of our sect also cultivate using his yang qi, which is proven to increase our physical strength."
"His yang qi is very strong because he is a fox beast, and it has a significant impact on our bodies, even though we used it for cultivation not too long ago." Yin Chang added.

Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou already knew that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a fox beast, but they had never used his yang qi, so they were not certain about its strength. "Why did you two decide to move your sect to this domain?"

"You two already know that our sect is engaged in assassination missions, right?" Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou nodded at Nong Qinwei. "He also has an assassination group, and he invited us to cooperate with his group. At first, we didn’t consider moving our sect here, but many cultivators have repeatedly attempted to attack and destroy us. Since this domain is much safer than our old domain, we decided to move our sect here."

Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "My assassination group is the Demon Fox Group, founded by one of my wives in the lower realm. I brought them all to this Paradise Realm, and I thought about developing them here, so I invited their group to join us."
"How will you get assassination missions after the changes in this realm?" Yue Qianrou asked the two women.

"We haven’t thought about that problem because this Paradise Realm only changed today." Nong Qinwei pointed to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "He has brought about so many changes in this domain and sect, so we believe he will find a solution for it."
Since Zhang Xiaolong [3] had a teleportation portal to connect the Celestial Moon Domain and Twin Flames Main Domain, Yue Qianrou had no doubt that he would find a solution for it.

"Now, back to our main topic." Zhang Xiaolong [3] pointed to Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang. "You two can ask them about life in this sect and their sect, so you can consider the possibility of moving your sect to this domain."

Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou looked at Nong Qinwei, who immediately explained to them about the situation of her sect since she moved it to the Twin Flames Main Domain. "However, my sect is different from your Celestial Moon Sect, so I don’t know whether your disciples will mind moving to this domain or not. If they object to the move, you will be unable to relocate your sect, and it will continue to decline as it is now."

"With the significant changes in this Paradise Realm, your Celestial Moon Domain is no longer effective for your sect. The number of women there is too large, and the birth rate is too low. Moreover, the talented young cultivators in your domain have already joined the Divine Samsara Sect, and those left are only those with mediocre talent." Yue Xuelian sighed heavily upon hearing Yin Chan’s words. "If your sect still wants to exist and improve, moving it to other domains is the best option, and this domain could be one of them, especially with the high security here."

Yue Xuelian had also realized that the security in the Twin Flames Main Domain was extremely high, even higher than in the Celestial Moon Domain, especially with all the formations installed there. The problem was that it was renowned as a dual cultivation paradise, especially with the numerous dual cultivation sects within it, making her hesitate to move their sects there.

"If you’re hesitant to move your sect to this domain, you could consider moving it to the Empyrean Domain." Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou just remembered that one of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s wives was Luo Yunxiao, the daughter of Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi. "Even though that domain doesn’t have as good protection as here, my parents-in-law might be able to help you if you move there."
"I think the Empyrean Domain is also a good choice, Big Sis."
Yue Xuelian agreed with Yue Qianrou. "Can you ask Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan to come here?"
"Sure."

Before long, Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan had arrived inside the residence, and Yue Xuelian immediately asked about their experiences after staying at the Moonlit Passion Temple for two months. All three women gave her positive answers because the residences of dual cultivators and non-dual cultivators were separate from each other, and they only met each other while practicing in those halls, so they never felt disturbed by their presence.
"What do you guys think if I move our sect to this domain?"
"Eh?" Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan were truly surprised by Yue Xuelian’s question.
"Have you decided to move our sect to this domain, Big Sis?" Yue Qianrou asked her.

Yue Xuelian nodded at her. "Even though the situation in the Empyrean Domain is more suitable for us, all the defenses in this domain will provide much better protection for our sect. The Divine Samsara Sect is still not moving right now because they have to adapt to the changes in this realm, but I believe they will come to our domain and suppress us one day, so I think this domain is much better for protecting our sect."

"I’m thinking the same as you, Big Sis." Yue Qianrou was considering the best option between the Empyrean Domain and the Twin Flames Main Domain, but she had to admit that the latter had far more protection than the former. "I agree if you want to move our sect to the domain, but we can’t make the final decision right away, and we have to discuss it with all the elders first. Besides, we can’t move to the domain right away, and we have to establish our new sect here, so the process will take several years."

"I don’t think you need to think about that." Yue Qianrou looked at Nong Qinwei, who pointed at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "He has many natural races under his command, including the dwarf, gnome, and giant races. They help us to build our sect, and they can finish it in a few months."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to the two women. "For now, you two should discuss this with your sect members, and you can tell me the results of your discussion. If they agree to move to this domain, I will ask the natural races to build your new sect, so you don’t need to worry about that."

"We’ll go back now to discuss this matter with our members, and we’ll let you know the results as soon as possible." Yue Xuelian looked at Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan. "You three should come back with us and tell them the truth about your lives in this sect for the last two months. Even though it might not necessarily make them agree, I believe we’ll have a greater chance of getting their approval."
"Yes, Sect Master."
After that, Yue Xuelian led the others back to the Celestial Moon Sect through the teleportation portal, and Nong Qinwei brought her vice sect master back to the Hidden Moon Sect.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not immediately return to the training space, and he went to the Sun Moon Sect to discuss with Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue, which would bring about a complete change in the Twin Flames Main Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1545: Meet The Elders
paragraphs: "Do you really think Zhang Fei’s plan is feasible?"

Chi Hongchen hugged Guang Yue’s waist. "His plan won’t be feasible in the short term, but I think we can do it gradually, and we should start with the smallest sects. This Paradise Realm has changed drastically, and those sects won’t be able to survive solely on the resources in this domain, even if it is rich in resources, so they have no other choice but to merge."
"The Blazing Union Sect still stands alone, but it is no different from a branch of the Moonlit Passion Sect because elders and disciples of the two sects have long since merged into one."

"Yes," Chi Hongchen looked out the window. "There are too many sects in this domain, and all the domains in the Paradise Realm have already separated from each other. The distance between each domain seems to be very far, so it is impossible for the people of those sects to go to other domains now. Even if Zhang Fei can create portals to various domains, he will not be able to do so in a short time because the materials to create one are too expensive and difficult to obtain."
"The best solution is to merge, which will only leave a few sects, as Zhang Fei predicted."

Chi Hongchen nodded at her. "Since he would rather not recruit members from all those sects into his sect, we can start talking to their leaders and persuade them to join us. I hope that many of them will be willing to join us, leading to a significant reduction in the number of sects in the domains."
"If it succeeds, Zhang Fei will probably succeed in persuading other sects to move into this domain, and this domain will no longer be a dual cultivation domain but a universal one."

Chi Hongchen exhaled softly. "For now, the new sect in this domain is the Hidden Moon Sect, and the Celestial Moon Sect will be the second if Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou succeed in persuading their members."

"I hope Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou succeed in persuading their sect members, and the presence of the Celestial Moon Sect in this domain might bring a refreshing change." Chi Hongchen agreed with Guang Yue, as he also hoped for the same result. "Since we have nothing else to do, we should start meeting with those sects to persuade them, and I hope our efforts will yield positive results."
"Let’s go."

Even though she already knew them, Su Yao still found it difficult to believe that all the women in the training space and pavilion belonged to Zhang Fei and his five clones, including her master. Even her sect master had repeatedly invited her to join them, but she always ran away every time they dual cultivated on the mountaintop of their sect.

"What do you want to talk to me about, Yao’er?" Su Yao pulled You Feiling to sit beside her and expressed her intentions. "The situation outside is unstable right now, and we don’t have information about the distance of all domains yet, so you have to wait to return to your home domain."
"Can Elder Zhang take me back to my domain, Master?"

You Feiling nodded at her. "He should be able to do it, but I still think you should wait for the right time, as the situation in all the domains is undoubtedly chaotic. Moreover, your home domain has never been peaceful, and I suspect great turmoil is brewing there."
"Yeah, you’re right."
"Is there something you want to ask me?" You Feiling asked after she saw the doubt in her disciple’s expression.
"Are you happy after becoming his wife, Master?"

"Haha," You Feiling laughed softly. "Back then, I was hesitant to become his wife, but I can tell you that I am happy now. I think my decision was the best in my life, and my life has become more colorful since I have been with him. Do you want to try to feel it?"

"Eh?" Su Yao was shocked as she blushed, remembering Zhang Fei’s naked body. "Elder Zhang is indeed strong, but I never thought of becoming his woman, Master. Instead, I’m attracted to a friend of his, but he doesn’t seem interested in a dual cultivator like me."
"Who?"
"Gang Zhishou."
"Gang Zhishou is the blacksmith that he brought from the Nine Stars Realm, right?"
"Yes," Su Yao nodded at her. "I often saw him forging equipment with others, and somehow I became attracted to him, but he never thought about women and focused on blacksmithing."
"Do you want Zhang Fei to help you get close to him?"
Su Rou shook her head. "I will approach the Zhishou Gang myself, Master. By the way, can you tell Elder Zhang to send me back to the sect?"
"Let’s meet him at the training ground, as he is still struggling to adapt to level 8 gravity."

After the two women met Zhang Fei, he sent Su Yao back to their sect. You Feiling then told him that her disciple was interested in Gang Zhishou, and she asked him to help her, which he immediately agreed to.

At the Celestial Moon Sect, Yue Xuelian had gathered all the elders and informed them of her plan to move their sect to the Twin Flames Main Domain, which shocked all of them. Besides, she also informed them about Nong Qinwei and Yun Chang’s decision to move the Hidden Moon Sect to that domain; however, their sect remained independent and did not join the Moonlit Passion Temple, only cooperating in the field of assassination.

Yue Xuelian asked Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan to explain to the elders about their lives at the Moonlit Passion Temple over the past two months. She knew that the elders would not believe her or Yue Qianrou, so she deliberately brought the three disciples back to convince them.

After the three disciples finished telling and showing everything to the elders, Yue Xuelian immediately spoke to them. "At first, I wanted to move our sect to the Empyrean Domain, but I think the Twin Flames Main Domain was much more suitable for us, especially because of the many defensive formations there. Even cultivators as powerful as Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, Tianshi Bailong, and Tian Qiye would have a hard time breaking through them, so I think we’ll be safe if we move there."

"Moreover, all the domains will be separated by a large distance, and the population in our domain will continue to decline because there are too few men here." All the elders agreed with Yue Qianrou, but they were still hesitant to move to the Twin Flames Main Domain because the majority of the population there were dual cultivators. "Big Sis and I originally wanted to persuade the higher-ups in this domain to increase the male population, but we felt that it was impossible because the situation in our domain had existed for too long. Therefore, we chose the second option by moving our sect to the Twin Flames Main Domain, and Zhang Fei’s subordinates would help us establish our new sect there."

All the elders understood the situation in their domains, and they also understood the declining condition of their sects. Moreover, their sects’ survival and development would become increasingly difficult with the domains separated by vast distances, yet they still found it difficult to move and mingle with the dual cultivators in the Twin Flames Main Domain.

Seeing the elders finding it difficult to decide, Yue Xuelian spoke to them again. "The ancestors of our sect who joined the Divine Samsara Sect were indeed strong, but they were not stronger than those people. If we continue to allow that sect to suppress us, our sect will no longer have a future, and we will continue to be their cash cows. If we move our sect to the Twin Flames Main Domain, they will no longer be able to suppress us, and we can become more independent. Therefore, I hope you can understand our situation and my choice, as I don’t want this sect to be destroyed, and the only solution we have is to move to another domain."

"Hahaha." All of them were shocked by the man’s laughter, and they were even more shocked when Zhang Xiaolong [3] canceled his invisibility. "Forgive me for trespassing, but I knew that you guys would be hesitant after listening to Sect Master Xuelian’s explanation about my domain. Thus, I decided to come here to talk to all of you myself, and I hope you can make a decision after listening to my explanation."
Yue Xuelian immediately stopped the elders and spoke to him. "Please explain everything to them."

"I just spoke with Chi Hongchen Guang Yue, and I asked them to unite all the dual cultivation sects in our domain." Zhang Xiaolong’s answer shocked them. "Since all the domains are separated by a long distance, they will have difficulty developing their sects because they don’t have the same strength as my sect and the Sun Moon Sect, so they will have no other choice but to reduce their numbers by merging. I think only two or three dual cultivation sects will remain in my domain after the merger, and I guarantee they won’t bother you if you move there. If you still have doubts about that, I will ask the cultivators who have joined my sect to set up another formation specifically for your new sect, so they won’t be able to enter without your permission."

If we move our sect to the Twin Flames Main Domain, they will no longer be able to suppress us, and we can become more independent.
Therefore, I hope you can understand our situation and my choice, as I don’t want this sect to be destroyed, and the only solution we have is to move to another domain."
"Hahaha." All of them were shocked by the man’s laughter, and they were even more shocked when Zhang Xiaolong [3] canceled his invisibility.
"Forgive me for trespassing, but I knew that you guys would be hesitant after listening to Sect Master Xuelian’s explanation about my domain.
Thus, I decided to come here to talk to all of you myself, and I hope you can make a decision after listening to my explanation."
Yue Xuelian immediately stopped the elders and spoke to him.
"Please explain everything to them."
"I just spoke with Chi Hongchen Guang Yue, and I asked them to unite all the dual cultivation sects in our domain." Zhang Xiaolong’s answer shocked them.

"Since all the domains are separated by a long distance, they will have difficulty developing their sects because they don’t have the same strength as my sect and the Sun Moon Sect, so they will have no other choice but to reduce their numbers by merging.
I think only two or three dual cultivation sects will remain in my domain after the merger, and I guarantee they won’t bother you if you move there.

If you still have doubts about that, I will ask the cultivators who have joined my sect to set up another formation specifically for your new sect, so they won’t be able to enter without your permission."

chapters.title: Chapter 1546: Agree
paragraphs: "How many dual cultivation sects will remain in the end?"

"I think there will only be two or three sects left at the end, Elder Yuling." Yue Yuling and the elders seemed doubtful about Zhang Xiaolong [3] because there were too many dual cultivation sects in his domain. "There are too many sects in my domain, but the majority of them are only small sects, and they won’t be able to survive for long with the massive changes in the Paradise Realm."

They did not argue with Zhang Xiaolong [3] because their Celestial Moon Sect was much larger than those sects, but they would have a challenging time surviving the current conditions in the Paradise Realm. Additionally, the aging female population in their domain and the pressure from the Divine Samsara Sect would worsen their conditions.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke to them again. "The Blazing Union Sect is the second largest after the Sun Moon Sect, but it has now become a branch of my sect. Since it is no longer a dual cultivation sect, I will not be taking dual cultivators from other sects. Therefore, I need several other sects to merge and accommodate those disciples, and the number of those sects will decrease significantly after the merger. At first, you might not be comfortable with them being there, but I promise you that they will never come closer or set foot in your new sect, so you can rest assured about that."
"How are you going to guarantee that?" Yue Wanxian asked him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] summoned seven evil mythical beasts, shocking them. "Besides these seven evil beasts, I still have two guardian beasts tasked with protecting my sect. They are the reason my sect can be number one in my domain, and no cultivators there can stand against them."
"Aren’t they—"

"They are the former generals of the four perils." Yue Xuelian nodded at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I met them in the Endless Night Dungeon, and several people helped me subdue them. Since then, they have been my beast contracts, and I assigned them to protect all my wives."
"Emperor Long and Empress Huo, right?"

"Yes," Zhang Xiaolong [3] sent the beasts into the beast space again. "Actually, there are two others, but they are my wives, and they live with my other wives. This way, you should no longer doubt that I can guarantee the safety and tranquility of your new sect, right?"

They no longer doubted Zhang Xiaolong [3], but they were still in a dilemma about the existence of the other dual cultivators in the Twin Flames Main Domain, and they weren’t confident in being able to coexist with them.

"Are you going to allow them to use the Celestial Yin Lake in your sect for cultivation, Zhang Fei?" Yue Xuelian, Yue Qianrou, and the elders turned to Yue Bingxuan, as they were unsure about it. "The concentration and strength of the yin qi in that lake are extremely high and pure, and the three of us have always cultivated there since we joined the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"Bingxuan is right," Yue Liuxian spoke. "The Celestial Yin Lake is the most suitable cultivation place for female cultivators like us."

Yue Liangyu also spoke to them. "No male cultivators dare to go near there, and they usually cultivate in the Celestial Yang Lake in the Blazing Union Sect, so we don’t have to worry about them spying on us."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] created two qi screens, which show the Celestial Yin Lake and the Celestial Yang Lake. "I don’t know how these two lakes were formed, but both are extremely beneficial to all cultivators, whether ordinary cultivators or dual cultivators. If you are interested in moving your sect to my domain, I will protect it and grant you access to cultivate in the Celestial Yin Lake. This way, the cultivation of all elders and disciples will increase rapidly, and they will become stronger than the other cultivators."
"Are there really no male cultivators who will peek at us if we cultivate there?" An elder asked him.

"Elder, they can peek into that lake if they are tired of living." The female elder looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in confusion. "All my wives often cultivate there, and I won’t let any man peek at them. If they dare to do that, I will never hesitate to kill them, even if they are talented disciples."
"Elder Qingyi, Zhang Fei is the most possessive man, so he will never allow other men to peek at them."

Yue Qingyi nodded in understanding to Yue Bingxuan before speaking to the others. "Since Zhang Fei is willing to guarantee our safety and privacy, I think we can move our sect to the Twin Flames Main Domain, and all the facilities there will be beneficial to our members."

After listening and considering everything, all the female elders finally agreed to move their sect to the Twin Flames Main Domain. However, they didn’t yet own a building in that domain, so they couldn’t move quickly, and it would take several years.
Yue Xuelian was pleased that they finally agreed with her choice. "Zhang Fei, what about the building for our new sect?"

"Regarding that matter, I think you should go to my domain again, Sect Master Xuelian. There are many empty areas there, so you can choose an area you think is suitable for your new sect, and I will order my people to build it afterward."

"Alright, I will go to your domain again to choose a suitable location for our new sect." Yue Xuelian looked at the others. "Qianrou, I want you, Yue Yuling, and Yue Qingyi to speak to our disciples about this matter."
"What if they don’t agree to move, Big Sis?"

Yue Xuelian considered that possibility first. "You should explain the sect’s and this domain’s situation, as well as the Twin Flames Main Domain’s. Additionally, you can tell them about the pressure from the Divine Samsara Sect, and our sect will have no future as long as we don’t escape it. They should have known our situation and the changes that occurred today, so I think they won’t object to it. If they do, we won’t take them with us, and they can join other sects in this domain."
"Yes, Big Sis." Yue Qianrou, Yue Yuling, and Yue Qingyi left the room to talk to the disciples.
"Elders, all of you can start packing up the things we rarely use starting today, and we will pack up the rest after our new sect is ready."
"Yes, Sect Master."

After all the elders left, Yue Xuelian immediately led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the teleportation portal location, followed by Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan. "What about this portal? What about your shop?"

"Haha," Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed. "This portal is portable, so I can move it anytime. As for my alchemy shop, I won’t be moving it, and Nanfeng Yunxi will manage it to serve the needs of the cultivators of this domain. Moreover, your sect’s transfer will not happen anytime soon, and we need several months to build your new sect."
"That’s true."

A short while later, they arrived at the Moonlit Passion Temple, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took Yue Xuelian with him. Meanwhile, Yue Liangyu, Yue Liuxian, and Yue Bingxuan immediately took off their robes to cultivate in the Celestial Yin Sect because it was already nighttime.
"How can you pass through these illusion and bewilderment formations so easily?"

"My beast ability can see through all illusion and bewilderment formations, so they’re useless to me, and I can move freely as if they don’t exist. As for the flying restriction formations, Liao Hanxue gave us the method to bypass them, allowing us to fly freely. However, this domain is filled with dense forests, so we have to go around manually to check those places." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Yue Xuelian. "May I ask you something, Sect Master Xuelian?"
Yue Xuelian nodded to him. "Feel free to ask."

"Why do I believe you act strange when you look at me? Why do you always avert your gaze as if you don’t dare look at me?" Yue Xuelian turned awkward as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked that. "See? You’re acting awkward now, making me have a lot of questions about you. Moreover, I can see the blush on your cheeks every time you look at me, even though we’ve never met before."
"Sorry, I can’t answer your questions." Yue Xuelian was too embarrassed to admit that she saw him naked every day, and she also repeatedly watched him have sex with all his women.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded slightly and did not ask Yue Xuelian anymore, but he immediately activated his demon eyes to see what was in her heart. However, he could not see anything negative in her heart, as if she had no negative thoughts at all, and her heart was too pure. ’This woman is really interesting.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1547: Searching Location
paragraphs: "Zhang Fei." Yue Xuelian looked at the giant black spider beast above them, but it immediately transformed into a woman who was none other than Xuan Meiyun, the leader of the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race. "Eh? Is this woman your new wife?"

"Yue Xuelian is the Sect Master of the Celestial Moon Sect in the Celestial Moon Domain." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at the increasingly awkward Yue Xuelian. "She is Xuan Meiyun, the leader of the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race from the Stygian Dusk Domain. Her race has excellent surveillance and communication abilities, so I asked them to join me to monitor the entire forest area."
Yue Xuelian nodded slightly. "I’ve never met her race before, but I’ve heard about their abilities, and this dense forest is the most suitable place for them."
"Hehe," Xuan Meiyun chuckled as she noticed Yue Xuelian’s awkward expression. "I won’t bother you two anymore, and I will meet my subordinates in other areas."

"Where shall we go first?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] grabbed Yue Xuelian’s hand and took her away using his teleportation ability, leaving her shocked. ’Is this also his beast ability? But how can he teleport non-stop?’
A few minutes later, they arrived near the living river that glowed white, where the statue of the twelve-winged woman was located. "I think this area is suitable for your sect, Sect Master Xuelian."

Yue Xuelian withdrew her hand from Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s grip and observed the area around them. She squatted next to the river, dipped her right hand, and felt the power of qi within it. "The yin qi in this river is much stronger than in my domain."

"You’re right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] squatted beside her. "There are two living rivers in this domain, both of which form Yin and Yang. This one is the Yin River, and the Yang River is located close to the Blazing Union Sect. Since this area is quite large and close to the source of Yin Qi, I think you will feel suited to this place, so I brought you here first. Moreover, this area is almost in the center of this domain, and there are many formations set up in the areas leading to this place, so I’m sure your new sect will be safer."

"Yes," Yue Xuelian waved her hand in the river. "You seem to understand Yin and Yang very well, eh? I feel that this place suits my sect, and the people of my sect can cultivate faster with the help of the Yin Qi in this river."

"Hehe," Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled. "I’m an experienced dual cultivator, so I naturally understand Yin and Yang well. If you find this place suitable, I’ll have my people begin building your new sect in this area today. I’ll give them the drawings of your sect so they can build one nearly identical to your old sect, and you’ll feel more comfortable living here."
"Alright, I choose this area." Yue Xuelian immediately stood up. "Why are you willing to help us so much?"

"Do you believe I have no other goals?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to her. "I just wanted to develop this domain, but I realized that I couldn’t rely solely on the local residents and all those sects. The Hidden Moon Sect already moved here a few months ago, and your sect will move here in the following months. However, I feel that’s not enough, so I plan to invite several other sects to move here."
"For example?"

"The Spring Breeze Pavilion and The Zenith Sect of the Sun-Moon Domain." Yue Xuelian naturally knew about both sects, which had also faced many setbacks similar to those of her Celestial Moon Sect. "I know Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei, and four of their disciples are also in my sect, so I want to offer them to move their two sects here."
Yue Xuelian nodded slightly. "It seems that you have selected from the start the sects you will invite to move to this domain."

"Yes," Zhang Xiaolong [3] stood in front of her. "I want this domain to remain as safe and peaceful as it is now, so I carefully selected the sects. I feel that the people from the Spring Breeze Pavilion and the Zenith Sect are excellent, but their situation has declined because of the Divine Samsara Sect, so I will invite them to join me."

"Even though I don’t know Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei personally, I know that they are both outstanding people who have always fought for their two sects, so I think your decision to invite them to join you is correct." Yue Xuelian’s face suddenly turned extremely red as the image of Zhang Fei with several naked women in the Celestial Spring Pool appeared in her mind, making her heart beat faster and louder. ’Ugh! They should keep training and not do such a thing now.’

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately noticed the change in Yue Xuelian’s face, and he knew that she was looking at something lewd; otherwise, her face would not be so red, but he did not know what she was looking at or the cause.

Yue Xuelian was shocked by the crimson flames that suddenly appeared on her dress, and she frantically tried to extinguish them. The flames did not harm her body, but they quickly burned her entire dress to ashes, leaving her naked in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"No!" Yue Xuelian screamed and jumped into the river. ’Ugh! He must have seen my naked body.’

Zhang Xiaolong [3] did see Yue Xuelian’s naked body clearly, but he was more concerned about the crimson flames that had burned her dress earlier. He had only ever met one person who possessed crimson flames, and that person was Feng Yao. ’Did you do that? When did you put your flames in her body?’

’Hahaha! I went to see Yue Xuelian some time ago to ask about Yue Qianrou, and I infused my crimson flames into her body.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] could only shake his head at Feng Yao’s mischievousness. ’You shouldn’t waste the good opportunity I gave you, and you should eat that woman straight away.’
"Hey! Please close your eyes."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn’t answer Feng Yao and closed his eyes as Yue Xuelian requested. Even so, he used the Demon-Piercing Eye he had mimicked from Jiu Yaoming several months ago. "You can come out now, Sect Master Xuelian."

Yue Xuelian first observed Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s eyes, making sure that he had closed them tightly. Once she was sure, she immediately got out of the river and took a change of clothes from her storage ring, but she didn’t realize that he could clearly see her naked body.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled faintly as he enjoyed Yue Xuelian’s flawless body without her knowledge. He thought about dispelling the qi surrounding her body, which would allow his Passive Lust Aura to spread and envelop her. However, he abandoned his intention because she was different from other women, and she would probably hate him if he did that.

As Yue Xuelian put on her replacement dress, Feng Yao’s crimson flames suddenly appeared and burned her gown to ashes again. She was utterly embarrassed that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was standing in front of her, and her body grew even redder as she continued to watch his real body’s activities with his women in her mind.

’What the hell is going on here? Where did these crimson flames come from?’ Yue Xuelian was irritated by that and took out another spare dress, but Feng Yao’s crimson flames burned it once again. It kept happening several times, which left her feeling hopeless. ’Sigh! What actually happened to me? My spare dresses are all gone now! I can’t be naked in front of Zhang Fei, or he will do something perverted to me.’
’Hey! Stop it, Feng Yao.’
’Hahaha!’
"Have you finished dressing?"
Yue Xuelian awkwardly covered her private parts. "Zhang Fei, I don’t know where those crimson flames came from, but they burned all my spare clothes, and I don’t have any spare ones left."
’Haha! Now’s your chance.’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn’t listen to Feng Yao, took out a change of clothes, and handed it to Yue Xuelian. "Wear them for now."

"Thank you." Yue Xuelian felt awkward and embarrassed to wear his clothes, but she had no other choice because all her spare dresses were gone. She didn’t wear them right away, as she was worried that the crimson flames would appear again and burn them. In the end, she wore them anyway, and she felt relieved that the crimson flames didn’t burn them. "Phew! You can open your eyes now."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his eyes. "What exactly happened? Where did those crimson flames come from?"

"This is my first time experiencing something like this, so I don’t know where those crimson flames came from." Yue Xuelian still felt embarrassed toward him. "Since we’ve found a suitable location for my new sect, we should return to your sect now, and I’ll go straight back to mine."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the gate leading to the Celestial Moon Domain. "You can enter now, and you will immediately arrive at your domain."
"Is this gate one of your beast’s abilities?"
"Yes."
Yue Xuelian nodded slightly. "I’ll be back now, and I’ll talk to the others about this location."
"I’ll go to your sect again later to record the entire area."
"Okay."
After Yue Xuelian disappeared, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately closed the gate and went elsewhere.

Yue Xuelian nodded slightly.

"I want this domain to remain as safe and peaceful as it is now, so I carefully selected the sects.
I feel that the people from the Spring Breeze Pavilion and the Zenith Sect are excellent, but their situation has declined because of the Divine Samsara Sect, so I will invite them to join me."

When did you put your flames in her body?’

It kept happening several times, which left her feeling hopeless. ’Sigh!
What actually happened to me?

"Wear them for now."

She didn’t wear them right away, as she was worried that the crimson flames would appear again and burn them.
In the end, she wore them anyway, and she felt relieved that the crimson flames didn’t burn them.

Where did those crimson flames come from?"

paragraphs: *Crack*
"Eh? Why are you wearing men’s clothes, Big Sis? Are these Zhang Fei’s clothes?"

"Yes," Yue Xuelian created a qi screen, showing the scene in the forest. "All my dresses were burned by those crimson flames, and I didn’t have any replacements left, so Zhang Fei lent me his spare clothes."
"Where do these crimson flames come from?" Yue Qianrou approached Yue Xuelian and helped her take off her clothes.

"They came from my body, but I can’t find their source." Yue Xuelian fell silent and thought about what happened after Feng Yao came to see her more than two months ago. ’What exactly is her purpose in doing this to me? Since she came to see me, I’ve been able to see all the activities of Zhang Fei and all his wives, and this incident also happened while I was with him.’
"Big Sis." Yue Xuelian turned to Yue Qianrou behind her, but her vice sect master suddenly kissed her lips. "Did Zhang Fei see you naked before?"

"He closed his eyes when I put on his clothes." Unfortunately, Yue Xuelian didn’t know that Zhang Fei had already seen her naked body, and he was interested in devouring her whole. "Why did you ask that?"

Yue Qianrou grabbed Yue Xuelian’s breasts and kneaded them, causing her to moan softly. "Big Sis, you are beautiful, and your body is so sexy. Moreover, Zhang Fei is a fox beast with many wives by his side, so I’m afraid that he is targeting you and wants to take you as his wife."

"You know that I will never be interested in any man, right?" Ye Xuelian faced her and briefly kissed her. "Zhang Fei is indeed extraordinary, and he can do many things that no other cultivator can, but I will never be interested in him. By the way, I’ve found a suitable location for our sect, and that area is near a river with an exceptionally high Yin Qi content. I don’t know how the Yin Qi there could be that strong, but I suspect it was caused by the existence of two moons in that domain."

"The Twin Flames Main Domain has indeed been strange since ancient times." Yue Qianrou took the dress from Yue Xuelian and helped her put it on. "That domain is the only one with two suns and two moons, but unfortunately, people discovered it too late, and dual cultivators had already filled it by the time those in the past discovered it. If our ancestors had discovered it earlier, our Celestial Moon Sect might not have been built in this domain but there."

Ye Xuelian agreed with her. "Even though this decision comes much too late, I think that domain will breathe new air into our sect, and we may become even stronger due to the abundant Yin Qi in that river."
"I hope we’ve made the right decision by moving our sect to the Twin Flames Main Domain, Big Sis."
"I hope so." Yue Xuelian suddenly raised an eyebrow and listened to the incoming voice transmission. "Liang Huizhong just contacted me."
"What does he want from us?"

"He asked us to send our elders to explore this Paradise Realm to determine the location and distance between this domain and the Heavenlight Domain." Yue Qianrou frowned at that. "I don’t know the distance between the two domains, but I hope they’re both very far away, so we have plenty of time to complete our sect’s relocation. As long as we remain in this domain, the Divine Samsara Sect will continue to treat us as their cash cow."
Yue Qianrou agreed with her. "Do you think they will be able to find our sect in the Twin Flames Main Domain, Big Sis?"

"I’m not sure about that." Yue Xuelian considered several possibilities first. "Liang Huizhong probably won’t be able to find us, but our former ancestors might be able to. However, I’ve personally seen all the formations in the Twin Flames Main Domain, and Zhang Fei has also brought all the members of the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race to his domain to utilize their excellent surveillance and communication abilities, so he will know everything that happens at any time."

Yue Qianrou let out a soft sigh as she remembered something. "All those formations are powerful because they were created by the Liao Clan from the Sky Pillar Domain, but we can’t underestimate the people from the Divine Samsara Sect because one of the clan’s ancestors was one of the sect’s founders, and she should still be alive now. If my guess is correct, she should be able to break through all the formations in the Twin Flames Main Domain. I hope our decision to move our sect to that domain won’t cause trouble for Zhang Fei and the Moonlit Passion Temple; otherwise, the sect will be destroyed if the people from the Divine Samsara Sect attack it."

"The people of the Divine Samsara Sect are indeed powerful, but you forget that Zhang Fei has nine evil mythical beasts by his side, and his two sect guardian beasts are also powerful," Yue Qianrou agreed. "Moreover, he has the ability to easily move between realms regardless of distance, and he still has many allies by his side, such as Empress Huo, Empress Long, and many more. If the people of that sect attack the Moonlit Passion Temple, I think we will see their destruction in the future, and the sect will no longer exist in this realm."
"I think the destruction of the Divine Samsara Sect will be good for us and everyone in the Paradise Realm, and we will no longer have to feel under their pressure."

Yue Xuelian nodded to her. "However, the destruction of the Divine Samsara Sect will also bring new problems to this Paradise Realm, and the situation in this realm will probably become even worse than it is now."
"Alright, let’s stop this discussion. We can’t predict what will happen in the future, and we can only wait for the outcome." Yue Qianrou then walked out. "I’ll help the elders pack, Big Sis."

Yue Xuelian sat on the bed and rubbed her lips, thinking about Yue Qianrou’s kiss earlier. She suddenly saw Zhang Xiaolong [3] meeting with two people, none other than Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei, to discuss their sect’s move to the Twin Flames Main Domain. "Sigh! I hate this situation! I don’t want to feel it, but his and his clones’ activities with their women are making me start to change, and I’m starting to find it difficult to control my lust."

Yue Xuelian tried to contact Feng Yao again to ask her to stop her connection with Zhang Fei and his five clones, but the female phoenix did not give her an answer. She thought about going to the Blazing Nirvana Domain, but she dropped the idea and closed her eyes to calm herself.

Somewhere in the Sun-Moon Main Domain, Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei seemed to be seriously considering Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s offer just now. They were aware that their sects would be in even greater trouble with the separation of the domains, so they were considering his offer seriously. Although the situation would bring changes for both their sects, the chaos and decline experienced by both sects were already too severe, and they would need hundreds or even thousands of years to repair everything.

Moreover, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already given disciples from both sects to cultivate at the Celestial Yin Lake and Celestial Yang Lake nine months ago, and they were already becoming accustomed to cultivating in both lakes. If they moved both sects to the Twin Flames Main Domain, their disciples would no longer need to commute between the two domains, and they would have greater convenience in cultivating in both lakes.

After considering everything, Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei finally came to a decision. "We agree with your idea of moving our two sects to your domain, but we won’t be able to move anytime soon. We need to communicate with everyone regarding our merger, and we also need to wait for the construction of our new sect to be completed."

"I understand that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at them. "After you discuss it with the members of your two sects, you can immediately inform me of the results. If all members of both sects agree, you two can send some representatives to my domain, and my people will begin construction on the new sect formed by the merger, which will likely take several months to complete. Since I still have other matters, I will be leaving now, and I will be waiting to hear from you two."
After Zhang Fei left, Gong Wei let out a soft sigh. "Our two sects have been in this domain for tens or hundreds of thousands of years, but we must move them to another domain soon."

"All the sects in this realm experienced major problems that led to decline after people discovered the portal to the Forbidden Land, and they all declined even further after many ancestors decided to join forces and establish the Divine Samsara Sect, which ultimately monopolized everything in this realm." Gong Wei agreed with Lu Shaqing. "I hope our decision to merge and move our sects to the Twin Flames Main Domain is correct, and I hope we can be successful again in the future."
"Hahaha," Gong Wei stood up from his seat. "I hope so, Sect Master Lu. So, what will our sect be called after the merger?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1549: Back To Seclusion
paragraphs: After leaving the Sun-Moon Domain, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to several other domains, such as the Radiant Starfall Domain, the Lotus Expanse Domain, the Azure Cloud Domain, and the Twilight Domain, to check on the situation there. He found the situation much more under control, and the cultivators there held a feast to welcome the changes in the Paradise Realm.

Since all the domains were separated by a great distance, they were confident that no more invaders would invade their domains. They were sure they could adapt to the situation, and everything would return to normal once they had adjusted to it, even though it would greatly affect their domains.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke with Huo Lanyin, Huo Yu’er, Huo Yan’er, and Huo Xiaoyu about the changes in the Paradise Realm. They already knew everything from Feng Yao, who had ordered them to take action if the situation in the four domains became chaotic in order to restore calm.

Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary to talk to Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi, but the two of them had already heard everything from Bing Xingying. As for the five ancestors of the Luo Clan, his father-in-law told him that they had still been in seclusion since they returned from the Ashen Lotus Monastery half a year ago, but they had asked about him several times.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn’t care much about the five ancestors of the Luo Clan, and he waited for their decision on their relationship. He asserted to Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi that he would have no qualms about fighting the five of them, and he would do something to them if they insisted on being his enemies.

After they finished talking, Zhang Xiaolong [3] installed a teleportation device in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary in a special place, allowing his parents-in-law to freely go to the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] left the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary and headed to another domain, which was the Nine Nether Demon. There, he met Jiu Mozu and Jiu Moze, and he ordered them some things before leaving again.

Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s next destination was the Slaughter Blood Domain, where he spoke with Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui about the changes in the Paradise Realm. They asked him about the destruction of the gates, but he refused to admit that he was the cause of their destruction.

Although Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not want to admit it, Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui believed that he was the mastermind behind the destruction of those gates. He told the Asura Demon Empress that he would take her to the Ashen Lotus Monastery again someday so she could spend time with her daughter like some time ago.

Shang Luohu would rather have Zhang Xiaolong [3] return Shang Xueli to her so they could live together like in the past, but she knew that that would never happen before Shang Zhanluo accepted his offer to join him.

After they talked for some time, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately left the Slaughter Blood Domain to go to another domain. Meanwhile, Shang Luohu went to her husband’s seclusion room to check on Shang Zhanluo’s condition, especially after her husband made a lot of noise some time ago.
The appearance of Zhang Xiaolong [3] startled Mo Zainan, who was deep in thought in her room. She hurriedly got out of bed, ran towards him, jumped into his arms, and kissed him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] gladly returned Mo Zainan’s kiss as he carried her back to bed and laid her down. He pinned her down and gave her deeper, passionate kisses for a few minutes.

After they finished kissing, Mo Zainan cupped his face and looked at him longingly. "Why haven’t you come to see me since last time? How are my two daughters doing in your sect? Are they able to blend in with those people?"

"Your two daughters are doing well in my sect, and they blend in perfectly with the people there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] told Mo Zainan about Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha’s situation at the Moonlit Passion Temple, which relieved her. "I was previously busy with my seclusion in a special place, which made it impossible for anyone else to contact me. Since my cultivation has not yet broken through to the Celestial Emperor Realm, I will continue my seclusion after this. If you need anything from me, you can leave a message with your two daughters, and I will come to see you right away."
"Alright, you can continue your seclusion, and I hope you’ll break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm sooner than you think."
"Did Mo Shentian contact you in the last three and a half months?"

"My husband contacts me every month to inquire about the situation within our Celestial Demon Race, and he also tells me about their journey, which is already halfway to the Three Mortal Realms." Zhang Xiaolong [3] had expected this from the start. "He will probably arrive there in the next three months, but he must be shocked that his journey will end in vain because they won’t be able to exit the tunnel."

"Haha," Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed softly. "How could your husband not be shocked and disappointed by that? He spent about half a year traveling to that realm, but in the end, he would not be able to get out of the tunnel, and he would have no choice but to return to this realm, which would be a waste of his time. When he reaches the end of the tunnel to return to this realm, he will be shocked again because he cannot get out, and he will be trapped there for quite a long time."
Mo Zainan nodded with a smile. "Do the changes in this realm have anything to do with you?"
"Do you like the changes?"

"Yes," Mo Zainan replied with a nod. "Since my husband left, I’ve seen several demon races attempting to enter this domain, especially demons from the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race. Fortunately, the barriers in our domain are much stronger than those of other domains, so they haven’t managed to get in. If Sha Mo and Sha Yuan manage to break through my barrier, I won’t be able to face them both in my husband’s absence, and they will successfully take over this domain. After this, the distance between all domains will be far away, and we won’t know the exact position of each domain, so I don’t need to be afraid that they will attack us."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled at her as he stroked her cheek. "After the changes in this realm, I believe that the situation in all domains will be more controlled, and the calm will last for a few years until everyone gets used to the changes. Once they get used to it, this realm will likely become chaotic again, but not as much as before, and only in their internal domains."
"I hope you’re right." Then, Mo Zainan asked him, "Are you going to leave right away?"

"Time is ticking, so I must improve my cultivation as soon as possible. Since the situation in this realm is still chaotic due to the changes, I want to use this time to increase my strength, and I probably won’t be leaving my seclusion for two or three years." Zhang Xiaolong [3] briefly kissed Mo Zainan as she wore a disappointed look. "When I’m stronger, I’ll help remove your husband’s mark from your soul. That way, you’ll be free from his control, and we can be together afterward."

He found the situation much more under control, and the cultivators there held a feast to welcome the changes in the Paradise Realm.
Since all the domains were separated by a great distance, they were confident that no more invaders would invade their domains.
They were sure they could adapt to the situation, and everything would return to normal once they had adjusted to it, even though it would greatly affect their domains.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke with Huo Lanyin, Huo Yu’er, Huo Yan’er, and Huo Xiaoyu about the changes in the Paradise Realm.
They already knew everything from Feng Yao, who had ordered them to take action if the situation in the four domains became chaotic in order to restore calm.
Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary to talk to Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi, but the two of them had already heard everything from Bing Xingying.

As for the five ancestors of the Luo Clan, his father-in-law told him that they had still been in seclusion since they returned from the Ashen Lotus Monastery half a year ago, but they had asked about him several times.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn’t care much about the five ancestors of the Luo Clan, and he waited for their decision on their relationship.
He asserted to Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi that he would have no qualms about fighting the five of them, and he would do something to them if they insisted on being his enemies.

After they finished talking, Zhang Xiaolong [3] installed a teleportation device in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary in a special place, allowing his parents-in-law to freely go to the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Although Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not want to admit it, Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui believed that he was the mastermind behind the destruction of those gates.
He told the Asura Demon Empress that he would take her to the Ashen Lotus Monastery again someday so she could spend time with her daughter like some time ago.

Shang Luohu would rather have Zhang Xiaolong [3] return Shang Xueli to her so they could live together like in the past, but she knew that that would never happen before Shang Zhanluo accepted his offer to join him.

How are my two daughters doing in your sect?
Are they able to blend in with those people?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1550: Hu Hunzi - Spirit Fox Race
paragraphs: "Haha," Hu Tianlang turned to the young male fox. "Hu Hunzi, I told you that Zhang Fei was the chosen one to save this universe, remember? Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian have become much stronger since I brought them to this Illusion Spirit Fox Domain a few years ago, but they will never be his match because he will become truly powerful in the future, and he will defeat them."
"Is it true that Zhang Fei will lead all the fox races back to their glory?"

Hu Tianlang nodded at him. "When Zhang Fei becomes truly powerful in the future, all the fox races will regain their glory, and all of you will live much better lives under his leadership. You are the future leader of the Spirit Fox Race, and you must work together with him in the future to bring happiness and prosperity to your race. Do you understand?"

"Yes, Grandpa Hun." Hu Hunzi looked at Tian Baixing and Tian Baitaian. "I will return to my hut, Grandpa. I will continue cultivating while waiting for Zhang Fei to come to this domain, and I will follow him as you told me."

Hu Tianlang smiled as he watched Hu Hunzi leave, and he looked at Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian again. ’I know my decision is unfair to you two, but there’s nothing I can do about it. Although you two have the chance to evolve into ten-tailed foxes, Zhang Fei is the one chosen by those hidden forces, and no one can stand against them, including me and Shen Yuanzhi.’
After Hu Tianlang left, Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian opened their eyes, but their expressions were completely ugly. "Will we never be able to leave this domain, Brother?"

"Our ancestor is constantly watching us, and he has set up a formation here, preventing us from going anywhere." Tian Baitian looked outside. "However, I’m curious about the ten-tailed fox and the requirements for evolving into one, especially since I don’t have any information about it."
"Since our ancestor said such things, we must improve our cultivation and reach the Celestial God Realm as soon as possible, and we will face Zhang Fei together in the future."
"Yeah." Tian Baitian closed his eyes again. "The Celestial God Realm is still far from our reach, so we don’t need to think about anything else and focus on achieving it."
"Yes."
In the training space, Zhang Fei sat with all his wives in the main garden, discussing his plans for their future after the changes that occurred in the Paradise Realm.

All his wives, especially Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran, were relieved by this. Since they didn’t yet have clear information about their two domains, they were considering returning to ensure that other domains, especially the other demon domains, weren’t near theirs.
"Can you take Qingxiu and me back to our domain to check?" Ye Mingran asked him.

"Alright." After they dressed, Zhang Fei led Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu out of the pavilion, and Nalan Shizhe decided to join them because she needed to ensure the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain was in a safe location.

They were already standing outside the Eternal Night Demon Domain, covering their bodies with qi. They couldn’t see any other domains in the surrounding area, indicating that the Eternal Night Demon Domain was quite far from them, which relieved Ye Mingran.

Ye Futian suddenly appeared before them. "It seems my guess was correct about the changes in this realm today. You are the mastermind behind the disappearance of those gates, which separated all the domains by a tremendous distance."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei rubbed his nose. "Do you like the changes in this realm, great grandmaster?"

"Yes," Ye Futian nodded at him. "We’ve checked several hundred miles around our domain, and we couldn’t find a single domain in this area, including the Seven Emotions Demon and the Soul-Devouring Demon, which means they are very far away."

Ye Mingran was relieved to hear that, and she was sure that her domain would be safe from invaders for the next few years. "Futian, I will be in seclusion with Zhang Fei for the next few years, so I hand over our domain to you, and you can make all the decisions without waiting for me."

"Haha," Ye Futian laughed as he noticed Ye Mingran’s change. "Demon God, I never imagined that you would also become his wife, but I’m happy for you that you’ve been able to move on from your late husband."

Ye Mingran nodded at him. "I never dreamed that a day like this would come in my life, but I can say for sure that I’m happy with my change, and I will be even stronger after we break our seclusion. By the way, you must always be alert to the movements of the Winged Race because Tian Qiye will attack us once the situation returns to normal, and we might face a big war with them at that time."
"It seems Tian Qiye holds a grudge against our demon race, huh?"

"That’s for sure, right?" Ye Mingran released a soft sigh. "We have never attacked the Winged Race, but our ancestors repeatedly attacked them in the past, and they killed many of their members back then. The situation in this realm will be peaceful for the next few years, but I’m sure Tian Qiye has already deployed her subordinates to move around and map out the distances of all domains, and she will target our demon race first."

"Back then, Tian Qiye didn’t dare attack us because of the gates, making it easier for the other demon races to come to our aid. Now, all the domains are far apart, and the other demon races will surely be focused on their respective members, so they won’t have time to help us."

"That’s why you must always be fully alert when I’m in isolation, and you can activate our domain’s protective barrier to ensure that no intruders can enter our domain for now." Ye Mingran turned to Zhang Fei. "Can you do anything to let me know the changes in the situation in my domain at any time? Even though you have sent my artificial doll here, I feel uncomfortable being away for too long."

"That’s too easy." Zhang Fei touched his chest and pulled a strand of his soul out, shooting it into Ye Futian’s body. "This way, I can monitor the situation in your domain in real time, and I will immediately bring you back here if there is any danger threatening the safety of your race members. As for the Winged Race, you don’t need to worry too much about them because Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu are my servants, and I have implanted something into their souls, so I will immediately know about Tian Qiye’s plans and movements."

"That’s good." Ye Mingran looked at Ye Futian again. "We’ll leave now, and I’ll hand over our domain to you. You also have to protect my children and tell them not to go anywhere for now, and they have to focus on their cultivation."
"Yes, Demon God." Ye Futian shook his head slightly after Zhang Fei led the three women away. "Since she’s his wife now, our demon race may experience changes in the future."
Thereafter, Ye Futian returned inside, and he activated the protective barrier. He also gathered the higher-ups of the Eternal Demon Race, instructing them on several matters.
They had arrived at the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain, and Nalan Shizhe immediately gathered all the members of his race and gave them some instructions.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei inspected the area outside the domain, ensuring that there were no other domains near the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain. He was relieved after he couldn’t find other domains, like the Eternal Night Demon Domain, so his mother-in-law didn’t need to worry about the safety of her race members.

After Nalan Shizhe finished speaking with her race members, Zhang Fei took the three women into the Seven Emotions Demon Domain. However, they saw another domain very close to it, but they were relieved because that domain was where the Faceless Demon Race lived.

Since the Faceless Demon God, Wu Mian, was their ally, they didn’t need to worry about the situation in the Seven Emotions Demon Domain. They didn’t go to see him, but Zhang Fei contacted him and asked him to protect her domain as well.
After Qi Qingxiu activated the barrier protecting the Seven Emotions Demon Domain, Zhang Fei brought the three women back into the training space to continue their seclusion.

Not long after, Wu Mian appeared in the area, but he used the body of a female demon that he left in the Seven Emotions Demon Domain. "That kid is truly terrifying! He managed to destroy those gates that no one else, including Long Wuzhao and all the previous demon gods, had ever been able to destroy. This realm has returned to how it was in the past, and all the domains are now separated by a great distance."
A male demon suddenly appeared beside Wu Mian. "Do you think this realm will be peaceful from now on, Demon God?"

"No," Wu Mian replied as he shook his head. "The peace and security in this realm will not last forever, and in a few years the situation will become chaotic again, especially after all races adapt to the changes. Fortunately, I’ve left one body in each domain; otherwise, I would have difficulty monitoring change in their situation. Let’s go back, Wu Yu."
"Yes, Demon God."
